```php
})->with(['archived organisation', 'address taken', 'cancelled invitation']);

it('cuts the sessions and remember token of a disabled or deleted user, so re-enabling or restoring revives neither (RL-28)', function (string $lockOut): void {
    // The database session driver (the kit default), set before anything resolves the session or the
    // guard, so the guard and the session middleware share one database-backed store.
    config(['session.driver' => 'database']);
    app()->forgetInstance('session.store');
    app('session')->forgetDrivers();
    app()->forgetInstance('auth.driver');
    Auth::forgetGuards();

    $organisation = Organisation::factory()->create();
    $member = User::factory()->for($organisation)->create(['remember_token' => 'old-remember-token']);
    $colleague = User::factory()->for($organisation)->create();
    $admin = asOrgAdmin($organisation);

    // A colleague's signed-in browser, which the lock-out leaves alone.
    DB::table('sessions')->insert([
        'id' => Str::random(40),
        'user_id' => $colleague->id,
        'ip_address' => '127.0.0.1',
        'user_agent' => 'test',
        'payload' => '',
        'last_activity' => time(),
    ]);

    $guard = Auth::guard('web');
    $sessionCookie = (string) config('session.cookie');
    $recallerCookie = $guard->getRecallerName();
    $rememberCookie = [$recallerCookie => $member->id.'|old-remember-token|'.$guard->hashPasswordForCookie($member->password)];

    /**
     * A new browser visit: no guard state, no session attributes and only the given cookies. Both cookie
     * names are always sent, an empty value meaning "no cookie", so nothing carries over from the last visit.
     *
     * @param  array<string, string>  $cookies
     */
    $newBrowserVisit = function (array $cookies) use ($sessionCookie, $recallerCookie): TestResponse {
        Auth::forgetGuards();
        app()->forgetInstance('auth.driver');
        $this->flushSession();

        return $this->withCookies(array_replace([$sessionCookie => '', $recallerCookie => ''], $cookies))
            ->get(route('dashboard'));
    };

    // Before the lock-out the remember cookie signs the member in, and the database driver stores that
    // session under the member's id.
    $newBrowserVisit($rememberCookie)->assertOk();
    $this->assertAuthenticatedAs($member);
    $sessionId = app('session')->driver()->getId();
    expect(DB::table('sessions')->where('id', $sessionId)->value('user_id'))->toBe($member->id);

    // The session cookie alone signs the member in too.
    $newBrowserVisit([$sessionCookie => $sessionId])->assertOk();
    $this->assertAuthenticatedAs($member);

    if ($lockOut === 'disable') {
        app(UpdateUserStatus::class)->handle($admin, $member, UserStatus::Disabled);
    } else {
        app(DeleteUser::class)->handle($admin, $member);
    }

    expect(DB::table('sessions')->where('user_id', $member->id)->exists())->toBeFalse()
        ->and(DB::table('sessions')->where('user_id', $colleague->id)->exists())->toBeTrue()
        ->and(DB::table('users')->where('id', $member->id)->value('remember_token'))->toBeNull();

    if ($lockOut === 'disable') {
        app(UpdateUserStatus::class)->handle($admin, $member->refresh(), UserStatus::Active);
    } else {
        app(RestoreUser::class)->handle($admin, $member->refresh());
    }

    // After re-enabling or restoring, neither the old session cookie nor the old remember cookie signs in.
    $newBrowserVisit([$sessionCookie => $sessionId])->assertRedirect(route('login'));
    $this->assertGuest();

    $newBrowserVisit($rememberCookie)->assertRedirect(route('login'));
    $this->assertGuest();
})->with(['disable', 'delete']);

it('records status changes and deletions', function (): void {
    $organisation = Organisation::factory()->create();
    $member = User::factory()->for($organisation)->create();
    $admin = asOrgAdmin($organisation);

    app(UpdateUserStatus::class)->handle($admin, $member, UserStatus::Disabled);
    app(UpdateUserStatus::class)->handle($admin, $member, UserStatus::Disabled);
    app(DeleteUser::class)->handle($admin, $member);

    $statusChange = recordedActivity(ActivityEvent::UserStatusChanged)->sole();
    $deletion = recordedActivity(ActivityEvent::UserDeleted)->sole();

    expect($statusChange->subject_id)->toBe($member->id)
        ->and($statusChange->causer_id)->toBe($admin->id)
        ->and($statusChange->organisation_id)->toBe($organisation->id)
        ->and($statusChange->attribute_changes?->toArray())->toEqual(['old' => ['status' => 'active'], 'attributes' => ['status' => 'disabled']])
        ->and($deletion->subject_id)->toBe($member->id)
        ->and($deletion->causer_id)->toBe($admin->id)
        ->and($deletion->organisation_id)->toBe($organisation->id);
});
```

The test runs on the database session driver, set before anything resolves the session or the guard (session.store, the session manager's drivers, auth.driver and the guards are forgotten first). It replays both the real session cookie and the remember cookie: each signs the member in before the lock-out, and neither does after re-enabling or restoring. Each visit forgets the guards and `auth.driver` (the database handler stores `user_id` from `auth.driver`) and flushes the session store; it clears the other cookie by sending it empty, because the test case's cookie list (`$defaultCookies`) is a protected property: the Pest PHPStan plugin waives only protected methods and constants on `$this` in a test closure (`TestCaseMemberVisibilityIgnoreExtension`), not protected properties, so Larastan would report `$this->defaultCookies = []`.

```php
    'disabled' => [UserStatus::Disabled, 'zinc'],
]);
```

```php
<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

/** covers §4.3, §4.4 */

use App\Models\User;
use App\Tenancy\Auth\Sessions;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;
use Illuminate\Support\Str;

it('deletes the users\' session rows and clears their remember tokens, and leaves everyone else alone (RL-28)', function (): void {
    $first = User::factory()->create(['remember_token' => 'first-token']);
    $second = User::factory()->create(['remember_token' => 'second-token']);
    $otherUser = User::factory()->create(['remember_token' => 'other-token']);

    /** Stores a session row the way the database session driver writes it; a guest row has no user_id. */
    $storeSession = function (?User $owner): string {
        $id = Str::random(40);
        DB::table('sessions')->insert([
            'id' => $id,
            'user_id' => $owner?->id,
            'ip_address' => '127.0.0.1',
            'user_agent' => 'test',
            'payload' => '',
            'last_activity' => time(),
        ]);

        return $id;
    };

    $storeSession($first);
    $storeSession($first);
    $storeSession($second);
    $kept = [$storeSession($otherUser), $storeSession(null)];

    Sessions::endFor([$first->id, $second->id]);

    expect(DB::table('sessions')->pluck('id')->all())->toEqualCanonicalizing($kept)
        ->and(DB::table('users')->whereIn('id', [$first->id, $second->id])->pluck('remember_token')->all())->toBe([null, null])
        ->and(DB::table('users')->where('id', $otherUser->id)->value('remember_token'))->toBe('other-token');
});
```

`endFor()` matches on `sessions.user_id` only, so the rows carry an empty payload.

- [ ] **Step 4: Add the session-cutting helper**

`app/Tenancy/Auth/Sessions.php`:

```php
<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace App\Tenancy\Auth;

use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;

/**
 * Ends the stored sessions of locked-out users (RL-28): disabled, deleted, or archived or purged with
 * their organisation. With the database session driver (the kit default) deleting the users' rows signs
 * them out on every device; a null remember token makes every "remember me" cookie worthless (the next
 * remember-me sign-in sets a new one). A plain delete by sessions.user_id, inside the caller's transaction.
 */
final class Sessions
{
    /** @param  list<int>  $userIds */
    public static function endFor(array $userIds): void
    {
        if ($userIds === []) {
            return;
        }

        DB::table('sessions')->whereIn('user_id', $userIds)->delete();
        DB::table('users')->whereIn('id', $userIds)->update(['remember_token' => null]);
    }
}
```

`DB::table()` applies no global scopes, so the helper also reaches users the archive cascade has just soft-deleted. `UpdateUserStatus` and `DeleteUser` keep their in-memory model in step with the row (`remember_token` null, synced as original) instead of saving it again.

- [ ] **Step 5: Add the status action**

`app/Actions/Users/UpdateUserStatus.php`:

```php
<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace App\Actions\Users;

use App\Actions\Audit\RecordActivity;
use App\Authorization\EffectivePermissions;
use App\Authorization\LockoutGuard;
use App\Enums\ActivityEvent;
use App\Enums\UserStatus;
use App\Models\User;
use App\Tenancy\Auth\Sessions;
use Illuminate\Auth\Access\AuthorizationException;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Gate;
use Illuminate\Validation\ValidationException;

/**
 * Enables or disables a user (§4.4, DEC-26 (3)). updateStatus is always checked, so nobody disables
 * themselves, super admins included (W2, W12). Pending activation is never set by hand and a pending
 * user's status only changes by accepting the invitation (W4, USR-13). Disabling never removes the
 * last active super admin or the last active organisation admin, whoever asks (DEC-26 (10)), and it
 * ends the user's sessions and cycles the remember token, so enabling them again revives neither
 * (RL-28). Every decision is taken on the stored row, never on a possibly stale model (FU2-5).
 */
final readonly class UpdateUserStatus
{
    public function __construct(
        private LockoutGuard $lockoutGuard,
        private EffectivePermissions $effectivePermissions,
        private RecordActivity $recordActivity,
    ) {}

    /**
     * @throws AuthorizationException
     * @throws ValidationException
     */
    public function handle(User $actor, User $target, UserStatus $status): void
    {
        Gate::forUser($actor)->authorize('updateStatus', $target);

        if ($status === UserStatus::PendingActivation) {
            throw ValidationException::withMessages(['status' => [__('Pending activation can\'t be set by hand.')]]);
        }

        DB::transaction(function () use ($actor, $target, $status): void {
            $stored = DB::table('users')->where('id', $target->id)->first(['status', 'is_super_admin']);

            if ($stored === null) {
                return;
            }

            $previous = UserStatus::from((string) $stored->status);

            if ($previous === UserStatus::PendingActivation) {
                throw ValidationException::withMessages(['status' => [__('A pending user becomes active by accepting the invitation.')]]);
            }

            // Align the model with the stored row first, so the save and the logged old status match it.
            $target->forceFill(['status' => $previous])->syncOriginalAttribute('status');

            if ($status === $previous) {
                return;
            }

            if ($previous === UserStatus::Active) {
                $this->ensureAnotherActiveAdmin($target, (bool) $stored->is_super_admin);

                Sessions::endFor([$target->id]);
                $target->forceFill(['remember_token' => null])->syncOriginalAttribute('remember_token');
            }

            $target->forceFill(['status' => $status])->save();

            $this->recordActivity->handle(
                ActivityEvent::UserStatusChanged,
                $target,
                changes: ['old' => ['status' => $previous->value], 'attributes' => ['status' => $status->value]],
                causer: $actor,
            );
        });
    }

    /** @throws ValidationException */
    private function ensureAnotherActiveAdmin(User $target, bool $isSuperAdmin): void
    {
        if ($isSuperAdmin) {
            $this->lockoutGuard->ensureAnotherActiveSuperAdmin($target, 'status');
        }

        $teamId = $target->organisation_id;

        if ($teamId !== null && $this->effectivePermissions->holdsTemplate([$target->id], $teamId) !== []) {
            $this->lockoutGuard->ensureAnotherActiveOrganisationAdmin($target, $teamId, 'status');
        }
    }
}
```

- [ ] **Step 6: Add the delete action**

`app/Actions/Users/DeleteUser.php`:

```php
<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace App\Actions\Users;

use App\Actions\Audit\RecordActivity;
use App\Authorization\EffectivePermissions;
use App\Authorization\LockoutGuard;
use App\Enums\ActivityEvent;
use App\Enums\UserStatus;
use App\Models\User;
use App\Tenancy\Auth\Sessions;
use Illuminate\Auth\Access\AuthorizationException;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Gate;
use Illuminate\Validation\ValidationException;

/**
 * Soft-deletes a user (§4.4, DEC-26 (3)). delete is always checked, so nobody deletes themselves (W2).
 * Deleting an active user never removes the last active super admin or the last active organisation
 * admin, whoever asks (DEC-26 (10), W12). A pending user is removed by cancelling the invitation.
 * The user's sessions end and the remember token is cycled, so a restore revives neither (RL-28).
 * Every decision is taken on the stored row, never on a possibly stale model (FU2-5).
 */
final readonly class DeleteUser
{
    public function __construct(
        private LockoutGuard $lockoutGuard,
        private EffectivePermissions $effectivePermissions,
        private RecordActivity $recordActivity,
    ) {}

    /**
     * @throws AuthorizationException
     * @throws ValidationException
     */
    public function handle(User $actor, User $target): void
    {
        Gate::forUser($actor)->authorize('delete', $target);

        DB::transaction(function () use ($actor, $target): void {
            $stored = DB::table('users')->where('id', $target->id)->first(['status', 'is_super_admin', 'deleted_at']);

            if ($stored === null || $stored->deleted_at !== null) {
                return;
            }

            if ($stored->status === UserStatus::PendingActivation->value) {
                throw ValidationException::withMessages(['user' => [__('Cancel the invitation instead.')]]);
            }

            if ($stored->status === UserStatus::Active->value) {
                $this->ensureAnotherActiveAdmin($target, (bool) $stored->is_super_admin);
            }

            Sessions::endFor([$target->id]);
            $target->forceFill(['remember_token' => null])->syncOriginalAttribute('remember_token');
            $target->delete();

            $this->recordActivity->handle(ActivityEvent::UserDeleted, $target, causer: $actor);
        });
    }

    /** @throws ValidationException */
    private function ensureAnotherActiveAdmin(User $target, bool $isSuperAdmin): void
    {
        if ($isSuperAdmin) {
            $this->lockoutGuard->ensureAnotherActiveSuperAdmin($target, 'user');
        }

        $teamId = $target->organisation_id;

        if ($teamId !== null && $this->effectivePermissions->holdsTemplate([$target->id], $teamId) !== []) {
            $this->lockoutGuard->ensureAnotherActiveOrganisationAdmin($target, $teamId, 'user');
        }
    }
}
```

`Sessions::endFor()` has already cleared the remember token on the row, so the model is only aligned with it; `$target->delete()` writes `deleted_at`/`updated_at` only. Spatie keeps the role rows on a soft delete, so a restored user keeps their roles. The stored row is read without a lock on purpose: `LockoutGuard` then locks the whole candidate set in id order (the target included when it is an admin), as in `SetSuperAdmin`, so the lock order stays the one RL-27 fixes. A trashed or pending target no longer has a check before the transaction: one decision on the stored row is enough, and the policy runs first either way.

`app/Actions/Users/RestoreUser.php`:

```php
<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace App\Actions\Users;

use App\Actions\Audit\RecordActivity;
use App\Enums\ActivityEvent;
use App\Enums\UserStatus;
use App\Models\Organisation;
use App\Models\User;
use App\Rules\AvailableEmail;
use Illuminate\Auth\Access\AuthorizationException;
use Illuminate\Database\UniqueConstraintViolationException;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Gate;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Validator;
use Illuminate\Validation\ValidationException;

/**
 * Restores a deleted user (§4.4, DEC-26 (11)). restore is not always-checked, so the domain guards
 * live here and apply to super admins too: never while the organisation is archived (restore the
 * organisation instead), never when the address is in use again (W9), and never for a pending user,
 * whose invitation was cancelled (C-9).
 */
final readonly class RestoreUser
{
    public function __construct(private RecordActivity $recordActivity) {}

    /**
     * @throws AuthorizationException
     * @throws ValidationException
     */
    public function handle(User $actor, User $target): void
    {
        Gate::forUser($actor)->authorize('restore', $target);

        if (! $target->trashed()) {
            return;
        }

        if ($target->status === UserStatus::PendingActivation) {
            throw ValidationException::withMessages(['user' => [__('This user never accepted their invitation. Invite the address again.')]]);
        }

        if ($target->organisation_id !== null && Organisation::onlyTrashed()->whereKey($target->organisation_id)->exists()) {
            throw ValidationException::withMessages(['user' => [__('Restore the organisation first.')]]);
        }

        Validator::make(
            ['email' => $target->email],
            ['email' => [new AvailableEmail($target->organisation_id, $target->id)]],
        )->validate();

        try {
            DB::transaction(function () use ($actor, $target): void {
                $target->restore();

                $this->recordActivity->handle(ActivityEvent::UserRestored, $target, causer: $actor);
            });
        } catch (UniqueConstraintViolationException) {
            // The address was taken between validation and restore (FU3-8).
            $target->refresh();

            throw ValidationException::withMessages(['email' => [__('This address can\'t be used.')]]);
        }
    }
}
```

`Organisation` is a central model, so `Organisation::onlyTrashed()` needs no tenant; `$target->restore()` and `refresh()` query without global scopes, so they work on any host.

### Task 7: Host scope and admin scaffolding

**Covers:** TEN-2 (mechanism), DEC26-1 (mechanism), DEC25-2, FU2-10, FU3-16 (part), RL-8, RL-25, C-2; OR-I5 (first half), RK-I4 (helper), RK-I11 (helper).

What this task delivers, spelled out:
- **Host-scoped reads (RL-8).** The admin pages of M4 are *any-host* pages: they run on a tenant host (`{slug}.localhost`, where `TenantScope` limits tenant models to that organisation) and on the central hosts (`localhost`, `admin.localhost`, where only super admins get through `VerifyTenantMembership`). Strict tenancy throws when a tenant model (`User`, later `Activity`, `Invitation`) is read with no tenant bound, and `Tenant::bypass()` is only allowed in `app/Console/`, `app/Setup/`, `app/Tenancy/`, `app/Actions/Audit/`, `database/seeders/` (enforced by `tests/Arch/TenancyRulesTest.php`). Pages must **not** join that allow-list (its path match would also allow a bypass on the tenant-host code path, C-2). Instead `App\Tenancy\HostScope::read(Closure)` runs the closure as is when a tenant is bound (scoped), inside `Tenant::bypass()` when no tenant is bound and the signed-in user is a super admin, and throws `AuthorizationException` (403) otherwise.
- `HostScope` covers tenant models only. Central models (organisations, Spatie roles and pivots) are filtered by the caller with `HostScope::organisationId()`: the tenant's id on a tenant host, `null` ("all organisations") for a super admin on a central host, `AuthorizationException` for anyone else (RK-I4).
- `HostScope::lockForWrite(Organisation)` is for actions of later tasks (invite, create, roles): inside the caller's transaction it re-reads the organisation `withTrashed()` with `FOR UPDATE`, refuses another tenant's organisation while a tenant is bound (`AuthorizationException`) and refuses an archived one (`ValidationException` on `organisation`: "This organisation is archived."). It throws `LogicException` when no transaction is open (RK-I11). The tenant check runs before the archived check, so a foreign tenant never learns whether an organisation is archived.
- **Current-user helper (RL-25, DEC25-2).** The private `user(): User` helper that is duplicated in the profile, security and recovery-codes components becomes the trait `App\Concerns\ResolvesCurrentUser::currentUser()`, because M4 adds about ten more components that need it.
- **Admin routes file.** `routes/admin.php` is required from `routes/web.php`; it holds an (empty for now) `auth` group for the admin pages and a marked spot, outside that group, for the signed invitation route of Task 11.
- **Arch rules.** The bypass rule also catches `newModelQuery(` (a query without global scopes) and an aliased `TenantScope` import, and the test now proves that its pattern recognises every form it names (FU3-16: "the widened bypass rule has no test that can fail"). A new rule keeps raw `like` operators out of the app (FU2-10: "ilike rule narrower than §7.2" — §7.2 forbids every driver-specific SQL; search uses `whereLike(..., caseSensitive: false)`).
- **Test helpers.** `pageSnapshot()` and `callPageAction()` in `tests/Pest.php` are the generic forms of M3's `securityPageSnapshot()` / `callOnSecurityPage()`: render a page over HTTP, take a component's snapshot, and replay a Livewire update as a forged request (other actor, forged parameters, wrong host). Tasks 8, 9 and later use them.

**Files:**
- Create: `app/Tenancy/HostScope.php`, `app/Concerns/ResolvesCurrentUser.php`, `routes/admin.php`
- Modify: `routes/web.php`, `resources/views/pages/settings/profile/profile.php`, `resources/views/pages/settings/security/security.php`, `resources/views/pages/settings/two-factor/recovery-codes/recovery-codes.php`, `tests/Arch/TenancyRulesTest.php`, `tests/Pest.php`, `lang/nl.json`, `lang/en.json`
- Test: `tests/Feature/Tenancy/HostScopeTest.php`

**Interfaces:**
- Consumes: `Tenant::check()`, `Tenant::current()`, `Tenant::bypass()` (facade `App\Tenancy\Facades\Tenant`; bypass allowed in `App\Tenancy`), `App\Models\User::isSuperAdmin()`.
- Produces:
  - `App\Tenancy\HostScope::read(Closure $callback): mixed` — static; `@template TReturn @param Closure(): TReturn $callback @return TReturn @throws AuthorizationException`. The closure must execute its queries itself (global scopes apply when a query runs).
  - `HostScope::organisationId(): ?int` — static; tenant bound → its id; no tenant and the `web` user is a super admin → `null`; otherwise `AuthorizationException`.
  - `HostScope::lockForWrite(Organisation $organisation): Organisation` — static; `LogicException` outside a transaction; `Organisation::withTrashed()->lockForUpdate()->findOrFail()`; bound tenant ≠ this organisation → `AuthorizationException`; trashed → `ValidationException` on `organisation` (`__('This organisation is archived.')`).
  - `App\Concerns\ResolvesCurrentUser::currentUser(): User` — `protected`; `@phpstan-require-extends Component`; `AuthenticationException` when signed out.
  - Test helpers (in `tests/Pest.php`): `pageSnapshot(string $url, string $component): array<string, mixed>`; `callPageAction(array $snapshot, string $method, array $params = [], array $updates = [], ?string $host = null): TestResponse` (`$params`: `list<mixed>`, `$updates`: `array<string, mixed>`, `$host`: a host name such as `Hosts::apex()`; `null` = the current URL origin).

The `LogicException` outside a transaction is not tested: `RefreshDatabase` wraps every test in a transaction, so `DB::transactionLevel()` is never 0 in a feature test.

In `tests/Arch/TenancyRulesTest.php`, replace the first test with this version (the pattern gains `newModelQuery\s*\(` and the aliased import; the loop proves every named form is recognised):

```php
it('bypasses or removes the tenant scope only in the allowed places', function (): void {
    // §6.2 / DEC-28 (8): Livewire pages never join this list; any-host pages read through App\Tenancy\HostScope::read().
    $allowed = [
        'app/Console/', 'app/Setup/', 'app/Tenancy/', 'app/Actions/Audit/', 'database/seeders/',
        'app/Http/Controllers/HealthCheckController.php',
    ];

    $candidates = array_values(array_filter(
        kitSourceFiles('app', 'routes', 'resources/views', 'database'),
        fn (string $path): bool => ! Str::startsWith($path, $allowed),
    ));

    // Removing TenantScope through Eloquent (by class, by name, by instance, through an aliased import, or by
    // building a query without global scopes) reads across organisations just like a bypass, and suspending or
    // resuming one changes the bypass state directly.
    $pattern = '/Tenant::bypass\s*\(|->bypass\s*\(|\b(suspend|resume)Bypass\s*\('
        .'|withoutGlobalScope\s*\(\s*(\\\\?[\w\\\\]*\\\\)?TenantScope::class'
        .'|withoutGlobalScope\s*\(\s*[\'"](\\\\?[\w\\\\]*\\\\)?TenantScope[\'"]'
        .'|withoutGlobalScope\s*\(\s*new\s+(\\\\?[\w\\\\]*\\\\)?TenantScope\b'
        .'|withoutGlobalScopes\s*\(|newQueryWithoutScopes\s*\(|newModelQuery\s*\('
        .'|use\s+\\\\?App\\\\Tenancy\\\\Scopes\\\\TenantScope\s+as\s/';

    // FU3-16: the rule recognises every form it names, so it can fail.
    $forms = [
        'Tenant::bypass(fn () => 1);',
        '$tenancy->bypass(fn () => 1);',
        '$tenancy->suspendBypass();',
        'User::withoutGlobalScope(TenantScope::class);',
        'User::withoutGlobalScope(\App\Tenancy\Scopes\TenantScope::class);',
        "User::withoutGlobalScope('TenantScope');",
        'User::withoutGlobalScope(new TenantScope);',
        'User::withoutGlobalScopes();',
        '(new User)->newQueryWithoutScopes();',
        '(new User)->newModelQuery();',
        'use App\Tenancy\Scopes\TenantScope as Scope;',
    ];

    foreach ($forms as $form) {
        expect(preg_match($pattern, $form))->toBe(1, "The bypass rule misses [{$form}].");
    }

    expect(filesMatching($candidates, $pattern))->toBe([]);
});
```

```php
/**
 * The snapshot of $component as the page at $url renders it for the signed-in user (generic form of the
 * M3 security-page helper). The URL decides the host.
 *
 * @return array<string, mixed>
 */
function pageSnapshot(string $url, string $component): array
{
    preg_match_all('/wire:snapshot="([^"]*)"/', (string) get($url)->assertOk()->getContent(), $matches);

    foreach ($matches[1] as $encoded) {
        /** @var array<string, mixed> $snapshot */
        $snapshot = json_decode(htmlspecialchars_decode($encoded, ENT_QUOTES), true, flags: JSON_THROW_ON_ERROR);

        if (($snapshot['memo']['name'] ?? null) === $component) {
            return $snapshot;
        }
    }

    throw new LogicException("The page [{$url}] renders no [{$component}] component.");
}

/**
 * Sends a Livewire update that calls $method on the snapshot's component, as a forged request would: with
 * client-chosen parameters and property updates, from the current origin or from $host.
 *
 * @param  array<string, mixed>  $snapshot
 * @param  list<mixed>  $params
 * @param  array<string, mixed>  $updates
 * @return TestResponse<Response>
 */
function callPageAction(array $snapshot, string $method, array $params = [], array $updates = [], ?string $host = null): TestResponse
{
    Livewire::flushState(); // a new request cycle, as in production: PersistentMiddleware remembers routes it already handled

    $uri = $host === null ? Livewire::getUpdateUri() : Hosts::url($host, Livewire::getUpdateUri());

    return postJson($uri, ['components' => [[
        'snapshot' => json_encode($snapshot, JSON_THROW_ON_ERROR),
        'updates' => $updates,
        'calls' => [['method' => $method, 'params' => $params, 'path' => '', 'metadata' => []]],
    ]]], ['X-Livewire' => '1']);
}
```

- [ ] **Step 3: `HostScope`**

`app/Tenancy/HostScope.php`:

```php
<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace App\Tenancy;

use App\Models\Organisation;
use App\Models\User;
use App\Tenancy\Facades\Tenant;
use Closure;
use Illuminate\Auth\Access\AuthorizationException;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Auth;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;
use Illuminate\Validation\ValidationException;
use LogicException;

/**
 * Reads and write locks for any-host pages and actions (§6.2, RL-8). On a tenant host tenant models stay
 * scoped to that organisation; on a central host only a super admin reads across organisations, inside
 * Tenant::bypass(). Pages never join the bypass allow-list: they read tenant models through read().
 *
 * Only tenant models are scoped. Central models (organisations, Spatie roles and pivots, sessions) are
 * filtered by the caller with organisationId(), and organisation ids sent by the client are ignored on a
 * tenant host (RK-I4).
 */
final class HostScope
{
    /**
     * Runs the callback with the host's tenant scope. The callback must run its queries itself: global
     * scopes apply when a query executes, so a builder returned from it would run outside the bypass.
     *
     * @template TReturn
     *
     * @param  Closure(): TReturn  $callback
     * @return TReturn
     *
     * @throws AuthorizationException
     */
    public static function read(Closure $callback): mixed
    {
        if (Tenant::check()) {
            return $callback();
        }

        self::ensureSuperAdmin();

        return Tenant::bypass($callback);
    }

    /**
     * The organisation whose central rows a page may show: the tenant on a tenant host, null (every
     * organisation) for a super admin on a central host.
     *
     * @throws AuthorizationException
     */
    public static function organisationId(): ?int
    {
        $organisation = Tenant::current();

        if ($organisation instanceof Organisation) {
            return $organisation->id;
        }

        self::ensureSuperAdmin();

        return null;
    }

    /**
     * Locks the organisation row inside the caller's transaction and returns the fresh row. Refuses another
     * tenant's organisation while a tenant is bound, then an archived one (RK-I11). Actions call it before
     * Tenant::run(): inside the run the bound tenant is always the organisation itself.
     *
     * @throws AuthorizationException
     * @throws ValidationException
     */
    public static function lockForWrite(Organisation $organisation): Organisation
    {
        if (DB::transactionLevel() === 0) {
            throw new LogicException('HostScope::lockForWrite() must run inside a database transaction.');
        }

        $locked = Organisation::withTrashed()->lockForUpdate()->findOrFail($organisation->id);
        $tenant = Tenant::current();

        if ($tenant instanceof Organisation && $tenant->id !== $locked->id) {
            throw new AuthorizationException;
        }

        if ($locked->trashed()) {
            throw ValidationException::withMessages([
                'organisation' => __('This organisation is archived.'),
            ]);
        }

        return $locked;
    }

    /** @throws AuthorizationException */
    private static function ensureSuperAdmin(): void
    {
        $user = Auth::guard('web')->user();

        if (! $user instanceof User || ! $user->isSuperAdmin()) {
            throw new AuthorizationException;
        }
    }
}
```

```php
<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace App\Concerns;

use App\Models\User;
use Illuminate\Auth\AuthenticationException;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Auth;
use Livewire\Component;

/**
 * The signed-in user of a Livewire component (DEC-25 (2)). Components keep no User property: Livewire
 * rehydrates public models without the tenant scope (§6.2), so every request reads the user again.
 *
 * @phpstan-require-extends Component
 */
trait ResolvesCurrentUser
{
    /** @throws AuthenticationException */
    protected function currentUser(): User
    {
        return Auth::user() ?? throw new AuthenticationException;
    }
}
```

### Task 8: Users index

**Covers:** USR-6, USR-7, USR-8 (modal), USR-10, USR-11 (archived view), USR-19, USR-20 (reads), TEN-2, TEN-3 (forged ids), TEN-4, DEC26-1, DEC26-8, DEC26-15, W2 (UI), X4, R-6, RL-8, RL-10 (`forbidden`), RL-11 (nav group), RL-16, RL-26 (row controls), C-26; OR-I5 (second half), CV-5, CV-20, RK-I4, RK-I6.

What this task delivers, spelled out:
- `pages::users.index` at `/users` (route `users.index`, any host, gated by `Permission::UsersView`). On a tenant host it lists that organisation's users; organisation admins and other non-super actors never see super admins, also not a promoted super admin who keeps an `organisation_id` (DEC-26 (12)). On a central host (super admins only) it lists every user, super admins included, with an organisation column ("Platform" for users without an organisation) and an organisation filter (R-6, C-26, USR-7).
- Search over name and email, case-insensitive on both databases with `whereLike(..., caseSensitive: false)` (USR-10); filters for status, role and (centrally) organisation; 25 per page; every filter lives in the URL (`#[Url]`) and a filter change goes back to page 1 (X4). Hostile query strings (`?status[]=x`) render the page, never a 500 (Livewire 4.4.7 ignores values that do not fit a typed property; the component also normalises every filter: `UserStatus::tryFrom`, numeric ids checked against the offered options).
- **No cross-organisation leaks on a tenant host (RK-I4):** `HostScope` scopes the users, but organisations and Spatie roles are central tables: role options come only from the tenant's team (plus the global `organisation_admin` template), the organisation filter and column do not exist there, and a client-sent `?organisation=` or `?role=` of another organisation is ignored.
- Team roles per row come from **one** `model_has_roles ⨝ roles` query for the page, matched to each user's own team in PHP (Spatie's `roles` relation filters on the current team, which is null on central hosts, X1/R-6). Row controls come from **one** batch evaluation, `UserAbilities::forPage()` (Task 4), which applies the same rules as `UserPolicy`, including the permission-subset rule: a non-super actor only acts on users whose effective permissions they hold themselves (RL-26). Nothing lazy-loads (RK-I6; strict Eloquent is on in tests).
- A delete control with a confirmation modal (USR-8) calls `DeleteUser` (Task 6); there is no delete control on your own row (W2) or on a pending user (CV-20: cancel the invitation instead; Task 13 links pending rows to the pending invitations list). An "Archived" view (`flux:radio.group variant="segmented"`, free Flux) lists soft-deleted users with a restore control that calls `RestoreUser` (Task 6); it leaves out soft-deleted *pending* users, which are cancelled invitations (C-9). Every action re-resolves the user through `HostScope::read()` and re-authorises; forged ids of another organisation answer 404 (CV-5).
- The interim navigation (RL-11): a permission-gated "Administration" (nl "Beheer") group in the sidebar with "Users"; later tasks add their links.
- The route × host matrix gets the `forbidden` outcome: the matrix's role-less member answers 403 on permission-gated pages on its own tenant host.

- Create: `resources/views/pages/users/index/index.php`, `resources/views/pages/users/index/index.blade.php`
- Modify: `routes/admin.php`, `resources/views/layouts/app/sidebar.blade.php`, `tests/Feature/Tenancy/RouteHostMatrixTest.php`, `lang/nl.json`, `lang/en.json`
- Test: `tests/Feature/Users/UsersIndexTest.php`, `tests/Feature/Navigation/AdministrationLinksTest.php`

**Interfaces:**
- Consumes: `App\Actions\Users\DeleteUser::handle(User $actor, User $target): void`, `App\Actions\Users\RestoreUser::handle(User $actor, User $target): void` (Task 6), `UserPolicy::{viewAny,delete,restore}`, `App\Authorization\UserAbilities::forPage(User $actor, Collection<int, User> $users): array<int, array{view: bool, update: bool, updateStatus: bool, delete: bool, restore: bool}>` (Task 4; called on a container instance, `app(UserAbilities::class)->forPage(...)`, with an `Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Collection`), `HostScope::{read,organisationId}` and `ResolvesCurrentUser` (Task 7), `UserStatus::{label,color}` (`color()` from Task 6), `Role::label()`, `SyncPermissions::GUARD`, `pageSnapshot()` / `callPageAction()` (Task 7).

```php
        ->assertDontSee('Beta Secret Ltd')
        ->assertDontSee('beta-secret-role');
});

it('deletes a member after the confirmation modal', function (): void {
    $organisation = Organisation::factory()->create();
    $member = User::factory()->for($organisation)->create(['name' => 'Mila Member']);
    asOrgAdmin($organisation);

    Livewire::test('pages::users.index')
        ->call('confirmDelete', $member->id)
        ->assertSet('showDeleteModal', true)
        ->assertSet('deletingUserId', $member->id)
        ->assertSee(__(':name can no longer sign in. You can restore the account from the archived view.', ['name' => 'Mila Member']))
        ->call('delete')
        ->assertHasNoErrors()
        ->assertSet('showDeleteModal', false)

it('renders no delete control on your own row and refuses a forged delete of yourself (W2)', function (): void {
    $organisation = Organisation::factory()->create();
    $member = User::factory()->for($organisation)->create();
    $admin = asOrgAdmin($organisation);

    $this->get(route('users.index'))
        ->assertOk()
        ->assertSee("confirmDelete({$member->id})", false)
        ->assertDontSee("confirmDelete({$admin->id})", false);

    Livewire::test('pages::users.index')
        ->call('confirmDelete', $admin->id)
        ->assertForbidden();

    expect($admin->fresh()?->trashed())->toBeFalse();
});

it('refuses a forged delete or restore of another organisation\'s user from a tenant host (CV-5)', function (): void {
    $acme = Organisation::factory()->create();
    $beta = Organisation::factory()->create();
    $stranger = User::factory()->for($beta)->create();
    $formerStranger = User::factory()->for($beta)->create();
    $formerStranger->delete();
    asOrgAdmin($acme);
    $snapshot = pageSnapshot(route('users.index'), 'pages::users.index');

    callPageAction($snapshot, 'confirmDelete', [$stranger->id])->assertNotFound();
    callPageAction($snapshot, 'restore', [$formerStranger->id])->assertNotFound();

    expect(DB::table('users')->where('id', $stranger->id)->value('deleted_at'))->toBeNull()
        ->and(DB::table('users')->where('id', $formerStranger->id)->value('deleted_at'))->not->toBeNull();
});

it('hides controls for users whose permissions the actor lacks (RL-26)', function () use ($teamRoleWith): void {
    $organisation = Organisation::factory()->create();
    $admin = User::factory()->for($organisation)->create();
    withPermissionsTeam($organisation->id, fn (): User => $admin->assignRole(Role::OrganisationAdmin->value));
    $member = User::factory()->for($organisation)->create();
    $helpdesk = $teamRoleWith($organisation, Permission::UsersView, Permission::UsersDelete);
    $actor = asMember($organisation);
    withPermissionsTeam($organisation->id, fn (): User => $actor->assignRole($helpdesk));
    $actor->unsetRelation('roles');

    $this->get(route('users.index'))
        ->assertOk()
        ->assertSee("confirmDelete({$member->id})", false)
        ->assertDontSee("confirmDelete({$admin->id})", false);

    Livewire::test('pages::users.index')
        ->call('confirmDelete', $admin->id)
        ->assertForbidden();
});

it('renders no delete control for a pending user (CV-20)', function (): void {
    $organisation = Organisation::factory()->create();
    $pending = User::factory()->for($organisation)->pending()->create(['name' => 'Piet Pending']);
    asOrgAdmin($organisation);

    $this->get(route('users.index'))
        ->assertOk()
        ->assertSee('Piet Pending')
        ->assertDontSee("confirmDelete({$pending->id})", false);
});

it('renders a page of users without lazy-loading violations (RK-I6)', function (string $actor): void {
    $organisation = Organisation::factory()->create();
    $editor = RoleModel::query()->create(['name' => 'editor', 'guard_name' => 'web', 'team_id' => $organisation->id]);
    $addUsers = function (int $count) use ($organisation, $editor): void {
        foreach (User::factory()->count($count)->for($organisation)->create() as $user) {
            withPermissionsTeam($organisation->id, fn (): User => $user->assignRole($editor));
        }
    };
    $queriesForOneRender = function (): int {
        DB::flushQueryLog();
        DB::enableQueryLog();
        Livewire::test('pages::users.index')->assertOk();
        DB::disableQueryLog();

        return count(DB::getQueryLog());
    };
    $addUsers(3);

    if ($actor === 'super admin') {
        asSuperAdmin();
        onAdminHost();
    } else {
        asOrgAdmin($organisation);
    }

    Livewire::test('pages::users.index')->assertOk(); // warms the permission cache
    $fewUsers = $queriesForOneRender();
    $addUsers(10);

    expect($queriesForOneRender())->toBe($fewUsers);
})->with(['organisation admin', 'super admin']);

it('lists archived users with restore and leaves out cancelled invitations\' users (C-9)', function (): void {
    $organisation = Organisation::factory()->create();
    $former = User::factory()->for($organisation)->create(['name' => 'Fien Former']);
    $former->delete();
    $cancelled = User::factory()->for($organisation)->pending()->create(['name' => 'Cees Cancelled']);
    $cancelled->delete();
    asOrgAdmin($organisation);

    Livewire::withQueryParams(['view' => 'archived'])
        ->test('pages::users.index')
        ->assertSee('Fien Former')
        ->assertDontSee('Cees Cancelled')
        ->assertSeeHtml("restore({$former->id})")
        ->call('restore', $former->id)
        ->assertHasNoErrors()
        ->assertDispatched('toast-show');

    expect($former->fresh()?->trashed())->toBeFalse();
});

    asMember(Organisation::factory()->create());

    $this->get(route('users.index'))->assertForbidden();
});
```

`resources/views/pages/users/index/index.php`:

```php
<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

use App\Actions\Users\DeleteUser;
use App\Actions\Users\RestoreUser;
use App\Authorization\Role;
use App\Authorization\SyncPermissions;
use App\Authorization\UserAbilities;
use App\Concerns\ResolvesCurrentUser;
use App\Enums\UserStatus;
use App\Models\Organisation;
use App\Models\User;
use App\Tenancy\Facades\Tenant;
use App\Tenancy\HostScope;
use Flux\Flux;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Builder;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Collection as EloquentCollection;
use Illuminate\Database\Query\Builder as QueryBuilder;
use Illuminate\Pagination\LengthAwarePaginator;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;
use Livewire\Attributes\Computed;
use Livewire\Attributes\Locked;
use Livewire\Attributes\Title;
use Livewire\Attributes\Url;
use Livewire\Component;
use Livewire\WithPagination;
use Spatie\Permission\Models\Role as RoleModel;

new #[Title('Users')] class extends Component
{
    use ResolvesCurrentUser;
    use WithPagination;

    #[Url]
    public string $search = '';

    #[Url]
    public string $status = '';

    #[Url]
    public string $role = '';

    /** Central hosts only; ignored on a tenant host (RK-I4). */
    #[Url]
    public string $organisation = '';

    #[Url]
    public string $view = 'active';

    public bool $showDeleteModal = false;

    #[Locked]
    public ?int $deletingUserId = null;

    #[Locked]
    public string $deletingUserName = '';

    /**
     * The current page, read once per request; private properties are never dehydrated.
     *
     * @var LengthAwarePaginator<int, User>|null
     */
    private ?LengthAwarePaginator $usersPage = null;

    /**
     * Mount the component.
     */
    public function mount(): void
    {
        $this->authorize('viewAny', User::class);
    }

    /**
     * A changed filter starts again on the first page (X4); another organisation has other roles.
     */
    public function updated(string $property): void
    {
        if ($property === 'organisation') {
            $this->role = '';
        }

        if (in_array($property, ['search', 'status', 'role', 'organisation', 'view'], true)) {
            $this->resetPage();
        }
    }

    /**
     * Show the delete confirmation modal.
     */
    public function confirmDelete(int $userId): void
    {
        $target = $this->findUser($userId);
        $this->authorize('delete', $target);

        $this->deletingUserId = $target->id;
        $this->deletingUserName = $target->name;
        $this->showDeleteModal = true;
    }

    /**
     * Delete the user from the modal; DeleteUser keeps the lock-out guards (W2, W12).
     */
    public function delete(DeleteUser $deleteUser): void
    {
        if ($this->deletingUserId === null) {
            return;
        }

        $target = $this->findUser($this->deletingUserId);
        $this->authorize('delete', $target);

        try {
            $deleteUser->handle($this->currentUser(), $target);
        } finally {
            $this->closeDeleteModal();
        }

        Flux::toast(variant: 'success', text: __(':name was deleted.', ['name' => $target->name]));
    }

    /**
     * Restore a deleted user from the archived view; RestoreUser refuses taken addresses and archived organisations.
     */
    public function restore(int $userId, RestoreUser $restoreUser): void
    {
        $target = $this->findUser($userId, trashed: true);
        $this->authorize('restore', $target);

        $restoreUser->handle($this->currentUser(), $target);

        Flux::toast(variant: 'success', text: __(':name was restored.', ['name' => $target->name]));
    }

    /**
     * Close the delete confirmation modal.
     */
    public function closeDeleteModal(): void
    {
        $this->showDeleteModal = false;
        $this->deletingUserId = null;
        $this->deletingUserName = '';
    }

    /**
     * The page of users for the current filters, read through the host scope (RL-8).
     *
     * @return LengthAwarePaginator<int, User>
     */
    #[Computed]
    public function users(): LengthAwarePaginator
    {
        if ($this->usersPage instanceof LengthAwarePaginator) {
            return $this->usersPage;
        }

        $search = trim($this->search);
        $status = UserStatus::tryFrom($this->status);
        $roleId = $this->pickedRoleId();
        $organisationId = $this->pickedOrganisationId();
        $archived = $this->view === 'archived';

        /** @var LengthAwarePaginator<int, User> $users */
        $users = HostScope::read(function () use ($search, $status, $roleId, $organisationId, $archived): LengthAwarePaginator {
            $query = $this->visibleUsers();

            if ($archived) {
                // Cancelled invitations leave soft-deleted pending users behind; they are not users to restore (C-9).
                $query->onlyTrashed()->where('status', '!=', UserStatus::PendingActivation->value);
            }

            if ($organisationId !== null) {
                $query->where('organisation_id', $organisationId);
            }

            if ($search !== '') {
                $query->where(function (Builder $inner) use ($search): void {
                    $inner->whereLike('name', "%{$search}%", caseSensitive: false)
                        ->orWhereLike('email', "%{$search}%", caseSensitive: false);
                });
            }

            if ($status instanceof UserStatus) {
                $query->where('status', $status->value);
            }

            if ($roleId !== null) {
                // The role must be held in the user's own team (the template role is global, its assignment is not).
                $query->whereExists(function (QueryBuilder $assignment) use ($roleId): void {
                    $assignment->selectRaw('1')
                        ->from('model_has_roles')
                        ->whereColumn('model_has_roles.model_id', 'users.id')
                        ->whereColumn('model_has_roles.team_id', 'users.organisation_id')
                        ->where('model_has_roles.model_type', (new User)->getMorphClass())
                        ->where('model_has_roles.role_id', $roleId);
                });
            }

            return $query->orderBy('name')->orderBy('id')->paginate(25);
        });

        return $this->usersPage = $users;
    }

    /**
     * Role labels per user, from one pivot query for the page, each read in the user's own team (R-6, X1).
     *
     * @return array<int, list<string>>
     */
    #[Computed]
    public function rolesByUser(): array
    {
        $teams = [];

        foreach ($this->pageUsers()->items() as $user) {
            if ($user->organisation_id !== null) {
                $teams[$user->id] = $user->organisation_id;
            }
        }

        if ($teams === []) {
            return [];
        }

        $rows = DB::table('model_has_roles')
            ->join('roles', 'roles.id', '=', 'model_has_roles.role_id')
            ->where('model_has_roles.model_type', (new User)->getMorphClass())
            ->whereIn('model_has_roles.model_id', array_keys($teams))
            ->orderBy('roles.name')
            ->get(['model_has_roles.model_id', 'model_has_roles.team_id', 'roles.name']);

        $roles = [];

        foreach ($rows as $row) {
            $userId = (int) $row->model_id;

            if ($row->team_id === null || (int) $row->team_id !== ($teams[$userId] ?? null)) {
                continue;
            }

            $name = (string) $row->name;
            $roles[$userId][] = Role::tryFrom($name)?->label() ?? $name;
        }

        return $roles;
    }

    /**
     * The controls each row may show, from one batch evaluation of the policy rules (RL-26, RK-I6).
     *
     * @return array<int, array{view: bool, update: bool, updateStatus: bool, delete: bool, restore: bool}>
     */
    #[Computed]
    public function rowAbilities(): array
    {
        $users = new EloquentCollection($this->pageUsers()->items());
        $actor = $this->currentUser();

        /** @var array<int, array{view: bool, update: bool, updateStatus: bool, delete: bool, restore: bool}> $abilities */
        $abilities = HostScope::read(fn (): array => app(UserAbilities::class)->forPage($actor, $users));

        return $abilities;
    }

    /**
     * The organisation_admin template, then the roles of the shown team: the tenant on a tenant host, the
     * picked organisation centrally (RK-I4).
     *
     * @return array<int, string>
     */
    #[Computed]
    public function roleOptions(): array
    {
        $teamId = $this->pickedOrganisationId();

        return RoleModel::query()
            ->where('guard_name', SyncPermissions::GUARD)
            ->where(function (Builder $query) use ($teamId): void {
                $query->where(function (Builder $template): void {
                    $template->whereNull('team_id')->where('name', Role::OrganisationAdmin->value);
                });

                if ($teamId !== null) {
                    $query->orWhere('team_id', $teamId);
                }
            })
            ->get()
            ->sortBy(fn (RoleModel $role): string => ($role->getAttribute('team_id') === null ? '0 ' : '1 ').$role->name)
            ->mapWithKeys(fn (RoleModel $role): array => [(int) $role->getKey() => Role::tryFrom($role->name)?->label() ?? $role->name])
            ->all();
    }

    /**
     * Every organisation for the filter on central hosts; nothing on a tenant host.
     *
     * @return array<int, string>
     */
    #[Computed]
    public function organisationOptions(): array
    {
        if (HostScope::organisationId() !== null) {
            return [];
        }

        return Organisation::query()
            ->orderBy('name')
            ->get(['id', 'name'])
            ->mapWithKeys(fn (Organisation $organisation): array => [$organisation->id => $organisation->name])
            ->all();
    }

    /**
     * Names of the page's organisations for the central organisation column, archived ones included.
     *
     * @return array<int, string>
     */
    #[Computed]
    public function organisationNames(): array
    {
        if (HostScope::organisationId() !== null) {
            return [];
        }

        $ids = [];

        foreach ($this->pageUsers()->items() as $user) {
            if ($user->organisation_id !== null) {
                $ids[$user->organisation_id] = $user->organisation_id;
            }
        }

        return Organisation::withTrashed()
            ->whereKey(array_values($ids))
            ->get(['id', 'name'])
            ->mapWithKeys(fn (Organisation $organisation): array => [$organisation->id => $organisation->name])
            ->all();
    }

    /**
     * Whether the page runs on a central host (organisation column and filter).
     */
    #[Computed]
    public function central(): bool
    {
        return ! Tenant::check();
    }

    /**
     * Users the actor may see: everyone in the host scope, minus super admins for non-super actors (DEC-26 (12)).
     *
     * @return Builder<User>
     */
    private function visibleUsers(): Builder
    {
        $query = User::query();

        if (! $this->currentUser()->isSuperAdmin()) {
            $query->where('is_super_admin', false);
        }

        return $query;
    }

    /**
     * Re-resolves a user for an action through the host scope; another organisation's id answers 404 (CV-5).
     */
    private function findUser(int $userId, bool $trashed = false): User
    {
        return HostScope::read(function () use ($userId, $trashed): User {
            $query = $this->visibleUsers();

            if ($trashed) {
                $query->onlyTrashed();
            }

            return $query->findOrFail($userId);
        });
    }

    /**
     * The organisation filter: always the tenant on a tenant host; centrally only a listed organisation (RK-I4).
     */
    private function pickedOrganisationId(): ?int
    {
        $tenantId = HostScope::organisationId();

        if ($tenantId !== null) {
            return $tenantId;
        }

        $picked = ctype_digit($this->organisation) ? (int) $this->organisation : null;

        $options = $this->organisationOptions();

        return $picked !== null && array_key_exists($picked, $options) ? $picked : null;
    }

    /**
     * The role filter: only a role the page offers.
     */
    private function pickedRoleId(): ?int
    {
        $picked = ctype_digit($this->role) ? (int) $this->role : null;

        $options = $this->roleOptions();

        return $picked !== null && array_key_exists($picked, $options) ? $picked : null;
    }

    /**
     * The current page, memoised in $usersPage so the paginate query runs once per request. PHP code calls the
     * methods, never the magic computed properties (Larastan level 8 has no Livewire computed support).
     *
     * @return LengthAwarePaginator<int, User>
     */
    private function pageUsers(): LengthAwarePaginator
    {
        return $this->users();
    }
};
```

```blade
                        @elseif ($abilities['delete'] && $user->status !== \App\Enums\UserStatus::PendingActivation)
                            <flux:button size="sm" variant="ghost" icon="trash" wire:click="confirmDelete({{ $user->id }})" :aria-label="__('Delete :name', ['name' => $user->name])" data-test="delete-user-button" />
                        @endif
                    </flux:table.cell>
                </flux:table.row>
            @empty
                <flux:table.row>
                    <flux:table.cell :colspan="$this->central ? 5 : 4">{{ __('No users found.') }}</flux:table.cell>
                </flux:table.row>
            @endforelse
        </flux:table.rows>
    </flux:table>

    <flux:modal name="delete-user-modal" class="max-w-md md:min-w-md" @close="closeDeleteModal" wire:model="showDeleteModal">
        <div class="space-y-6">
            <div class="space-y-2">
                <flux:heading size="lg">{{ __('Delete user') }}</flux:heading>
                <flux:text>{{ __(':name can no longer sign in. You can restore the account from the archived view.', ['name' => $deletingUserName]) }}</flux:text>
            </div>

            <div class="flex justify-end gap-3">
                <flux:button variant="outline" wire:click="closeDeleteModal">{{ __('Cancel') }}</flux:button>
                <flux:button variant="danger" wire:click="delete" data-test="confirm-delete-user-button">{{ __('Delete user') }}</flux:button>
            </div>
        </div>
    </flux:modal>
</section>
```

### Task 9: Users edit page (doubles as show page)

**Covers:** USR-5 (UI), USR-12 (page), USR-13 (UI), USR-19, USR-20, AUTHZ-1 (UI caller), ROLE-14 (UI caller), DEC26-8, DEC26-17, DEC27-4, W1 (Livewire level), W4 (status select), W12 (UI), X1, R-6, R-7, RL-10, RL-16, RL-18, C-18, C-25, E1 (UI); RK-M8, RK-I9, CV-1, RK-D4.

What this task delivers, spelled out:
- `pages::users.edit` at `/users/{user}/edit` (route `users.edit`, any host, `whereNumber('user')`, gated by `Permission::UsersView` because the page doubles as the show page). `mount(int $user)` takes the id, not a model: Livewire's implicit binding would read `User` through `TenantScope`, which throws on central hosts, and public model properties rehydrate without any scope (R-7). The component keeps only a `#[Locked]` id and re-reads the user through `HostScope::read()` on every request, so another organisation's user answers 404 on a tenant host while a super admin on the admin host finds every user (USR-20, DEC-26 (8)); `UserPolicy::view` then answers 403 for an organisation admin looking at a super admin.
- Sections, each with its own save and its own action (partial saves across sections are by design):
  - **Account** (`users.update`): name, address and status through `UpdateUser` (Task 5) and `UpdateUserStatus` (Task 6). On your own account the address is read-only with a link to the profile page, and the page never sends a changed address (E1 stays closed: your own address changes only through the signed self-service link, CV-1). A pending user's address and status are read-only (only accepting the invitation activates; a new address means cancel and re-invite). The status select offers only Active and Disabled: `pending_activation` is never settable (W4, USR-13). Changing **another** user's address first asks for a fresh password confirmation and returns to this page; the unsaved name, address and status are parked in the session and restored after the confirmation, with a notice (RL-18, RK-D4).
  - **Roles** (`roles.assign`): a free `flux:checkbox.group` of the organisation_admin template and the target team's roles; `saveRoles()` is the only public method that writes roles and always goes through `UpdateUserRoles`, which rejects the super_admin badge, another team's role and roles whose permissions the actor lacks (W1). The current roles are read with an explicit query in the target's team, so a super admin on the admin host sees them ticked and saving the name never strips them (X1). No role or status controls on your own account (W12). A **pending** user's roles are read-only, with the callout "Cancel the invitation and invite again with the new roles.": the invitation's accept link is a bearer credential that never rotates (RK-B3; a reminder keeps the token), so widening a pending user's roles after the link was shown to a less privileged user would widen what that link grants at accept time. `saveRoles()` refuses a forged change on a pending user with a `roles` validation error.
  - **Super admin** (super admins on other active or disabled users only): a switch saved through the new `App\Actions\Users\UpdateSuperAdmin`, which authorises `updateSuperAdmin` before calling `SetSuperAdmin` (RK-M8: every action authorises itself; console and seeders keep calling `SetSuperAdmin`) and refuses a pending target with an `is_super_admin` validation error, for the same accept-link reason. A fresh password confirmation comes first (RL-18).
- Accepted residual (like X13): widening a role's permissions in the role editor still widens the outstanding invite links of pending users who hold that role. Only the per-user role and super-admin changes are closed here.
- `App\Concerns\ConfirmsPasswords::passwordConfirmationRequired()` gains an optional, server-built return URL (default the security page; the Referer of a Livewire update is client input).
- Viewers without `users.update` see the user read-only. The index links each row the actor may view to this page.
- The route × host matrix covers `users.edit` through `matrixParameters()`, which supplies a member of the test organisation created before the host switch (RL-10).

**Files:**
- Create: `resources/views/pages/users/edit/edit.php`, `resources/views/pages/users/edit/edit.blade.php`, `app/Actions/Users/UpdateSuperAdmin.php`
- Modify: `routes/admin.php`, `app/Concerns/ConfirmsPasswords.php`, `resources/views/pages/users/index/index.blade.php`, `tests/Feature/Tenancy/RouteHostMatrixTest.php`, `lang/nl.json`, `lang/en.json`
- Test: `tests/Feature/Users/UsersEditTest.php`

**Interfaces:**
- Consumes: `HostScope::read()`, `ResolvesCurrentUser`, `pageSnapshot()` / `callPageAction()` (Task 7); `UserStatus::PendingActivation`; `App\Actions\Users\UpdateUser::handle(User $actor, User $target, string $name, string $email): void` (Task 5; refuses an address change of your own account or of a pending user, notifies the old address with `App\Notifications\EmailChangedByAdministrator` after commit); `App\Concerns\ProfileValidationRules::emailRules(?int $userId = null, ?int $organisationId = null)` and `nameRules()` (Task 5); `App\Actions\Users\UpdateUserStatus::handle(User $actor, User $target, UserStatus $status): void` (Task 6); `App\Actions\Users\UpdateUserRoles::handle(User $actor, User $target, array $roleIds): void`; `App\Authorization\SetSuperAdmin::handle(User $user, bool $isSuperAdmin): void`; `UserPolicy::{view,update,updateStatus,updateRoles,updateSuperAdmin}`; `UserStatus::color()` (Task 6); `SyncPermissions::GUARD`; lang keys `Change your own address on your profile page.` and `Cancel the invitation and invite the new address.` (added in Task 5).
- Produces:
  - `ConfirmsPasswords::passwordConfirmationRequired(?string $returnTo = null): bool` — `protected`; `$returnTo` defaults to `route('security.edit')` and is always built server-side.
  - `App\Actions\Users\UpdateSuperAdmin::handle(User $actor, User $target, bool $isSuperAdmin): void` — `@throws AuthorizationException|ValidationException`; `Gate::forUser($actor)->authorize('updateSuperAdmin', $target)`, then a pending target throws `ValidationException` on `is_super_admin` ("Cancel the invitation and invite again with the new roles."), then `SetSuperAdmin::handle()` (which logs).
  - Page `pages::users.edit`: `mount(int $user): void`; `#[Locked] public int $userId`; `public string $name = ''`, `public string $email = ''`, `public string $status = ''`, `/** @var list<string> */ public array $roles = []` (role ids as the checkboxes send them), `public bool $isSuperAdmin = false`, `#[Locked] public bool $draftRestored = false`; `saveAccount(UpdateUser $updateUser, UpdateUserStatus $updateUserStatus): void`; `saveRoles(UpdateUserRoles $updateUserRoles): void`; `saveSuperAdmin(UpdateSuperAdmin $updateSuperAdmin): void`; `#[Computed] target(): User` (`HostScope::read(fn () => User::query()->findOrFail($this->userId))` + `authorize('view')`, memoised per request in `private ?User $resolvedTarget`, cleared by a save before it reads back); `#[Computed] roleOptions(): array<int, string>`; `#[Computed] abilities(): array{update: bool, updateStatus: bool, updateRoles: bool, updateSuperAdmin: bool, ownAccount: bool, pending: bool}` (`updateRoles` and `updateSuperAdmin` are false for a pending target). No other public method writes roles. PHP code in the component calls `$this->target()` / `$this->roleOptions()`, never the magic computed properties (Larastan level 8 reports `property.notFound` on them); Blade reads `$this->target`, `$this->roleOptions` and `$this->abilities`.
  - Route `Route::livewire('users/{user}/edit', 'pages::users.edit')->whereNumber('user')->can(Permission::UsersView)->name('users.edit')`.
  - Matrix: `matrixParameters(string $route, Organisation $organisation): array<string, int>` (`users.edit` → a member of `$organisation`; `organisations.edit` is added in Task 18).

```php
/** A member of $organisation holding one team role with exactly these permissions. */
$memberWith = function (Organisation $organisation, Permission ...$permissions): User {
    $role = RoleModel::query()->create(['name' => 'custom-'.Str::lower(Str::random(6)), 'guard_name' => 'web', 'team_id' => $organisation->id]);
    $role->givePermissionTo(array_map(fn (Permission $permission): string => $permission->value, $permissions));
    $user = User::factory()->for($organisation)->create();

    ->where('team_id', $user->organisation_id)
    ->orderBy('role_id')
    ->pluck('role_id')
    ->map(fn (mixed $id): int => (int) $id)
    ->all();

    Notification::fake();

        ->assertOk()
        ->assertJsonPath('components.0.effects.redirect', route('password.confirm'));

        ->and($member->fresh()?->status)->toBe(UserStatus::Active);

    $restored = pageSnapshot($page, 'pages::users.edit');

        ->and($restored['data']['email'] ?? null)->toBe('new@acme.test')

it('exposes no public method that writes roles besides saveRoles (W1)', function (): void {
    $organisation = Organisation::factory()->create();

    $class = new ReflectionClass(Livewire::test('pages::users.edit', ['user' => $member->id])->instance());

    $declared = collect($class->getMethods(ReflectionMethod::IS_PUBLIC))
        ->filter(fn (ReflectionMethod $method): bool => $method->getDeclaringClass()->getName() === $class->getName())
        ->map(fn (ReflectionMethod $method): string => $method->getName())
        ->sort()
        ->values()
        ->all();

    $roleWriters = collect($class->getMethods())
        ->filter(fn (ReflectionMethod $method): bool => collect($method->getParameters())->contains(
            fn (ReflectionParameter $parameter): bool => $parameter->getType() instanceof ReflectionNamedType
                && $parameter->getType()->getName() === UpdateUserRoles::class,
        ))
        ->map(fn (ReflectionMethod $method): string => $method->getName())
        ->values()
        ->all();

    expect($declared)->toBe(['abilities', 'mount', 'roleOptions', 'saveAccount', 'saveRoles', 'saveSuperAdmin', 'target'])
        ->and($roleWriters)->toBe(['saveRoles']);
});

it('keeps a pending user\'s roles and super admin flag as invited and refuses forged changes (RK-B3)', function () use ($templateId, $roleIdsOf): void {
    $organisation = Organisation::factory()->create();
    $viewer = RoleModel::query()->create(['name' => 'viewer', 'guard_name' => 'web', 'team_id' => $organisation->id]);
    $pending = User::factory()->for($organisation)->pending()->create();
    withPermissionsTeam($organisation->id, fn (): User => $pending->assignRole($viewer));
    asOrgAdmin($organisation);

    $this->get(route('users.edit', ['user' => $pending->id]))
        ->assertOk()
        ->assertSee(__('Cancel the invitation and invite again with the new roles.'))
        ->assertDontSee('wire:submit="saveRoles"', false);

    Livewire::test('pages::users.edit', ['user' => $pending->id])
        ->set('roles', [(string) $templateId()])
        ->call('saveRoles')
        ->assertHasErrors(['roles']);

    expect($roleIdsOf($pending))->toBe([(int) $viewer->id]);

    // No fresh confirmation in the session: the refusal comes before the password round trip (assertNoRedirect).
    $superAdmin = asSuperAdmin();
    onAdminHost();

    $this->get(route('users.edit', ['user' => $pending->id]))
        ->assertOk()
        ->assertDontSee('wire:submit="saveSuperAdmin"', false);

    Livewire::test('pages::users.edit', ['user' => $pending->id])
        ->set('isSuperAdmin', true)
        ->call('saveSuperAdmin')
        ->assertHasErrors(['is_super_admin'])
        ->assertNoRedirect();

    expect(fn () => app(UpdateSuperAdmin::class)->handle($superAdmin, $pending, true))->toThrow(ValidationException::class);

    expect($pending->fresh()?->isSuperAdmin())->toBeFalse()
        ->and($roleIdsOf($pending))->toBe([(int) $viewer->id]);
});

it('keeps an organisation admin\'s roles when a super admin renames them on the admin host, with the checkboxes ticked (X1)', function () use ($templateId, $roleIdsOf): void {
    $organisation = Organisation::factory()->create();
    $orgAdmin = User::factory()->for($organisation)->create(['name' => 'Olga Admin']);
    withPermissionsTeam($organisation->id, fn (): User => $orgAdmin->assignRole(Role::OrganisationAdmin->value));
    asSuperAdmin();
    onAdminHost();

    Livewire::test('pages::users.edit', ['user' => $orgAdmin->id])
        ->assertSet('roles', [(string) $templateId()])
        ->set('name', 'Olga de Admin')
        ->call('saveAccount')
        ->assertHasNoErrors();

    expect($orgAdmin->fresh()?->name)->toBe('Olga de Admin')
        ->and($roleIdsOf($orgAdmin))->toBe([$templateId()]);
});

it('asks for a fresh password confirmation before switching super admin and comes back to this page (RL-18)', function (): void {
    $organisation = Organisation::factory()->create();
    $member = User::factory()->for($organisation)->create();
    asSuperAdmin();
    onAdminHost();
    $page = route('users.edit', ['user' => $member->id]);
    $snapshot = pageSnapshot($page, 'pages::users.edit');

    callPageAction($snapshot, 'saveSuperAdmin', updates: ['isSuperAdmin' => true])
        ->assertOk()
        ->assertJsonPath('components.0.effects.redirect', route('password.confirm'));

    expect($member->fresh()?->isSuperAdmin())->toBeFalse();

    $this->post(route('password.confirm.store'), ['password' => 'password'])->assertRedirect($page);
    callPageAction($snapshot, 'saveSuperAdmin', updates: ['isSuperAdmin' => true])->assertOk();

    expect($member->fresh()?->isSuperAdmin())->toBeTrue();
});

it('switches super admin only through UpdateSuperAdmin (RK-M8)', function (): void {
    $organisation = Organisation::factory()->create();
    $member = User::factory()->for($organisation)->create();
    $orgAdmin = asOrgAdmin($organisation);

    expect(fn () => app(UpdateSuperAdmin::class)->handle($orgAdmin, $member, true))->toThrow(AuthorizationException::class);

    Livewire::test('pages::users.edit', ['user' => $member->id])
        ->set('isSuperAdmin', true)
        ->call('saveSuperAdmin')
        ->assertForbidden();

    $superAdmin = asSuperAdmin();

    expect(fn () => app(UpdateSuperAdmin::class)->handle($superAdmin, $superAdmin, false))->toThrow(AuthorizationException::class);

    app(UpdateSuperAdmin::class)->handle($superAdmin, $member, true);

    expect($member->fresh()?->isSuperAdmin())->toBeTrue()
        ->and(filesMatching(kitSourceFiles('resources/views', 'routes'), '/\bSetSuperAdmin\b/'))->toBe([]);
});

it('answers 404 for another organisation\'s user on a tenant host and finds any user for a super admin on the admin host (USR-20)', function (): void {
    $acme = Organisation::factory()->create();
    $stranger = User::factory()->for(Organisation::factory())->create();
    $promoted = User::factory()->for($acme)->create();
    app(SetSuperAdmin::class)->handle($promoted, true);

    $this->get(route('users.edit', ['user' => $stranger->id]))->assertOk()->assertSee($stranger->name);
    $this->get(route('users.edit', ['user' => $operator->id]))->assertOk()->assertSee($operator->name);
});
```

`app/Concerns/ConfirmsPasswords.php` — replace the method:

```php
    /**
     * Send the user to the password confirmation screen when their last confirmation is older than
     * `auth.password_timeout`, and back to $returnTo (the security page by default) afterwards. True means
     * the action must stop. Callers build $returnTo themselves: the Referer of a Livewire update is client input.
     */
    protected function passwordConfirmationRequired(?string $returnTo = null): bool
    {
        $confirmedAt = (int) session('auth.password_confirmed_at', 0);

        if (time() - $confirmedAt <= (int) config('auth.password_timeout')) {
            return false;
        }

        redirect()->setIntendedUrl($returnTo ?? route('security.edit'));
        $this->redirectRoute('password.confirm');

        return true;
    }
```

- [ ] **Step 4: `UpdateSuperAdmin`**

`app/Actions/Users/UpdateSuperAdmin.php`:

```php
<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace App\Actions\Users;

use App\Authorization\SetSuperAdmin;
use App\Enums\UserStatus;
use App\Models\User;
use Illuminate\Auth\Access\AuthorizationException;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Gate;
use Illuminate\Validation\ValidationException;

/**
 * The super-admin switch for people (§6.3, RK-M8): only another super admin changes the flag
 * (updateSuperAdmin, always checked), and never on a pending user, whose accept link would then grant it
 * (RK-B3). SetSuperAdmin does the locked write and the audit entry; console commands and seeders keep
 * calling it directly.
 */
final class UpdateSuperAdmin
{
    public function __construct(private readonly SetSuperAdmin $setSuperAdmin) {}

    /**
     * @throws AuthorizationException
     * @throws ValidationException
     */
    public function handle(User $actor, User $target, bool $isSuperAdmin): void
    {
        Gate::forUser($actor)->authorize('updateSuperAdmin', $target);

        if ($target->status === UserStatus::PendingActivation) {
            throw ValidationException::withMessages([
                'is_super_admin' => __('Cancel the invitation and invite again with the new roles.'),
            ]);
        }

        $this->setSuperAdmin->handle($target, $isSuperAdmin);
    }
}
```
