`resources/views/pages/users/edit/edit.php`:

```php
<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

use App\Actions\Users\UpdateSuperAdmin;
use App\Actions\Users\UpdateUser;
use App\Actions\Users\UpdateUserRoles;
use App\Actions\Users\UpdateUserStatus;
use App\Authorization\Role;
use App\Authorization\SyncPermissions;
use App\Concerns\ConfirmsPasswords;
use App\Concerns\ProfileValidationRules;
use App\Concerns\ResolvesCurrentUser;
use App\Enums\UserStatus;
use App\Models\User;
use App\Tenancy\HostScope;
use Flux\Flux;
use Illuminate\Auth\Access\AuthorizationException;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Builder;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;
use Illuminate\Support\Str;
use Illuminate\Validation\Rule;
use Illuminate\Validation\ValidationException;
use Livewire\Attributes\Computed;
use Livewire\Attributes\Locked;
use Livewire\Attributes\Title;
use Livewire\Component;
use Spatie\Permission\Models\Role as RoleModel;

new #[Title('Edit user')] class extends Component
{
    use ConfirmsPasswords;
    use ProfileValidationRules;
    use ResolvesCurrentUser;

    /** Session key prefix of a name, address and status parked while the actor confirms their password (RL-18). */
    private const string DRAFT_PREFIX = 'users.edit.draft.';

    #[Locked]
    public int $userId;

    public string $name = '';

    public string $email = '';

    public string $status = '';

    /**
     * Role ids as the checkboxes send them.
     *
     * @var list<string>
     */
    public array $roles = [];

    public bool $isSuperAdmin = false;

    #[Locked]
    public bool $draftRestored = false;

    /** The target read once per request (query and view check); private properties are never dehydrated. */
    private ?User $resolvedTarget = null;

    /**
     * Mount the component with the user id from the route; the user is read per request (R-7).
     */
    public function mount(int $user): void
    {
        $this->userId = $user;
        $target = $this->target();

        $this->fillAccount($target);
        $this->isSuperAdmin = $target->isSuperAdmin();
        $this->roles = $this->assignedRoleIds($target);
        $this->restoreDraft();
    }

    /**
     * Save name, address and status (USR-12). Your own and a pending user's address are read-only and never
     * sent (E1); another user's new address needs a fresh password confirmation first (RL-18).
     */
    public function saveAccount(UpdateUser $updateUser, UpdateUserStatus $updateUserStatus): void
    {
        $actor = $this->currentUser();
        $target = $this->target();
        $this->authorize('update', $target);

        $pending = $target->status === UserStatus::PendingActivation;
        $emailEditable = $actor->isNot($target) && ! $pending;
        $this->email = Str::lower(trim($this->email));

        $this->validate([
            'name' => $this->nameRules(),
            ...($emailEditable ? ['email' => $this->emailRules($target->id, $target->organisation_id)] : []),
            ...($pending ? [] : ['status' => ['required', 'string', Rule::in([UserStatus::Active->value, UserStatus::Disabled->value])]]),
        ]);

        $email = $emailEditable ? $this->email : $target->email;
        $status = $pending ? $target->status : UserStatus::from($this->status);
        $statusChanges = $status !== $target->status;

        if ($statusChanges) {
            $this->authorize('updateStatus', $target);
        }

        if ($email !== $target->email && $this->confirmationParked($target)) {
            return;
        }

        $updateUser->handle($actor, $target, $this->name, $email);

        if ($statusChanges) {
            $updateUserStatus->handle($actor, $target, $status);
        }

        $this->resolvedTarget = null;
        $this->fillAccount($this->target());
        $this->draftRestored = false;

        Flux::toast(variant: 'success', text: __('User saved.'));
    }

    /**
     * The only public method that writes roles (W1); UpdateUserRoles checks the team, the badge and escalation.
     */
    public function saveRoles(UpdateUserRoles $updateUserRoles): void
    {
        $actor = $this->currentUser();
        $target = $this->target();
        $this->authorize('updateRoles', $target);

        if ($actor->is($target)) {
            // No role controls on your own account (W12).
            throw new AuthorizationException;
        }

        if ($target->status === UserStatus::PendingActivation) {
            // The accept link never rotates: widening a pending user's roles would widen a link already shown (RK-B3).
            throw ValidationException::withMessages([
                'roles' => __('Cancel the invitation and invite again with the new roles.'),
            ]);
        }

        $roleIds = array_values(array_unique(array_map(intval(...), $this->roles)));

        $updateUserRoles->handle($actor, $target, $roleIds);

        $this->roles = $this->assignedRoleIds($target);

        Flux::toast(variant: 'success', text: __('Roles saved.'));
    }

    /**
     * Grant or remove super admin after a fresh password confirmation (RL-18, RK-M8). Never on a pending user,
     * whose accept link would then grant the flag (RK-B3).
     */
    public function saveSuperAdmin(UpdateSuperAdmin $updateSuperAdmin): void
    {
        $target = $this->target();
        $this->authorize('updateSuperAdmin', $target);

        if ($target->status === UserStatus::PendingActivation) {
            throw ValidationException::withMessages([
                'is_super_admin' => __('Cancel the invitation and invite again with the new roles.'),
            ]);
        }

        if ($this->passwordConfirmationRequired(route('users.edit', ['user' => $target->id], absolute: false))) {
            return;
        }

        $updateSuperAdmin->handle($this->currentUser(), $target, $this->isSuperAdmin);

        $this->resolvedTarget = null;
        $this->isSuperAdmin = $this->target()->isSuperAdmin();

        Flux::toast(variant: 'success', text: $this->isSuperAdmin ? __('Super admin granted.') : __('Super admin removed.'));
    }

    /**
     * The user this page shows, read again through the host scope on every request (USR-20) and memoised for
     * the rest of it; a save clears the memo before it reads the result back. PHP code calls this method,
     * never the magic computed property (Larastan level 8 has no Livewire computed support).
     */
    #[Computed]
    public function target(): User
    {
        if ($this->resolvedTarget instanceof User) {
            return $this->resolvedTarget;
        }

        $target = HostScope::read(fn (): User => User::query()->findOrFail($this->userId));
        $this->authorize('view', $target);

        return $this->resolvedTarget = $target;
    }

    /**
     * What the signed-in user may change on this page.
     *
     * @return array{update: bool, updateStatus: bool, updateRoles: bool, updateSuperAdmin: bool, ownAccount: bool, pending: bool}
     */
    #[Computed]
    public function abilities(): array
    {
        $actor = $this->currentUser();
        $target = $this->target();
        $ownAccount = $actor->is($target);
        $pending = $target->status === UserStatus::PendingActivation;

        return [
            'update' => $actor->can('update', $target),
            'updateStatus' => ! $pending && $actor->can('updateStatus', $target),
            // A pending user's roles and flag stay as invited: the accept link never rotates (RK-B3).
            'updateRoles' => ! $ownAccount && ! $pending && $actor->can('updateRoles', $target),
            'updateSuperAdmin' => ! $pending && $actor->can('updateSuperAdmin', $target),
            'ownAccount' => $ownAccount,
            'pending' => $pending,
        ];
    }

    /**
     * The organisation_admin template first, then the target team's own roles (DEC-21).
     *
     * @return array<int, string>
     */
    #[Computed]
    public function roleOptions(): array
    {
        $teamId = $this->target()->organisation_id;

        if ($teamId === null) {
            return [];
        }

        return RoleModel::query()
            ->where('guard_name', SyncPermissions::GUARD)
            ->where(function (Builder $query) use ($teamId): void {
                $query->where('team_id', $teamId)->orWhere(function (Builder $template): void {
                    $template->whereNull('team_id')->where('name', Role::OrganisationAdmin->value);
                });
            })
            ->get()
            ->sortBy(fn (RoleModel $role): string => ($role->getAttribute('team_id') === null ? '0 ' : '1 ').$role->name)
            ->mapWithKeys(fn (RoleModel $role): array => [(int) $role->getKey() => Role::tryFrom($role->name)?->label() ?? $role->name])
            ->all();
    }

    /**
     * Parks the unsaved name, address and status, then sends the actor to confirm their password. True means stop.
     */
    private function confirmationParked(User $target): bool
    {
        $key = self::DRAFT_PREFIX.$target->id;
        session()->put($key, ['name' => $this->name, 'email' => $this->email, 'status' => $this->status]);

        if ($this->passwordConfirmationRequired(route('users.edit', ['user' => $target->id], absolute: false))) {
            return true;
        }

        session()->forget($key);

        return false;
    }

    /**
     * Brings back a name, address and status parked before a password confirmation; a status other than
     * Active or Disabled is dropped (W4).
     */
    private function restoreDraft(): void
    {
        $draft = session()->pull(self::DRAFT_PREFIX.$this->userId);

        if (! is_array($draft)) {
            return;
        }

        $name = $draft['name'] ?? null;
        $email = $draft['email'] ?? null;

        if (! is_string($name) || ! is_string($email)) {
            return;
        }

        $this->name = $name;
        $this->email = $email;

        $status = $draft['status'] ?? null;

        if (is_string($status) && in_array(UserStatus::tryFrom($status), [UserStatus::Active, UserStatus::Disabled], true)) {
            $this->status = $status;
        }

        $this->draftRestored = true;
    }

    private function fillAccount(User $target): void
    {
        $this->name = $target->name;
        $this->email = $target->email;
        $this->status = $target->status->value;
    }

    /**
     * The target's role ids in their own team, read without Spatie's team-filtered relation (X1).
     *
     * @return list<string>
     */
    private function assignedRoleIds(User $target): array
    {
        if ($target->organisation_id === null) {
            return [];
        }

        return array_values(DB::table('model_has_roles')
            ->where('model_type', $target->getMorphClass())
            ->where('model_id', $target->id)
            ->where('team_id', $target->organisation_id)
            ->orderBy('role_id')
            ->pluck('role_id')
            ->map(fn (mixed $id): string => (string) $id)
            ->all());
    }
};
```

- [ ] **Step 3: The enum**

`app/Enums/Locale.php` (enums live in `App\Enums`; the Pest Laravel preset forbids them elsewhere):

```php
<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace App\Enums;

/**
 * The supported locales, defined once (§6.5): validation, the migration default, the factory,
 * the invite form and, from M5, the switchers use this enum (OD-2).
 */
enum Locale: string
{
    case Dutch = 'nl';
    case English = 'en';

    /** The app locale when it is supported, otherwise Dutch (§4.11: nl is the kit default). */
    public static function default(): self
    {
        return self::tryFrom((string) config('app.locale')) ?? self::Dutch;
    }

    public function label(): string
    {
        return match ($this) {
            self::Dutch => __('Dutch'),
            self::English => __('English'),
        };
    }
}
```

### Task 11: Invitations core — config, table, model, policy, invite, cancel, invitation mail, accept route

**Covers:** INV-1, INV-2, INV-3 (`acceptUrl()`, route), INV-5 (invite, cancel), INV-6, INV-7, INV-8 (policy), INV-13 (sent, cancelled), INV-14, INV-15, INV-16 (encrypted token, `viewLink`), INV-17 (action), INV-19, INV-21, IMP-10 (config key), USR-3, USR-14, TEN-4 (matrix exclusion), TEN-6, FU2-3, FU2-11 (W8 `make()`), FU3-14, W8, W9, W10, W11, W13, W14 (roles), X2, X5, X11, RL-2, RL-13, C-8, C-22, C-23; OR-B1, OR-M3, OR-M7, OR-M10, RK-B3, RK-I8, RK-I11, RK-M10, RK-M11, CV-15.

What this task builds (spec §4.5, rulings RL-2 and RL-13):
- `config/skv.php` is created once, with the three keys M4 reads: `invitations.expires_in_days` (env `INVITATION_EXPIRES_IN_DAYS`, default 7), `invitations.signature_grace_days` (30) and `modules.impersonation` (env `MODULE_IMPERSONATION`, default true; read from Task 19 on).
- The `invitations` table is the single source of truth (no `users.activation_*` columns, W13). The token is 64 random characters, stored as `token_hash` (sha256, unique, used for the lookup) and as `token` (Laravel `encrypted` cast, nullable, used to rebuild the link for mails and "Copy invite link", cleared on accept in Task 12). It is never stored in plain text and never on `users`.
- `Invitation` is a tenant model (`BelongsToOrganisation` + `SoftDeletes`, listed in `config('tenancy.tenant_models')`, `organisation_id` not mass-assignable). "Hard delete" in the spec means `forceDelete()` (C-8).
- Inviting creates a **pending user** (status `pending_activation`, name = the address until the invitee chooses one, the chosen `Locale`), attaches the roles to that user **at invite time through `UpdateUserRoles`** (so the escalation guard applies, X5), creates the invitation and queues the mail after commit. At least one role is required (W14). Inviting needs `users.create` **and** `roles.assign` in the organisation (OR-M7). The audit trail of one invite is exactly `user.roles_changed` + `invitation.sent`, and no entry ever contains the token, its hash or a link (OR-M10, RK-M11).
- `InviteUser` locks the organisation with `HostScope::lockForWrite()` **before** `Tenant::run()`: an archived organisation is a validation error, and inviting into another organisation than the bound tenant is refused (RK-I11).
- The address goes through `App\Rules\AvailableEmail` (Task 5): generic "This address can't be used." for an address of another organisation or a super admin, "already has an open invitation" for a pending holder in the own organisation (W9, OR-I3). Addresses are lower-cased (X2).
- Cancel force-deletes the invitation and soft-deletes the pending user (spec §4.5), refused once accepted; the same address can be invited again afterwards (INV-14); the cancelled invitee stays out of restore (C-9).
- `InvitationMail` is a queued markdown mailable marked `afterCommit()` (W10). It builds the signed accept link **when the worker renders it** (TEN-6, FU3-14): `Invitation::acceptUrl()` signs a relative route with expiry `expires_at + signature_grace_days` (never `expires_at` itself, INV-4) and puts it on the organisation's host with `tenant_url()`. The mail is written in the invitee's locale, dates with `isoFormat('LL')` (X11).
- `InvitationPolicy`: `create`, `remind`, `cancel`, `viewLink`. None is in `SuperAdminGate::ALWAYS_CHECKED`, so super admins pass through `Gate::before` (FU2-3). `viewLink` ("Copy invite link") is a bearer credential for the invitation's roles: it needs the `remind` conditions, `roles.assign` and that the pending user's effective permissions are a subset of the actor's (RK-B3, RL-26). `remind` needs `users.invite.resend`, `cancel` needs `users.delete` (INV-8). `remind`, `cancel` and `viewLink` all require the actor to be in the invitation's organisation **and** the pending user not to be a super admin (§6.3, mirroring `UserAbilities::manages()`): the `super_admin` badge has no team, so `EffectivePermissions` leaves it out, and without this check an organisation admin could copy the accept link of a pending user a super admin had promoted and take over a platform account.
- The signed `invitations.accept` route (tenant hosts only, `signed:relative`, **outside** the `auth` group) is registered now; its page arrives in Task 12 (`Route::livewire()` stores only the component name). It goes into the route × host matrix exclusions (OR-B1).

**Files:**
- Create: `config/skv.php`, `database/migrations/0001_01_01_000007_create_invitations_table.php`, `app/Models/Invitation.php`, `database/factories/InvitationFactory.php`, `app/Policies/InvitationPolicy.php`, `app/Actions/Invitations/InviteUser.php`, `app/Actions/Invitations/CancelInvitation.php`, `app/Mail/InvitationMail.php`, `resources/views/mail/invitation.blade.php`
- Modify: `config/tenancy.php` (`tenant_models`), `routes/admin.php` (signed `invitations.accept` route outside the `auth` group), `tests/Feature/Tenancy/RouteHostMatrixTest.php` (exclusion), `.env.example` (`INVITATION_EXPIRES_IN_DAYS=7`, `MODULE_IMPERSONATION=true`), `tests/Pest.php` (`inviteMember`, `acceptLinkFor`), `lang/nl.json`, `lang/en.json`
- Test: `tests/Feature/Invitations/InviteUserTest.php`, `tests/Feature/Invitations/InvitationMailTest.php`, `tests/Feature/Invitations/CancelInvitationTest.php`, `tests/Feature/Invitations/InvitationPolicyTest.php`

- [ ] **Step 1: Add the test helpers**

Append to `tests/Pest.php` and add the imports `App\Actions\Invitations\InviteUser`, `App\Enums\Locale`, `App\Models\Invitation` and `Spatie\Permission\Models\Role as RoleModel` (`App\Authorization\Role`, `App\Authorization\SetSuperAdmin`, `App\Models\Organisation` and `App\Models\User` are imported already):

```php
/**
 * Invites an address into an organisation with the organisation_admin template through InviteUser
 * (§4.5). Without an actor a fresh super admin invites; this helper signs nobody in.
 */
function inviteMember(Organisation $organisation, ?User $actor = null, string $email = 'invitee@example.com'): Invitation
{
    if (! $actor instanceof User) {
        $actor = User::factory()->superAdmin()->create();
        app(SetSuperAdmin::class)->handle($actor, true);
    }

    $templateId = (int) RoleModel::query()->whereNull('team_id')->where('name', Role::OrganisationAdmin->value)->value('id');

    return app(InviteUser::class)->handle($actor, $organisation, $email, [$templateId], Locale::default());
}

/** The signed accept link of an invitation, on its organisation's host (Invitation::acceptUrl()). */
function acceptLinkFor(Invitation $invitation): string
{
    return $invitation->acceptUrl();
}
```

```php
    $role->givePermissionTo(array_map(fn (Permission $permission): string => $permission->value, $permissions));

    return $role;
};

$holderOf = function (Organisation $organisation, RoleModel $role): User {
    $user = User::factory()->for($organisation)->create();
    withPermissionsTeam($organisation->id, fn (): User => $user->assignRole($role));
    $user->unsetRelation('roles');

    return $user;
};

// The messages the array mailer delivered (real sync or database queue; never Mail::fake(), RK-I8).
$deliveredMails = function (): array {
    $transport = Mail::driver()->getSymfonyTransport();
    $mails = [];

    if ($transport instanceof ArrayTransport) {
        foreach ($transport->messages() as $sent) {
            $message = $sent instanceof SentMessage ? $sent->getOriginalMessage() : null;

            if ($message instanceof Email) {
                $mails[] = $message;
            }
        }
    }

    return $mails;
};

it('creates a pending user with roles, an invitation and a queued mail (INV-1)', function (): void {
    config(['queue.default' => 'database']);
    // Whole seconds: the datetime columns store no microseconds.
    $this->freezeSecond();
    $organisation = Organisation::factory()->create(['slug' => 'acme']);
    $admin = asOrgAdmin($organisation);

    $invitation = inviteMember($organisation, $admin);

    $invitee = User::query()->where('email', 'invitee@example.com')->sole();
    expect($invitee->status)->toBe(UserStatus::PendingActivation)
        ->and($invitee->name)->toBe('invitee@example.com')
        ->and($invitee->locale)->toBe(Locale::default())
        ->and(withPermissionsTeam($organisation->id, fn (): array => $invitee->getRoleNames()->all()))->toBe([Role::OrganisationAdmin->value])
        ->and($invitation->user_id)->toBe($invitee->id)
        ->and($invitation->invited_by)->toBe($admin->id)
        ->and($invitation->organisation_id)->toBe($organisation->id)
        ->and($invitation->expires_at->equalTo(now()->addDays(7)))->toBeTrue()
        ->and($invitation->reminder_sent_at)->toBeNull()
        ->and($invitation->accepted_at)->toBeNull()
        ->and(DB::table('jobs')->count())->toBe(1)
        ->and((string) DB::table('jobs')->value('payload'))->toContain('InvitationMail');
});

        ->toThrow(ValidationException::class, __('Choose at least one role.'));

it('stores the token only as a hash and an encrypted copy, never in plain text (W13, RK-M10)', function (): void {
    $organisation = Organisation::factory()->create(['slug' => 'acme']);
    $invitation = inviteMember($organisation, asOrgAdmin($organisation));
    $token = $invitation->token ?? throw new LogicException('The invitation keeps no token.');
    $stored = DB::table('invitations')->where('id', $invitation->id);

    expect($token)->toHaveLength(64)
        ->and($stored->value('token_hash'))->toBe(hash('sha256', $token))
        ->and($stored->value('token'))->not->toBe($token)
        ->and(Crypt::decryptString((string) $stored->value('token')))->toBe($token)
        ->and(json_encode([DB::table('invitations')->get(), DB::table('users')->get()], JSON_THROW_ON_ERROR))->not->toContain($token);
});

it('sends no mail while the transaction is open and exactly one after commit (W10, RK-I8)', function () use ($deliveredMails): void {

    DB::transaction(function () use ($organisation, $admin, $deliveredMails): void {

    config([
        'queue.default' => 'database',
        'mail.default' => 'failing',
        'mail.mailers.failing' => ['transport' => 'failing'],
    ]);
    Mail::extend('failing', fn (): TransportInterface => new class implements TransportInterface
    {
        public function send(RawMessage $message, ?Envelope $envelope = null): ?SentMessage
        {
            throw new TransportException('The mail server is down.');
        }

        public function __toString(): string
        {
            return 'failing';
        }
    });
    $organisation = Organisation::factory()->create(['slug' => 'acme']);
    $admin = asOrgAdmin($organisation);
    $invitation = inviteMember($organisation, $admin);

    Artisan::call('queue:work', ['--once' => true, '--stop-when-empty' => true, '--tries' => 1]);
    // The worker resets the scoped CurrentTenant before each job; bind the host's tenant again.
    onTenant($organisation);

    expect(DB::table('jobs')->count())->toBe(0)
        ->and(DB::table('failed_jobs')->count())->toBe(1)
        ->and(Invitation::query()->whereKey($invitation->id)->exists())->toBeTrue()
        ->and(User::query()->where('email', 'invitee@example.com')->first()?->status)->toBe(UserStatus::PendingActivation)
        ->and(Gate::forUser($admin)->allows('remind', $invitation))->toBeTrue();
});

        ->toThrow(ValidationException::class, __('You can only give or take away roles whose permissions you have yourself.'));
```

`tests/Feature/Invitations/InvitationMailTest.php`:

```php
<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

/** covers §4.5, §6.2, X11 */

use App\Actions\Invitations\InviteUser;
use App\Authorization\Role;
use App\Authorization\SetSuperAdmin;
use App\Enums\Locale;
use App\Models\Organisation;
use App\Models\User;
use Carbon\CarbonImmutable;
use Illuminate\Mail\Transport\ArrayTransport;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Artisan;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Mail;
use Spatie\Permission\Models\Role as RoleModel;
use Symfony\Component\Mailer\SentMessage;
use Symfony\Component\Mime\Email;

beforeEach(function (): void {
    config(['queue.default' => 'database']);
});

$deliveredMails = function (): array {
    $transport = Mail::driver()->getSymfonyTransport();
    $mails = [];

    if ($transport instanceof ArrayTransport) {
        foreach ($transport->messages() as $sent) {
            $message = $sent instanceof SentMessage ? $sent->getOriginalMessage() : null;

            if ($message instanceof Email) {
                $mails[] = $message;
            }
        }
    }

    return $mails;
};

$htmlOf = function (Email $mail): string {
    $html = $mail->getHtmlBody();

    return html_entity_decode(is_string($html) ? $html : '');
};

it('builds a signed accept link on the organisation\'s host when the worker sends it (TEN-6, FU3-14)', function () use ($deliveredMails, $htmlOf): void {
    $organisation = Organisation::factory()->create(['name' => 'Acme', 'slug' => 'acme']);
    $invitation = inviteMember($organisation, asOrgAdmin($organisation));
    $token = $invitation->token ?? throw new LogicException('The invitation keeps no token.');

    // The queued job carries no link and no token: the worker builds the link (FU3-14).
    expect((string) DB::table('jobs')->value('payload'))->not->toContain($token)->not->toContain('signature');

    onAdminHost();
    Artisan::call('queue:work', ['--once' => true, '--stop-when-empty' => true, '--tries' => 1]);

    $mails = $deliveredMails();
    expect($mails)->toHaveCount(1)
        ->and($mails[0]->getTo()[0]->getAddress())->toBe('invitee@example.com');

    preg_match('#https?://[^\s"<>]+/invitations/accept/[^\s"<>]+#', $htmlOf($mails[0]), $matches);
    $link = $matches[0] ?? throw new RuntimeException('The mail holds no accept link.');
    parse_str((string) parse_url($link, PHP_URL_QUERY), $query);

    expect($link)->toStartWith('http://acme.localhost/invitations/accept/'.$token.'?')
        ->and($query['expires'] ?? null)->toBe((string) $invitation->expires_at->copy()->addDays(30)->getTimestamp())
        ->and($query)->toHaveKey('signature');
});

it('writes the mail in the invitee\'s language with a localised expiry date (X11)', function (Locale $locale, string $subject, string $date) use ($deliveredMails, $htmlOf): void {
    $this->travelTo(CarbonImmutable::parse('2026-10-11 09:00:00'));
    $organisation = Organisation::factory()->create(['name' => 'Acme', 'slug' => 'acme']);
    $superAdmin = User::factory()->superAdmin()->create();
    app(SetSuperAdmin::class)->handle($superAdmin, true);
    $templateId = (int) RoleModel::query()->whereNull('team_id')->where('name', Role::OrganisationAdmin->value)->value('id');

    app(InviteUser::class)->handle($superAdmin, $organisation, 'invitee@example.com', [$templateId], $locale);
    Artisan::call('queue:work', ['--once' => true, '--stop-when-empty' => true, '--tries' => 1]);

    $mail = $deliveredMails()[0] ?? throw new RuntimeException('No mail was delivered.');

    expect($mail->getSubject())->toBe($subject)
        ->and($htmlOf($mail))->toContain($subject)->toContain($date);
})->with([
    'Dutch' => [Locale::Dutch, 'Je bent uitgenodigd voor Acme', '18 oktober 2026'],
    'English' => [Locale::English, 'You have been invited to Acme', 'October 18, 2026'],
]);
```

```php
    $invitation->forceFill(['accepted_at' => now()])->save();

    expect(fn () => app(CancelInvitation::class)->handle($admin, $invitation))
        ->toThrow(ValidationException::class, __('This invitation has already been accepted.'));

        ->and(User::withTrashed()->where('email', 'invitee@example.com')->count())->toBe(2);
});

    $invitation = inviteMember($organisation, $admin);
```

```php
<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

/** covers §4.5, §4.6, §6.3 */

use App\Actions\Invitations\InviteUser;
use App\Authorization\Permission;
use App\Authorization\Role;
use App\Authorization\SetSuperAdmin;
use App\Enums\Locale;
use App\Models\Invitation;
use App\Models\Organisation;
use App\Models\User;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Gate;
use Spatie\Permission\Models\Role as RoleModel;

$teamRoleWith = function (Organisation $organisation, string $name, Permission ...$permissions): RoleModel {
    $role = RoleModel::query()->create(['name' => $name, 'guard_name' => 'web', 'team_id' => $organisation->id]);
    $role->givePermissionTo(array_map(fn (Permission $permission): string => $permission->value, $permissions));

    return $role;
};

$holderOf = function (Organisation $organisation, RoleModel|string $role): User {
    $user = User::factory()->for($organisation)->create();
    withPermissionsTeam($organisation->id, fn (): User => $user->assignRole($role));
    $user->unsetRelation('roles');

    return $user;
};

it('lets a super admin and an inviter who could grant the roles see the link, and nobody else (RK-B3)', function () use ($teamRoleWith, $holderOf): void {
    $acme = Organisation::factory()->create(['slug' => 'acme']);
    $beta = Organisation::factory()->create(['slug' => 'beta']);
    $superAdmin = User::factory()->superAdmin()->create();
    app(SetSuperAdmin::class)->handle($superAdmin, true);
    $betaAdmin = $holderOf($beta, Role::OrganisationAdmin->value);
    onTenant($acme);
    $adminInvitation = inviteMember($acme, $superAdmin);
    $acmeAdmin = $holderOf($acme, Role::OrganisationAdmin->value);
    $helpdesk = $holderOf($acme, $teamRoleWith($acme, 'helpdesk', Permission::UsersView, Permission::UsersInviteResend, Permission::RolesAssign));
    $resender = $holderOf($acme, $teamRoleWith($acme, 'resender', Permission::UsersView, Permission::UsersInviteResend));
    $viewerRole = $teamRoleWith($acme, 'viewer', Permission::UsersView);
    $viewerInvitation = app(InviteUser::class)->handle($superAdmin, $acme, 'viewer@example.com', [(int) $viewerRole->id], Locale::English);

    expect(Gate::forUser($superAdmin)->allows('viewLink', $adminInvitation))->toBeTrue()
        ->and(Gate::forUser($acmeAdmin)->allows('viewLink', $adminInvitation))->toBeTrue()
        ->and(Gate::forUser($helpdesk)->allows('viewLink', $adminInvitation))->toBeFalse()
        ->and(Gate::forUser($helpdesk)->allows('viewLink', $viewerInvitation))->toBeTrue()
        ->and(Gate::forUser($resender)->allows('remind', $adminInvitation))->toBeTrue()
        ->and(Gate::forUser($resender)->allows('viewLink', $adminInvitation))->toBeFalse()
        ->and(Gate::forUser($resender)->allows('viewLink', $viewerInvitation))->toBeFalse()
        ->and(Gate::forUser($betaAdmin)->allows('viewLink', $adminInvitation))->toBeFalse();
});

it('ties remind to users.invite.resend and cancel to users.delete (INV-8)', function () use ($teamRoleWith, $holderOf): void {
    $acme = Organisation::factory()->create(['slug' => 'acme']);

    onTenant($acme);
    $viewerRole = $teamRoleWith($acme, 'viewer', Permission::UsersView);
    $invitation = app(InviteUser::class)->handle($superAdmin, $acme, 'viewer@example.com', [(int) $viewerRole->id], Locale::English);
    $resender = $holderOf($acme, $teamRoleWith($acme, 'resender', Permission::UsersView, Permission::UsersInviteResend));
    $deleter = $holderOf($acme, $teamRoleWith($acme, 'deleter', Permission::UsersView, Permission::UsersDelete));
    $viewer = $holderOf($acme, $viewerRole);

    expect(Gate::forUser($resender)->allows('remind', $invitation))->toBeTrue()
        ->and(Gate::forUser($resender)->allows('cancel', $invitation))->toBeFalse()
        ->and(Gate::forUser($deleter)->allows('cancel', $invitation))->toBeTrue()
        ->and(Gate::forUser($deleter)->allows('remind', $invitation))->toBeFalse()
        ->and(Gate::forUser($viewer)->allows('remind', $invitation))->toBeFalse()
        ->and(Gate::forUser($viewer)->allows('cancel', $invitation))->toBeFalse();
});

it('refuses organisation members every invitation ability on a pending super admin (§6.3)', function () use ($holderOf): void {
    $acme = Organisation::factory()->create(['slug' => 'acme']);
    $superAdmin = User::factory()->superAdmin()->create();
    app(SetSuperAdmin::class)->handle($superAdmin, true);
    onTenant($acme);
    $invitation = inviteMember($acme, $superAdmin);
    $acmeAdmin = $holderOf($acme, Role::OrganisationAdmin->value);

    // A direct write stands in for any path that ever promotes a pending user: the policy must not rely on that path being closed.
    $invitation->user->forceFill(['is_super_admin' => true])->save();

    foreach (['remind', 'cancel', 'viewLink'] as $ability) {
        expect(Gate::forUser($acmeAdmin)->allows($ability, $invitation))->toBeFalse()
            ->and(Gate::forUser($superAdmin)->allows($ability, $invitation))->toBeTrue();
    }
});

it('requires roles.assign to create (OR-M7)', function () use ($teamRoleWith, $holderOf): void {
    $acme = onTenant(Organisation::factory()->create(['slug' => 'acme']));
    $beta = Organisation::factory()->create(['slug' => 'beta']);
    $creatorOnly = $holderOf($acme, $teamRoleWith($acme, 'creator', Permission::UsersCreate));
    $inviter = $holderOf($acme, $teamRoleWith($acme, 'inviter', Permission::UsersCreate, Permission::RolesAssign));
    $superAdmin = User::factory()->superAdmin()->create();
    app(SetSuperAdmin::class)->handle($superAdmin, true);

    expect(Gate::forUser($creatorOnly)->allows('create', [Invitation::class, $acme]))->toBeFalse()
        ->and(Gate::forUser($inviter)->allows('create', [Invitation::class, $acme]))->toBeTrue()
        ->and(Gate::forUser($inviter)->allows('create', [Invitation::class, $beta]))->toBeFalse()
        ->and(Gate::forUser($superAdmin)->allows('create', [Invitation::class, $beta]))->toBeTrue();
});
```

- [ ] **Step 6: Model, factory and tenant registration**

`app/Models/Invitation.php`:

```php
<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace App\Models;

use App\Tenancy\Concerns\BelongsToOrganisation;
use Database\Factories\InvitationFactory;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Attributes\Fillable;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Attributes\Hidden;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Factories\HasFactory;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Model;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Relations\BelongsTo;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\SoftDeletes;
use Illuminate\Support\Carbon;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\URL;
use LogicException;

/**
 * An invitation to join an organisation (§4.5), the single source of truth for it (W13). The token
 * is stored as a sha256 hash for the lookup and as an encrypted copy for mails and "Copy invite
 * link"; the copy is cleared on accept, so an accepted link can never be rebuilt (RK-B3). Tenant
 * model: the lookup runs under the tenant scope, so a link opened on another host finds nothing (W14).
 *
 * @property int $id
 * @property int $organisation_id
 * @property int $user_id
 * @property int|null $invited_by
 * @property string $token_hash
 * @property string|null $token
 * @property Carbon $expires_at
 * @property Carbon|null $reminder_sent_at
 * @property Carbon|null $accepted_at
 * @property Carbon|null $created_at
 * @property Carbon|null $updated_at
 * @property Carbon|null $deleted_at
 * @property-read User $user
 * @property-read Organisation|null $organisation
 */
#[Fillable(['user_id', 'invited_by', 'token_hash', 'token', 'expires_at', 'reminder_sent_at', 'accepted_at'])]
#[Hidden(['token', 'token_hash'])]
class Invitation extends Model
{
    /** @use HasFactory<InvitationFactory> */
    use BelongsToOrganisation, HasFactory, SoftDeletes;

    /** The invitation for a plain token, within the current tenant only (W14). */
    public static function findByToken(string $token): ?self
    {
        return self::query()->where('token_hash', hash('sha256', $token))->first();
    }

    /**
     * The pending user; soft-deleted users included, so a cancelled invitee still resolves.
     *
     * @return BelongsTo<User, $this>
     */
    public function user(): BelongsTo
    {
        return $this->belongsTo(User::class)->withTrashed();
    }

    /**
     * The one place that builds the accept link (§4.5): a relative signed path, so it survives
     * http↔https and host rewrites between queueing and clicking, on the organisation's host. The
     * signature lives signature_grace_days past the domain expiry, so a just-expired link reaches
     * the "expired" page and only links older than the grace period get a 403. Built at send time
     * in the worker (FU3-14); after a slug rename a reminder rebuilds it (X13).
     */
    public function acceptUrl(): string
    {
        $token = $this->token ?? throw new LogicException("Invitation [{$this->id}] keeps no token any more.");
        $organisation = $this->organisation ?? throw new LogicException("Invitation [{$this->id}] has no active organisation.");

        return tenant_url($organisation, URL::temporarySignedRoute(
            'invitations.accept',
            $this->expires_at->copy()->addDays((int) config('skv.invitations.signature_grace_days', 30)),
            ['token' => $token],
            absolute: false,
        ));
    }

    public function isExpired(): bool
    {
        return $this->expires_at->isPast();
    }

    public function isAccepted(): bool
    {
        return $this->accepted_at !== null;
    }

    /** @return array<string, string> */
    protected function casts(): array
    {
        return [
            'token' => 'encrypted',
            'expires_at' => 'datetime',
            'reminder_sent_at' => 'datetime',
            'accepted_at' => 'datetime',
        ];
    }
}
```

```php
<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace Database\Factories;

use App\Models\Invitation;
use App\Models\Organisation;
use App\Models\User;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Factories\Factory;
use Illuminate\Support\Str;

/**
 * An invitation with its pending user. Real flows go through InviteUser; the factory serves list
 * and state tests.
 *
 * @extends Factory<Invitation>
 */
class InvitationFactory extends Factory
{
    /**
     * Define the model's default state.
     *
     * @return array<string, mixed>
     */
    public function definition(): array
    {
        $token = Str::random(64);

        return [
            'organisation_id' => Organisation::factory(),
            'user_id' => fn (array $attributes): int => User::factory()->pending()->create(['organisation_id' => $attributes['organisation_id']])->id,
            'invited_by' => null,
            'token_hash' => hash('sha256', $token),
            'token' => $token,
            'expires_at' => now()->addDays(7),
            'reminder_sent_at' => null,
            'accepted_at' => null,
        ];
    }

    public function expired(): static
    {
        return $this->state(fn (array $attributes): array => [
            'expires_at' => now()->subDay(),
        ]);
    }

    public function accepted(): static
    {
        return $this->state(fn (array $attributes): array => [
            'accepted_at' => now(),
            'token' => null,
        ]);
    }
}
```

- [ ] **Step 7: The policy**

`app/Policies/InvitationPolicy.php`:

```php
<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace App\Policies;

use App\Authorization\EffectivePermissions;
use App\Authorization\Permission;
use App\Authorization\UserAbilities;
use App\Models\Invitation;
use App\Models\Organisation;
use App\Models\User;

/**
 * Invitation abilities (§4.5). None of the names is in SuperAdminGate::ALWAYS_CHECKED, so super
 * admins pass through Gate::before (FU2-3).
 */
final class InvitationPolicy
{
    public function __construct(
        private readonly EffectivePermissions $effectivePermissions,
        private readonly UserAbilities $userAbilities,
    ) {}

    /** Roles attach at invite time, so inviting needs users.create and roles.assign in the own organisation (§4.6, OR-M7). */
    public function create(User $actor, Organisation $organisation): bool
    {
        return $actor->can(Permission::UsersCreate)
            && $actor->can(Permission::RolesAssign)
            && $actor->organisation_id !== null
            && $actor->organisation_id === $organisation->id;
    }

    public function remind(User $actor, Invitation $invitation): bool
    {
        return $actor->can(Permission::UsersInviteResend) && $this->sameOrganisation($actor, $invitation);
    }

    public function cancel(User $actor, Invitation $invitation): bool
    {
        return $actor->can(Permission::UsersDelete) && $this->sameOrganisation($actor, $invitation);
    }

    /**
     * The accept link is a bearer credential for the invitation's roles (RK-B3): only someone who
     * could grant them sees it — the remind conditions, roles.assign and the pending user's effective
     * permissions being a subset of the actor's (RL-26).
     */
    public function viewLink(User $actor, Invitation $invitation): bool
    {
        if (! $this->remind($actor, $invitation) || ! $actor->can(Permission::RolesAssign)) {
            return false;
        }

        return $this->userAbilities->covers(
            $this->effectivePermissions->of($actor, $invitation->organisation_id),
            $this->effectivePermissions->of($invitation->user, $invitation->organisation_id),
        );
    }

    /**
     * The actor belongs to the invitation's organisation. Organisation members never act on a pending
     * super admin (§6.3), mirroring UserAbilities::manages(): the super_admin badge has no team, so
     * EffectivePermissions leaves it out and viewLink's subset check alone would hand out a platform
     * account's accept link. Super admins pass through Gate::before.
     */
    private function sameOrganisation(User $actor, Invitation $invitation): bool
    {
        return ! $invitation->user->isSuperAdmin()
            && $actor->organisation_id !== null
            && $actor->organisation_id === $invitation->organisation_id;
    }
}
```

- [ ] **Step 8: The invitation mail**

`app/Mail/InvitationMail.php`:

```php
<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace App\Mail;

use App\Models\Invitation;
use Illuminate\Bus\Queueable;
use Illuminate\Contracts\Queue\ShouldQueue;
use Illuminate\Mail\Mailable;
use Illuminate\Mail\Mailables\Content;
use Illuminate\Mail\Mailables\Envelope;
use Illuminate\Queue\SerializesModels;
use LogicException;

/**
 * The invitation mail (§4.5). Queued after commit, so a rolled-back invite sends nothing and a
 * transport failure leaves a remindable invitation (W10). The accept link is built when the worker
 * renders the mail, on the organisation's host (TEN-6, FU3-14), and the expiry date is written in
 * the mail's locale (X11). A mail for an invitation cancelled or accepted before the worker runs
 * fails in the worker and is never delivered.
 */
final class InvitationMail extends Mailable implements ShouldQueue
{
    use Queueable, SerializesModels;

    public function __construct(public Invitation $invitation)
    {
        $this->afterCommit();
    }

    public function envelope(): Envelope
    {
        return new Envelope(
            subject: __('You have been invited to :organisation', ['organisation' => $this->organisationName()]),
        );
    }

    public function content(): Content
    {
        return new Content(
            markdown: 'mail.invitation',
            with: [
                'organisation' => $this->organisationName(),
                'acceptUrl' => $this->invitation->acceptUrl(),
                'expiresOn' => $this->invitation->expires_at->copy()->locale(app()->getLocale())->isoFormat('LL'),
            ],
        );
    }

    private function organisationName(): string
    {
        return $this->invitation->organisation?->name
            ?? throw new LogicException("Invitation [{$this->invitation->id}] has no active organisation.");
    }
}
```

- [ ] **Step 9: The invite and cancel actions**

`app/Actions/Invitations/InviteUser.php`:

```php
<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace App\Actions\Invitations;

use App\Actions\Audit\RecordActivity;
use App\Actions\Users\UpdateUserRoles;
use App\Concerns\ProfileValidationRules;
use App\Enums\ActivityEvent;
use App\Enums\Locale;
use App\Enums\UserStatus;
use App\Mail\InvitationMail;
use App\Models\Invitation;
use App\Models\Organisation;
use App\Models\User;
use App\Tenancy\Facades\Tenant;
use App\Tenancy\HostScope;
use Illuminate\Auth\Access\AuthorizationException;
use Illuminate\Database\UniqueConstraintViolationException;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Gate;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Mail;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Validator;
use Illuminate\Support\Str;
use Illuminate\Validation\ValidationException;
use Spatie\Permission\Models\Role as RoleModel;

/**
 * Invites an address into an organisation (§4.5). In one transaction: the organisation is locked
 * and re-checked before the tenant is bound (RK-I11), the address must be available (W9, X2), a
 * pending user is created with an explicit organisation and never as super admin (W8), its roles
 * are attached through UpdateUserRoles so the escalation guard applies (X5) and at least one role
 * is required (W14), and the invitation keeps only a hash and an encrypted copy of the token (W13).
 * The mail is queued after commit and builds its link in the worker (W10, FU3-14). Team and tenant
 * are restored on failure (W11). Bulk invitations (M7) reuse this action.
 */
final class InviteUser
{
    use ProfileValidationRules;

    public function __construct(
        private readonly UpdateUserRoles $updateUserRoles,
        private readonly RecordActivity $recordActivity,
    ) {}

    /**
     * @param  list<int>  $roleIds
     *
     * @throws AuthorizationException
     * @throws ValidationException
     */
    public function handle(User $actor, Organisation $organisation, string $email, array $roleIds, Locale $locale): Invitation
    {
        Gate::forUser($actor)->authorize('create', [Invitation::class, $organisation]);

        $email = Str::lower(trim($email));

        try {
            return DB::transaction(function () use ($actor, $organisation, $email, $roleIds, $locale): Invitation {
                // Before Tenant::run(): inside it the "is this the bound tenant" check would be trivially true.
                $organisation = HostScope::lockForWrite($organisation);

                return Tenant::run($organisation, fn (): Invitation => $this->invite($actor, $organisation, $email, $roleIds, $locale));
            });
        } catch (UniqueConstraintViolationException) {
            // A concurrent invite or sign-up took the address between validation and insert.
            throw ValidationException::withMessages(['email' => __("This address can't be used.")]);
        }
    }

    /**
     * @param  list<int>  $roleIds
     *
     * @throws AuthorizationException
     * @throws ValidationException
     */
    private function invite(User $actor, Organisation $organisation, string $email, array $roleIds, Locale $locale): Invitation
    {
        Validator::make(
            ['email' => $email, 'roles' => $roleIds],
            [
                'email' => $this->emailRules(organisationId: $organisation->id),
                'roles' => ['required', 'array', 'min:1'],
            ],
            [
                'roles.required' => __('Choose at least one role.'),
                'roles.min' => __('Choose at least one role.'),
            ],
        )->validate();

        $invitee = new User;
        $invitee->forceFill([
            'organisation_id' => $organisation->id,
            'is_super_admin' => false,
            'status' => UserStatus::PendingActivation,
            'locale' => $locale,
            'name' => $email,
            'email' => $email,
            'password' => Str::password(32),
        ])->save();

        $this->updateUserRoles->handle($actor, $invitee, $roleIds);

        $token = $this->newToken();

        $invitation = new Invitation;
        $invitation->forceFill([
            'organisation_id' => $organisation->id,
            'user_id' => $invitee->id,
            'invited_by' => $actor->id,
            'token_hash' => hash('sha256', $token),
            'token' => $token,
            'expires_at' => now()->addDays((int) config('skv.invitations.expires_in_days', 7)),
        ])->save();

        $this->recordActivity->handle(ActivityEvent::InvitationSent, $invitee, [
            'invitation_id' => $invitation->id,
            'email' => $email,
            'roles' => $this->roleNames($roleIds),
        ], causer: $actor);

        Mail::to($email)->locale($locale->value)->queue(new InvitationMail($invitation));

        return $invitation;
    }

    private function newToken(): string
    {
        return Str::random(64);
    }

    /**
     * @param  list<int>  $roleIds
     * @return list<string>
     */
    private function roleNames(array $roleIds): array
    {
        return array_values(array_map(
            fn (mixed $name): string => (string) $name,
            RoleModel::query()->whereKey($roleIds)->orderBy('name')->pluck('name')->all(),
        ));
    }
}
```

`app/Actions/Invitations/CancelInvitation.php`:

```php
<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace App\Actions\Invitations;

use App\Actions\Audit\RecordActivity;
use App\Enums\ActivityEvent;
use App\Models\Invitation;
use App\Models\Organisation;
use App\Models\User;
use App\Tenancy\Facades\Tenant;
use App\Tenancy\HostScope;
use Illuminate\Auth\Access\AuthorizationException;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Gate;
use Illuminate\Validation\ValidationException;

/**
 * Cancels an open invitation (§4.5): the invitation is force-deleted (a tenant model with soft
 * deletes, so "hard delete" means forceDelete, C-8) and the pending user is soft-deleted, which
 * frees the address for a new invitation (INV-14) and keeps the user out of restore (C-9).
 * Refused once accepted.
 */
final class CancelInvitation
{
    public function __construct(private readonly RecordActivity $recordActivity) {}

    /**
     * @throws AuthorizationException
     * @throws ValidationException
     */
    public function handle(User $actor, Invitation $invitation): void
    {
        Gate::forUser($actor)->authorize('cancel', $invitation);

        DB::transaction(function () use ($actor, $invitation): void {
            $organisation = HostScope::lockForWrite(Organisation::withTrashed()->findOrFail($invitation->organisation_id));

            Tenant::run($organisation, function () use ($actor, $invitation): void {
                $locked = Invitation::query()->lockForUpdate()->findOrFail($invitation->id);

                if ($locked->isAccepted()) {
                    throw ValidationException::withMessages([
                        'invitation' => __('This invitation has already been accepted.'),
                    ]);
                }

                $invitee = $locked->user;

                $locked->forceDelete();
                $invitee->delete();

                $this->recordActivity->handle(ActivityEvent::InvitationCancelled, $invitee, [
                    'invitation_id' => $locked->id,
                    'email' => $invitee->email,
                ], causer: $actor);
            });
        });
    }
}
```

### Task 12: Remind, accept and the accept page; flash→toast bridge

**Covers:** INV-3 (page), INV-4, INV-5 (remind, accept), INV-7 (reminder mail), INV-10, INV-11, INV-12, INV-13 (reminder sent, accepted), INV-20, TEN-6 (reminder), W5, W14 (name, sign-in, host), X9, X12 (states), RL-11 (bridge), RL-13 (token cleared), RL-15, C-10, C-11; OR-I10, CV-12, RK-B3, RK-M3, RK-M12.

What this task builds (spec §4.5, rulings RL-11, RL-13, RL-15):
- **Remind = resend** (C-10): renews `expires_at` to now + `skv.invitations.expires_in_days`, keeps the token, sets `reminder_sent_at`, works on an expired invitation and is refused once accepted (W5). The reminder mail is queued after commit and builds its link in the worker, on the organisation's host, also when the reminder was sent from the admin host (CV-12). The action queues inside `Tenant::run($organisation, …)`, and the database queue builds the payload when the job is pushed (only the insert waits for the commit), so the job carries the organisation's `tenant_id` even when the request is on the admin host; the link itself comes from the invitation's organisation, not from the worker's tenant. A reminder also rebuilds links after a slug rename (X13).
- **Accept**: one transaction with the invitation row locked (X9); inside it the action re-checks accepted/expired and that the pending user is not trashed, still `pending_activation` and not a super admin (RK-M3; a promoted pending user is never activated through a link, §6.3). The invitee chooses their own name and a password (W14); the user becomes active and is saved quietly (the action logs its own `invitation.accepted`, RL-6); `accepted_at` is set and the encrypted `token` is cleared, so the link can never be rebuilt (RK-B3), while `token_hash` stays for the "already accepted" state.
- **Accept page** `pages::invitations.accept` on the signed `invitations.accept` route (Task 11), guest layout. States in this order (OR-I10, OR-E4): `accepted` ("already accepted — please log in", W5) → `expired` (domain expiry passed; a "Resend invitation" button only for signed-in users who may `remind`, INV-11) → `signed-in` ("You are signed in as :name" with a log-out button, no form) → `form` (name, password, confirmation). `accept()` refuses while anyone is signed in (403, RK-M3). Unknown or cancelled tokens and other hosts answer 404 (friendly wording with M5's 404 page, CV-11); a signature older than the grace period answers 403 (INV-4). The page renders in the invitee's `users.locale`, re-applied on every Livewire update (X12). It sends `Referrer-Policy: no-referrer` (RK-M12). After accepting, the invitee is signed in on this host (session regenerated) and lands on the dashboard with a welcome toast (INV-12).
- Livewire updates of a `signed` page skip the signature check (it is not persistent middleware), so every action re-resolves the `#[Locked]` invitation id under the tenant scope and the actions re-check state.
- **Flash→toast bridge** (RL-11, interim until M5's `layouts/base`): `<x-flash-toast />` in the app layout turns `session('status')` into a Flux toast; the profile page's duplicate status callout is dropped.

**Files:**
- Create: `app/Actions/Invitations/RemindInvitation.php`, `app/Actions/Invitations/AcceptInvitation.php`, `app/Mail/InvitationReminderMail.php`, `resources/views/mail/invitation-reminder.blade.php`, `resources/views/pages/invitations/accept/accept.php`, `resources/views/pages/invitations/accept/accept.blade.php`, `resources/views/components/flash-toast.blade.php`, `app/Http/Middleware/SetReferrerPolicy.php`
- Modify: `routes/admin.php` (`SetReferrerPolicy` on the accept route), `resources/views/layouts/app/sidebar.blade.php` (bridge), `resources/views/pages/settings/profile/profile.blade.php` (status callout removed), `lang/nl.json`, `lang/en.json`
- Test: `tests/Feature/Invitations/RemindInvitationTest.php`, `tests/Feature/Invitations/AcceptInvitationTest.php`, `tests/Feature/Navigation/FlashToastTest.php`

**Interfaces:**
- Consumes:
  - `App\Models\Invitation` (`findByToken()`, `acceptUrl()`, `isExpired()`, `isAccepted()`, `user`, `organisation`), `App\Policies\InvitationPolicy::remind`, `InvitationMail` (pattern), helpers `inviteMember()` and `acceptLinkFor()` (Task 11).
  - `App\Tenancy\HostScope::lockForWrite(Organisation $organisation): Organisation` (Task 7), `Tenant::run()`.
  - `App\Actions\Audit\RecordActivity::handle(...)`, `App\Enums\ActivityEvent::{InvitationReminderSent, InvitationAccepted, Login}`, `recordedActivity()` (Task 1); the `auth.login` entry comes from Task 2's `RecordAuthenticationActivity` listener on `Illuminate\Auth\Events\Login`.
  - `App\Tenancy\Auth\HostLoginRule::allows(User $user): bool`; `App\Concerns\PasswordValidationRules::passwordRules()`; `App\Concerns\ProfileValidationRules::nameRules()`.
  - Test helpers `pageSnapshot(string $url, string $component): array` and `callPageAction(array $snapshot, string $method, array $params = [], array $updates = [], ?string $host = null): TestResponse` (Task 7, `tests/Pest.php`).
- Produces:
  - `App\Actions\Invitations\RemindInvitation::handle(User $actor, Invitation $invitation): void` — authorises `remind`; transaction → `HostScope::lockForWrite()` → `Tenant::run()` → invitation row locked; accepted → `ValidationException` on `invitation` (`__('This invitation has already been accepted.')`); `expires_at` = now + `skv.invitations.expires_in_days`, `reminder_sent_at` = now; logs `InvitationReminderSent` (subject the pending user, `properties` `invitation_id` + `email`, causer the actor); queues `InvitationReminderMail` in the invitee's locale (after commit); refreshes the passed model.
  - `App\Actions\Invitations\AcceptInvitation::handle(Invitation $invitation, string $name, string $password): User` — validates `nameRules()` and `['required', 'string', Password::default()]` (the page validates the confirmation); transaction with the row locked; accepted → `invitation`: `__('This invitation has already been accepted. Please log in.')`; expired → `__('This invitation has expired.')`; pending user trashed, no longer pending or a super admin (§6.3, defence in depth behind `InvitationPolicy`) → `__('This invitation is no longer valid.')`; `forceFill(['name', 'password', 'status' => Active])->saveQuietly()`; `accepted_at` = now, `token` = null; logs `InvitationAccepted` (subject and causer the invitee, `properties` `invitation_id` + `email`); returns the user (the page signs in). Runs on the invitation's tenant host (the bound tenant scopes the lock).
  - `App\Mail\InvitationReminderMail` (final, `ShouldQueue`; `__construct(public Invitation $invitation)` calls `afterCommit()`; markdown `mail.invitation-reminder`).
  - Page `pages::invitations.accept` (`#[Layout('layouts::auth')]`, `#[Title('Accept invitation')]`): `mount(string $token): void` (`Invitation::findByToken()` or 404; applies the invitee's locale); `hydrate(): void` (re-applies it); `#[Locked] public int $invitationId`; `public string $name = ''`, `public string $password = ''`, `public string $password_confirmation = ''`; `#[Computed] state(): string` (`'accepted'|'expired'|'signed-in'|'form'`, in that order); `#[Computed] mayResend(): bool`; `#[Computed] organisationName(): string`; `accept(AcceptInvitation $acceptInvitation, HostLoginRule $hostLoginRule): void` (`abort_if(Auth::check(), 403)`, validates, accepts, `Auth::guard('web')->login()`, `session()->regenerate()`, flashes `status`, redirects to `dashboard`); `resend(RemindInvitation $remindInvitation): void`.
  - `App\Http\Middleware\SetReferrerPolicy::handle(Request $request, Closure $next): Response` — sets `Referrer-Policy: no-referrer`.
  - `<x-flash-toast />` (`resources/views/components/flash-toast.blade.php`) — when `session('status')` is a non-empty string, renders `<div hidden data-flash-toast x-data x-init="…$flux.toast({ text: … })">`; included in `layouts/app/sidebar.blade.php` after the toast group.

```php
<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

/** covers §4.5, §6.2, Appendix A W5, X11 */

use App\Actions\Invitations\RemindInvitation;
use App\Enums\ActivityEvent;
use App\Enums\Locale;
use App\Models\Organisation;

use Carbon\CarbonImmutable;
use Illuminate\Auth\Access\AuthorizationException;
use Illuminate\Mail\Transport\ArrayTransport;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Artisan;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Mail;
use Illuminate\Validation\ValidationException;
use Symfony\Component\Mailer\SentMessage;
use Symfony\Component\Mime\Email;

beforeEach(function (): void {
    config(['queue.default' => 'database']);
});

$queuedReminders = fn (): int => DB::table('jobs')->pluck('payload')
    ->filter(fn (mixed $payload): bool => str_contains((string) $payload, 'InvitationReminderMail'))
    ->count();

$deliveredMails = function (): array {
    $transport = Mail::driver()->getSymfonyTransport();
    $mails = [];

    if ($transport instanceof ArrayTransport) {
        foreach ($transport->messages() as $sent) {
            $message = $sent instanceof SentMessage ? $sent->getOriginalMessage() : null;

            if ($message instanceof Email) {
                $mails[] = $message;
            }
        }
    }

    return $mails;
};

it('renews the expiry, sets reminder_sent_at and queues a reminder (INV-10)', function () use ($queuedReminders): void {
    // Whole seconds: the datetime columns store no microseconds.
    $this->freezeSecond();
    $organisation = Organisation::factory()->create(['slug' => 'acme']);
    $admin = asOrgAdmin($organisation);
    $invitation = inviteMember($organisation, $admin);
    $token = $invitation->token;
    $this->travel(3)->days();

    app(RemindInvitation::class)->handle($admin, $invitation);

    expect($invitation->expires_at->equalTo(now()->addDays(7)))->toBeTrue()
        ->and($invitation->reminder_sent_at?->equalTo(now()))->toBeTrue()
        ->and($invitation->token)->toBe($token)
        ->and($queuedReminders())->toBe(1);
});

    $invitation->forceFill(['accepted_at' => now()])->save();

    expect(fn () => app(RemindInvitation::class)->handle($admin, $invitation))
        ->toThrow(ValidationException::class, __('This invitation has already been accepted.'));
    expect($invitation->refresh()->reminder_sent_at)->toBeNull()
        ->and($queuedReminders())->toBe(0);
});

it('reminds an expired invitation', function (): void {
    $organisation = Organisation::factory()->create(['slug' => 'acme']);
    $admin = asOrgAdmin($organisation);
    $invitation = inviteMember($organisation, $admin);
    $this->travel(8)->days();

    expect($invitation->isExpired())->toBeTrue();

    app(RemindInvitation::class)->handle($admin, $invitation);

    expect($invitation->isExpired())->toBeFalse();
});

it('builds the reminder\'s accept link on the organisation\'s host in the worker, also when a super admin reminds from the admin host (CV-12)', function () use ($deliveredMails): void {
    $organisation = Organisation::factory()->create(['name' => 'Acme', 'slug' => 'acme']);
    $superAdmin = asSuperAdmin();
    onAdminHost();
    $invitation = inviteMember($organisation, $superAdmin);
    DB::table('jobs')->delete();

    app(RemindInvitation::class)->handle($superAdmin, $invitation);

    /** @var array<string, mixed> $payload */
    $payload = json_decode((string) DB::table('jobs')->value('payload'), true, flags: JSON_THROW_ON_ERROR);

    // The action binds the organisation itself (Tenant::run), so the payload carries its id even when the request is on the admin host.
    expect($payload['tenant_id'] ?? null)->toBe($organisation->id);

    // The link must not depend on the worker's tenant: let the worker run the job centrally.
    DB::table('jobs')->update(['payload' => json_encode([...$payload, 'tenant_id' => null], JSON_THROW_ON_ERROR)]);

    Artisan::call('queue:work', ['--once' => true, '--stop-when-empty' => true, '--tries' => 1]);

    $mail = $deliveredMails()[0] ?? throw new RuntimeException('No reminder was delivered.');
    $html = $mail->getHtmlBody();
    preg_match('#https?://[^\s"<>]+/invitations/accept/[^\s"<>]+#', html_entity_decode(is_string($html) ? $html : ''), $matches);
    $link = $matches[0] ?? throw new RuntimeException('The reminder holds no accept link.');
    parse_str((string) parse_url($link, PHP_URL_QUERY), $query);

    expect($mail->getSubject())->toBe(__('Reminder: your invitation to :organisation is waiting', ['organisation' => 'Acme']))
        ->and($link)->toStartWith('http://acme.localhost/invitations/accept/')
        ->and($query['expires'] ?? null)->toBe((string) $invitation->refresh()->expires_at->copy()->addDays(30)->getTimestamp());
});

it('writes the reminder in the invitee\'s language with a localised expiry date (X11)', function () use ($deliveredMails): void {
    $this->travelTo(CarbonImmutable::parse('2026-10-11 09:00:00'));
    $organisation = Organisation::factory()->create(['name' => 'Acme', 'slug' => 'acme']);
    $admin = asOrgAdmin($organisation);
    $invitation = inviteMember($organisation, $admin);
    Tenant::run($organisation, fn (): bool => $invitation->user->forceFill(['locale' => Locale::Dutch])->save());
    // Keep only the reminder: the invitation mail was queued too.
    DB::table('jobs')->delete();

    app(RemindInvitation::class)->handle($admin, $invitation);
    Artisan::call('queue:work', ['--once' => true, '--stop-when-empty' => true, '--tries' => 1]);

    $mail = $deliveredMails()[0] ?? throw new RuntimeException('No reminder was delivered.');
    $html = $mail->getHtmlBody();

    expect($mail->getSubject())->toBe('Herinnering: je uitnodiging voor Acme wacht op je')
        ->and(html_entity_decode(is_string($html) ? $html : ''))->toContain('18 oktober 2026');
});

it('refuses another organisation\'s admin', function (): void {
    $acme = Organisation::factory()->create(['slug' => 'acme']);
    $invitation = inviteMember($acme);
    $betaAdmin = asOrgAdmin(Organisation::factory()->create(['slug' => 'beta']));

    expect(fn () => app(RemindInvitation::class)->handle($betaAdmin, $invitation))->toThrow(AuthorizationException::class);
});

it('records invitation.reminder_sent', function (): void {
    $organisation = Organisation::factory()->create(['slug' => 'acme']);
    $admin = asOrgAdmin($organisation);
    $invitation = inviteMember($organisation, $admin);

    app(RemindInvitation::class)->handle($admin, $invitation);

    $reminded = recordedActivity(ActivityEvent::InvitationReminderSent)->sole();

    expect($reminded->subject_id)->toBe($invitation->user_id)
        ->and($reminded->causer_id)->toBe($admin->id)
        ->and($reminded->organisation_id)->toBe($organisation->id)
        ->and($reminded->properties?->get('invitation_id'))->toBe($invitation->id);
});
```

```php
$tokenOf = fn (Invitation $invitation): string => $invitation->token ?? throw new LogicException('The invitation keeps no token.');

        ->assertOk()
        ->assertSee(__('Choose your name and a password to activate your account.'));

});

it('refuses a forged accept from another tenant host (W14)', function (): void {
    $invitation = inviteMember(Organisation::factory()->create(['slug' => 'acme']));
    Organisation::factory()->create(['slug' => 'beta']);
    $snapshot = pageSnapshot(acceptLinkFor($invitation), 'pages::invitations.accept');

    // Livewire updates skip the route signature, so the host binding rests on the tenant-scoped lookup.
    callPageAction($snapshot, 'accept', [], [
        'name' => 'Mallory',
        'password' => 'secret-password',
        'password_confirmation' => 'secret-password',
    ], host: 'beta.localhost')->assertNotFound();

    expect(DB::table('users')->where('id', $invitation->user_id)->value('status'))->toBe(UserStatus::PendingActivation->value);
    $this->assertGuest();
});

it('clears the stored token on accept so the link cannot be rebuilt (RK-B3)', function (): void {
    $organisation = Organisation::factory()->create(['slug' => 'acme']);
    $invitation = inviteMember($organisation);
    $hash = $invitation->token_hash;
    onTenant($organisation);

    app(AcceptInvitation::class)->handle($invitation, 'Ann Invitee', 'secret-password');

    expect(DB::table('invitations')->where('id', $invitation->id)->value('token'))->toBeNull()
        ->and(DB::table('invitations')->where('id', $invitation->id)->value('token_hash'))->toBe($hash)
        ->and(fn () => $invitation->refresh()->acceptUrl())->toThrow(LogicException::class);
});

it('sends no referrer from the accept page (RK-M12)', function (): void {
    $link = acceptLinkFor(inviteMember(Organisation::factory()->create(['slug' => 'acme'])));

    $this->get($link)->assertOk()->assertHeader('Referrer-Policy', 'no-referrer');
});

it('renders in the invitee\'s language', function (): void {
    $organisation = Organisation::factory()->create(['name' => 'Acme', 'slug' => 'acme']);
    $superAdmin = User::factory()->superAdmin()->create();
    app(SetSuperAdmin::class)->handle($superAdmin, true);
    $templateId = (int) RoleModel::query()->whereNull('team_id')->where('name', Role::OrganisationAdmin->value)->value('id');
    $invitation = app(InviteUser::class)->handle($superAdmin, $organisation, 'invitee@example.com', [$templateId], Locale::Dutch);

    $this->get(acceptLinkFor($invitation))
        ->assertOk()
        ->assertSee('lang="nl"', false)
        ->assertSee('Welkom bij Acme')
        ->assertSee('Kies je naam en een wachtwoord om je account te activeren.');
});

it('rejects a tampered signature with 403', function (): void {
    $link = acceptLinkFor(inviteMember(Organisation::factory()->create(['slug' => 'acme'])));

    $this->get((string) preg_replace('/signature=[0-9a-f]+/', 'signature='.str_repeat('0', 64), $link))->assertForbidden();
});

it('records invitation.accepted and a sign-in', function () use ($tokenOf): void {
    $organisation = Organisation::factory()->create(['slug' => 'acme']);
    $invitation = inviteMember($organisation);
    onTenant($organisation);

    Livewire::test('pages::invitations.accept', ['token' => $tokenOf($invitation)])
        ->set('name', 'Ann Invitee')
        ->set('password', 'secret-password')

        ->and($accepted->causer_id)->toBe($invitation->user_id)
        ->and($accepted->organisation_id)->toBe($organisation->id)
        ->and(recordedActivity(ActivityEvent::Login))->toHaveCount(1);
});
```

`app/Mail/InvitationReminderMail.php`:

```php
<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace App\Mail;

use App\Models\Invitation;
use Illuminate\Bus\Queueable;
use Illuminate\Contracts\Queue\ShouldQueue;
use Illuminate\Mail\Mailable;
use Illuminate\Mail\Mailables\Content;
use Illuminate\Mail\Mailables\Envelope;
use Illuminate\Queue\SerializesModels;
use LogicException;

/**
 * The invitation reminder (§4.5). Like InvitationMail: queued after commit, the accept link built
 * in the worker on the organisation's host (CV-12; it also rebuilds links after a slug rename, X13)
 * and dates in the mail's locale (X11).
 */
final class InvitationReminderMail extends Mailable implements ShouldQueue
{
    use Queueable, SerializesModels;

    public function __construct(public Invitation $invitation)
    {
        $this->afterCommit();
    }

    public function envelope(): Envelope
    {
        return new Envelope(
            subject: __('Reminder: your invitation to :organisation is waiting', ['organisation' => $this->organisationName()]),
        );
    }

    public function content(): Content
    {
        return new Content(
            markdown: 'mail.invitation-reminder',
            with: [
                'organisation' => $this->organisationName(),
                'acceptUrl' => $this->invitation->acceptUrl(),
                'expiresOn' => $this->invitation->expires_at->copy()->locale(app()->getLocale())->isoFormat('LL'),
            ],
        );
    }

    private function organisationName(): string
    {
        return $this->invitation->organisation?->name
            ?? throw new LogicException("Invitation [{$this->invitation->id}] has no active organisation.");
    }
}
```

- [ ] **Step 4: The remind and accept actions**

`app/Actions/Invitations/RemindInvitation.php`:

```php
<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace App\Actions\Invitations;

use App\Actions\Audit\RecordActivity;
use App\Enums\ActivityEvent;
use App\Mail\InvitationReminderMail;
use App\Models\Invitation;
use App\Models\Organisation;
use App\Models\User;
use App\Tenancy\Facades\Tenant;
use App\Tenancy\HostScope;
use Illuminate\Auth\Access\AuthorizationException;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Gate;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Mail;
use Illuminate\Validation\ValidationException;

/**
 * Sends an invitation again (§4.5, C-10): renews the domain expiry, keeps the token, sets
 * reminder_sent_at and queues the reminder after commit. Allowed for an expired invitation,
 * refused once accepted (W5). The mail builds its link in the worker (CV-12).
 */
final class RemindInvitation
{
    public function __construct(private readonly RecordActivity $recordActivity) {}

    /**
     * @throws AuthorizationException
     * @throws ValidationException
     */
    public function handle(User $actor, Invitation $invitation): void
    {
        Gate::forUser($actor)->authorize('remind', $invitation);

        DB::transaction(function () use ($actor, $invitation): void {
            $organisation = HostScope::lockForWrite(Organisation::withTrashed()->findOrFail($invitation->organisation_id));

            Tenant::run($organisation, function () use ($actor, $invitation): void {
                $locked = Invitation::query()->lockForUpdate()->findOrFail($invitation->id);

                if ($locked->isAccepted()) {
                    throw ValidationException::withMessages([
                        'invitation' => __('This invitation has already been accepted.'),
                    ]);
                }

                $locked->forceFill([
                    'expires_at' => now()->addDays((int) config('skv.invitations.expires_in_days', 7)),
                    'reminder_sent_at' => now(),
                ])->save();

                $invitee = $locked->user;

                $this->recordActivity->handle(ActivityEvent::InvitationReminderSent, $invitee, [
                    'invitation_id' => $locked->id,
                    'email' => $invitee->email,
                ], causer: $actor);

                Mail::to($invitee->email)->locale($invitee->locale->value)->queue(new InvitationReminderMail($locked));
            });
        });

        $invitation->refresh();
    }
}
```

`app/Actions/Invitations/AcceptInvitation.php`:

```php
<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace App\Actions\Invitations;

use App\Actions\Audit\RecordActivity;
use App\Concerns\ProfileValidationRules;
use App\Enums\ActivityEvent;
use App\Enums\UserStatus;
use App\Models\Invitation;
use App\Models\User;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Validator;
use Illuminate\Validation\Rules\Password;
use Illuminate\Validation\ValidationException;

/**
 * Accepts an invitation (§4.5) on the invitation's tenant host. The invitation row is locked and
 * its state re-checked inside the transaction (X9), the pending user must still exist, still be
 * pending and not be a super admin (RK-M3, §6.3), the invitee chooses their own name (W14), and the stored token copy is cleared so
 * the link can never be rebuilt (RK-B3). The user is saved quietly because this action records its
 * own event (RL-6). Signing in is the caller's job.
 */
final class AcceptInvitation
{
    use ProfileValidationRules;

    public function __construct(private readonly RecordActivity $recordActivity) {}

    /** @throws ValidationException */
    public function handle(Invitation $invitation, string $name, string $password): User
    {
        $name = trim($name);

        Validator::make(['name' => $name, 'password' => $password], [
            'name' => $this->nameRules(),
            'password' => ['required', 'string', Password::default()],
        ])->validate();

        return DB::transaction(function () use ($invitation, $name, $password): User {
            $locked = Invitation::query()->lockForUpdate()->find($invitation->id)
                ?? throw ValidationException::withMessages(['invitation' => __('This invitation is no longer valid.')]);

            if ($locked->isAccepted()) {
                throw ValidationException::withMessages([
                    'invitation' => __('This invitation has already been accepted. Please log in.'),
                ]);
            }

            if ($locked->isExpired()) {
                throw ValidationException::withMessages(['invitation' => __('This invitation has expired.')]);
            }

            $invitee = $locked->user;

            // A pending user who became a super admin is never activated through a link (§6.3).
            if ($invitee->trashed() || $invitee->status !== UserStatus::PendingActivation || $invitee->isSuperAdmin()) {
                throw ValidationException::withMessages(['invitation' => __('This invitation is no longer valid.')]);
            }

            $invitee->forceFill([
                'name' => $name,
                'password' => $password,
                'status' => UserStatus::Active,
            ])->saveQuietly();

            $locked->forceFill(['accepted_at' => now(), 'token' => null])->save();

            $this->recordActivity->handle(ActivityEvent::InvitationAccepted, $invitee, [
                'invitation_id' => $locked->id,
                'email' => $invitee->email,
            ], causer: $invitee);

            return $invitee;
        });
    }
}
```

`app/Http/Middleware/SetReferrerPolicy.php`:

```php
<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace App\Http\Middleware;

use Closure;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use Symfony\Component\HttpFoundation\Response;

/** The accept page's token and signature are in its URL, so it never leaks them as a referrer (RK-M12). */
final class SetReferrerPolicy
{
    /** @param  Closure(Request): Response  $next */
    public function handle(Request $request, Closure $next): Response
    {
        $response = $next($request);
        $response->headers->set('Referrer-Policy', 'no-referrer');

        return $response;
    }
}
```
