Create the component with `php artisan make:livewire pages::invitations.accept --no-interaction` (multi-file, no emoji, per `config/livewire.php`), then replace both files.

`resources/views/pages/invitations/accept/accept.php`:

```php
<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

use App\Actions\Invitations\AcceptInvitation;
use App\Actions\Invitations\RemindInvitation;
use App\Concerns\PasswordValidationRules;
use App\Concerns\ProfileValidationRules;
use App\Models\Invitation;
use App\Models\User;
use App\Tenancy\Auth\HostLoginRule;
use Flux\Flux;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Auth;
use Livewire\Attributes\Computed;
use Livewire\Attributes\Layout;
use Livewire\Attributes\Locked;
use Livewire\Attributes\Title;
use Livewire\Component;

/*
 * The invitation accept page (§4.5, RL-15). The route is signed, but Livewire updates skip the
 * signature, so every request re-resolves the locked invitation id under the tenant scope and the
 * actions re-check its state.
 */
new #[Layout('layouts::auth')] #[Title('Accept invitation')] class extends Component
{
    use PasswordValidationRules;
    use ProfileValidationRules;

    #[Locked]
    public int $invitationId;

    public string $name = '';

    public string $password = '';

    public string $password_confirmation = '';

    private ?Invitation $resolvedInvitation = null;

    /**
     * Find the invitation on this host only: another organisation's host, the apex and the admin host answer 404 (W14).
     */
    public function mount(string $token): void
    {
        $invitation = Invitation::findByToken($token);

        if (! $invitation instanceof Invitation) {
            abort(404);
        }

        $this->invitationId = $invitation->id;
        $this->resolvedInvitation = $invitation;
        $this->useInviteeLocale();
    }

    /**
     * Keep the invitee's language on every Livewire update (X12).
     */
    public function hydrate(): void
    {
        $this->useInviteeLocale();
    }

    /**
     * The page state, in this order: accepted, expired, signed in, form (OR-I10).
     *
     * @return 'accepted'|'expired'|'signed-in'|'form'
     */
    #[Computed]
    public function state(): string
    {
        $invitation = $this->invitation();

        return match (true) {
            $invitation->isAccepted() => 'accepted',
            $invitation->isExpired() => 'expired',
            Auth::check() => 'signed-in',
            default => 'form',
        };
    }

    /**
     * Whether the signed-in visitor may send the invitation again (INV-11).
     */
    #[Computed]
    public function mayResend(): bool
    {
        $user = Auth::user();

        return $user instanceof User && $user->can('remind', $this->invitation());
    }

    #[Computed]
    public function organisationName(): string
    {
        return $this->invitation()->organisation?->name ?? '';
    }

    /**
     * Activate the account with the chosen name and password and sign the invitee in on this host (W14).
     */
    public function accept(AcceptInvitation $acceptInvitation, HostLoginRule $hostLoginRule): void
    {
        // A forged update from the "signed in as" state never replaces the visitor's session (RK-M3).
        abort_if(Auth::check(), 403);

        $this->validate([
            'name' => $this->nameRules(),
            'password' => $this->passwordRules(),
        ]);

        $user = $acceptInvitation->handle($this->invitation(), $this->name, $this->password);

        abort_unless($hostLoginRule->allows($user), 403);

        $this->reset('password', 'password_confirmation');

        Auth::guard('web')->login($user);
        session()->regenerate();
        session()->flash('status', __('Welcome, your account is ready.'));

        $this->redirectRoute('dashboard');
    }

    /**
     * Send the invitation again from the expired state (INV-11); RemindInvitation authorises.
     */
    public function resend(RemindInvitation $remindInvitation): void
    {
        $actor = Auth::user();

        if (! $actor instanceof User) {
            abort(403);
        }

        $remindInvitation->handle($actor, $this->invitation());

        Flux::toast(variant: 'success', text: __('Invitation reminder sent.'));
    }

    private function invitation(): Invitation
    {
        return $this->resolvedInvitation ??= Invitation::query()->findOrFail($this->invitationId);
    }

    private function useInviteeLocale(): void
    {
        app()->setLocale($this->invitation()->user->locale->value);
    }
};
```

In `resources/views/layouts/app/sidebar.blade.php`, directly after the toast group (after `@endpersist`, before `@fluxScripts`), add:

```blade
        <x-flash-toast />
```

so that block reads:

```blade
        @persist('toast')
            <flux:toast.group>
                <flux:toast />
            </flux:toast.group>
        @endpersist

        <x-flash-toast />

        @fluxScripts
```

(The bridge sits after the toast group, so Alpine has bound the group's `toast-show` listener when the bridge's `x-init` runs; `$nextTick` adds a tick of margin. `Js::from()` escapes quotes and tags for the attribute. Statuses can be notices or refusals, so the toast has no variant.)

```bash
  stored token and signs the invitee in (W14, X9, RK-B3, RK-M3, §6.3)
- reminders renew the expiry, are refused once accepted and build their link in the worker (W5, CV-12)
- no referrer from the accept page; status flashes show as toasts on app pages

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>"
```

**Matrix rows:** none new (`invitations.accept` was excluded in Task 11; its hosts are covered by `AcceptInvitationTest`).

### Task 13: Invite page and pending invitations list

**Covers:** INV-1 (page), INV-8 (list), INV-9, INV-16 (copy link), INV-17 (organisation picker), TEN-3, TEN-4, DEC26-1, W4, R-5, RL-8, RL-9, RL-11 (navigation), RL-13, RL-16 (pending row link); RK-B3, RK-I4, RK-I11, RK-M4, OR-M7, CV-20.

What this task builds, and the rules it must keep:
- **Invite page** `GET /users/invite` (`users.invite`, any host, route gate `users.create`). On a tenant host it invites into that host's organisation and the page itself needs `InvitationPolicy::create` (`users.create` **and** `roles.assign`, own organisation — OR-M7), checked in `mount()`; a role offering only `users.create` gets 403. On a central host only super admins reach it (the membership middleware signs everyone else out) and they must pick an organisation first (INV-17). Fields: email address, language (`App\Enums\Locale`, default `Locale::default()`), roles (`flux:checkbox.group`: the organisation_admin template plus the team roles of the host's or the picked organisation). Submitting re-authorises `InvitationPolicy::create` on the component for the organisation it is about to invite into (components authorise before calling an action; super admins pass through `Gate::before`) and calls `InviteUser` (Task 11), which authorises again, locks the organisation (archived or foreign → refused, RK-I11), validates the address (generic message for other organisations, W9) and at least one role (W14), creates the pending user and the invitation and queues the mail after commit. The page then redirects with a `status` flash, which the flash→toast bridge (Task 12) shows: to the pending list when the inviter holds `users.view` (the pending list's route gate), otherwise to the dashboard, so a custom role with `users.create` and `roles.assign` but without `users.view` never lands on a 403; the page's Cancel button uses the same target. A forged organisation id on a tenant host is ignored (the host's organisation is used); roles and organisation names of other organisations never render on a tenant host (RK-I4).
- **Pending invitations list** `GET /invitations/pending` (`invitations.pending`, any host, route gate `users.view`). Lists open invitations (not accepted; cancelled ones are gone) with the invitee's address, the inviter's name, the relative expiry and an "Expired" badge; on central hosts also the organisation column and an `?organisation=` filter (ignored on a tenant host, RK-I4). Row actions: **Send again** (`remind`, `users.invite.resend`), **Copy invite link** (`viewLink`: `remind` conditions plus `roles.assign` plus the pending user's permissions ⊆ the actor's — the link is a bearer credential for the invitation's roles, RK-B3; the link is rendered only in a modal after `showLink()` was authorised, never in the table HTML), **Cancel invitation** (`cancel`, `users.delete`, confirmation modal). Invitations are read through `HostScope::read()` (tenant host: scoped; super admin centrally: all organisations), so a forged id of another organisation's invitation answers 404 on a tenant host (TEN-3). A deleted inviter never breaks the list: names come from `App\Tenancy\UserNames` (cross-organisation, deleted users included), and an inviter row that was removed for good shows "Deleted user" (W4, INV-9, R-5). `UserNames` is fed only ids taken from rows this page read through its scope (RL-9, RK-M4).
- **Navigation:** a "Pending invitations" item in the interim Administration sidebar group (Task 8) for `users.view` holders; an "Invite user" button on the users index and the pending list, shown only to actors who may create invitations here; pending users' names on the users index link to the pending list instead of offering delete (CV-20).

- Modify: `routes/admin.php`, `resources/views/layouts/app/sidebar.blade.php`, `resources/views/pages/users/index/index.php` (`canInvite()`), `resources/views/pages/users/index/index.blade.php` ("Invite user" button; pending rows link to the pending list), `tests/Feature/Tenancy/RouteHostMatrixTest.php`, `tests/Feature/Navigation/AdministrationLinksTest.php`, `tests/Feature/Users/UsersIndexTest.php`, `lang/nl.json`, `lang/en.json`

```php
<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

/** covers §4.5, §6.2 */

use App\Authorization\Permission;
use App\Authorization\Role;
use App\Enums\Locale;
use App\Models\Invitation;

use App\Tenancy\Facades\Tenant;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;
use Livewire\Livewire;
use Spatie\Permission\Models\Role as RoleModel;

$makeRole = fn (Organisation $organisation, string $name): RoleModel => RoleModel::query()->create([
    'name' => $name,
    'guard_name' => 'web',
    'team_id' => $organisation->id,
]);

$templateRoleId = fn (): int => (int) RoleModel::query()
    ->whereNull('team_id')
    ->where('name', Role::OrganisationAdmin->value)
    ->value('id');

it('invites from a tenant host with that organisation\'s roles', function () use ($makeRole): void {
    $acme = Organisation::factory()->create(['slug' => 'acme']);
    $beta = Organisation::factory()->create(['slug' => 'beta']);
    $editor = $makeRole($acme, 'acme-editor');
    $makeRole($beta, 'beta-secret-role');
    asOrgAdmin($acme);

    // The suite runs with APP_LOCALE=en (phpunit.xml), so the default is English and picking Dutch proves the
    // chosen language is passed on.
    Livewire::test('pages::users.invite')
        ->assertSet('locale', Locale::default()->value)
        ->assertSee('acme-editor')
        ->assertDontSee('beta-secret-role')
        ->set('email', 'New.Person@Example.com')
        ->set('roles', [(string) $editor->id])
        ->set('locale', Locale::Dutch->value)
        ->call('invite')
        ->assertHasNoErrors()
        ->assertRedirect(route('invitations.pending'));

    $pending = User::query()->where('email', 'new.person@example.com')->sole();

    expect($pending->organisation_id)->toBe($acme->id)
        ->and($pending->locale)->toBe(Locale::Dutch)
        ->and(Invitation::query()->where('user_id', $pending->id)->exists())->toBeTrue()
        ->and(DB::table('model_has_roles')->where('model_id', $pending->id)->where('team_id', $acme->id)->pluck('role_id')->map(fn (mixed $id): int => (int) $id)->all())
        ->toBe([(int) $editor->id])
        ->and(session('status'))->toBe(__('Invitation sent to :email.', ['email' => 'new.person@example.com']));
});

it('refuses an unsupported language', function () use ($makeRole): void {
    $acme = Organisation::factory()->create(['slug' => 'acme']);
    $editor = $makeRole($acme, 'acme-editor');
    asOrgAdmin($acme);

    Livewire::test('pages::users.invite')
        ->set('email', 'x@example.com')
        ->set('roles', [(string) $editor->id])
        ->set('locale', 'xx')
        ->call('invite')
        ->assertHasErrors(['locale']);

    expect(DB::table('users')->where('email', 'x@example.com')->exists())->toBeFalse();
});

it('sends an inviter without users.view to the dashboard instead of the pending list', function () use ($makeRole): void {
    $acme = Organisation::factory()->create(['slug' => 'acme']);
    $editor = $makeRole($acme, 'acme-editor');
    // May invite (users.create and roles.assign) but may not open the pending list (users.view).
    $inviter = User::factory()->for($acme)->create();
    $role = $makeRole($acme, 'inviter');
    $role->givePermissionTo([Permission::UsersCreate->value, Permission::RolesAssign->value]);
    withPermissionsTeam($acme->id, fn () => $inviter->assignRole($role));
    $inviter->unsetRelation('roles');
    $this->actingAs($inviter);
    onTenant($acme);

    Livewire::test('pages::users.invite')
        ->assertSeeHtml('href="'.route('dashboard').'"')
        ->assertDontSeeHtml('href="'.route('invitations.pending').'"')
        ->set('email', 'helper@example.com')
        ->set('roles', [(string) $editor->id])
        ->call('invite')
        ->assertHasNoErrors()
        ->assertRedirect(route('dashboard'));

    expect((int) DB::table('users')->where('email', 'helper@example.com')->value('organisation_id'))->toBe($acme->id);
});

it('requires a super admin on a central host to pick an organisation (INV-17)', function () use ($templateRoleId): void {
    $acme = Organisation::factory()->create(['name' => 'Acme Corp', 'slug' => 'acme']);

        ->set('email', 'first@example.com')
        ->call('invite')

    // A new pick clears the roles, so the roles are chosen after the organisation.
    $page->set('organisationId', $acme->id)
        ->set('roles', [(string) $templateRoleId()])
        ->call('invite')
        ->assertHasNoErrors()
        ->assertRedirect(route('invitations.pending'));

    expect(Tenant::run($acme, fn (): int => Invitation::query()->count()))->toBe(1);
});

it('ignores a forged organisation id on a tenant host', function () use ($templateRoleId): void {
    $acme = Organisation::factory()->create(['slug' => 'acme']);

it('shows no other organisation\'s names or roles on a tenant host (RK-I4)', function () use ($makeRole): void {

it('answers 403 without users.create, and for a users.create holder without roles.assign (OR-M7)', function () use ($makeRole): void {

    asMember($organisation);

    $this->get(route('users.invite'))->assertForbidden();

    $this->actingAs($creator);
```

`tests/Feature/Invitations/PendingInvitationsTest.php`:

```php
<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

/** covers §4.5, §6.2 */

use App\Actions\Invitations\InviteUser;
use App\Authorization\Permission;
use App\Authorization\Role;
use App\Enums\Locale;
use App\Models\Invitation;
use App\Models\Organisation;
use App\Models\User;
use App\Tenancy\Facades\Tenant;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;
use Livewire\Livewire;
use Spatie\Permission\Models\Role as RoleModel;

/** An organisation admin who is not signed in (asOrgAdmin() would sign in and switch hosts). */
$adminOf = function (Organisation $organisation, ?string $name = null): User {
    $admin = User::factory()->for($organisation)->create($name === null ? [] : ['name' => $name]);
    withPermissionsTeam($organisation->id, fn () => $admin->assignRole(Role::OrganisationAdmin->value));
    $admin->unsetRelation('roles');

    return $admin;
};

/** Invites with the organisation_admin template, bound to the organisation like a request on its host. */
$invite = fn (User $inviter, Organisation $organisation, string $email): Invitation => Tenant::run(
    $organisation,
    fn (): Invitation => app(InviteUser::class)->handle(
        $inviter,
        $organisation,
        $email,
        [(int) RoleModel::query()->whereNull('team_id')->where('name', Role::OrganisationAdmin->value)->value('id')],
        Locale::English,
    ),
);

it('lists the own organisation\'s open invitations with inviter and relative expiry', function () use ($adminOf, $invite): void {
    $this->freezeTime();
    $acme = Organisation::factory()->create(['slug' => 'acme']);
    $beta = Organisation::factory()->create(['slug' => 'beta']);
    $ada = $adminOf($acme, 'Ada Admin');
    $open = $invite($ada, $acme, 'open@example.com');
    $accepted = $invite($ada, $acme, 'accepted@example.com');
    DB::table('invitations')->where('id', $accepted->id)->update(['accepted_at' => now()]);
    $invite($adminOf($beta), $beta, 'beta-invitee@example.com');
    asOrgAdmin($acme);

    $this->get(route('invitations.pending'))
        ->assertOk()
        ->assertSee('open@example.com')
        ->assertSee('Ada Admin')
        ->assertSee($open->expires_at->diffForHumans())
        ->assertDontSee('accepted@example.com')
        ->assertDontSee('beta-invitee@example.com');
});

it('keeps working when the inviter was deleted (W4)', function () use ($adminOf, $invite): void {
    $organisation = Organisation::factory()->create();
    $ada = $adminOf($organisation, 'Ada Admin');
    $bob = $adminOf($organisation, 'Bob Admin');
    $invite($ada, $organisation, 'from-ada@example.com');
    $invite($bob, $organisation, 'from-bob@example.com');
    // Ada is soft-deleted; Bob's row is removed for good, so invited_by becomes null (nullOnDelete).
    DB::table('users')->where('id', $ada->id)->update(['deleted_at' => now()]);
    DB::table('model_has_roles')->where('model_id', $bob->id)->delete();
    DB::table('users')->where('id', $bob->id)->delete();
    asOrgAdmin($organisation);

    $this->get(route('invitations.pending'))
        ->assertOk()
        ->assertSee('from-ada@example.com')
        ->assertSee('Ada Admin')
        ->assertSee('from-bob@example.com')
        ->assertSee(__('Deleted user'))
        ->assertDontSee('Bob Admin');
});

it('leaves out a hand-set pending user without an invitation (W4)', function (): void {
    $organisation = Organisation::factory()->create();
    User::factory()->for($organisation)->pending()->create(['email' => 'hand-set@example.com']);
    asOrgAdmin($organisation);

    $this->get(route('invitations.pending'))
        ->assertOk()
        ->assertDontSee('hand-set@example.com')
        ->assertSee(__('No open invitations.'));
});

it('reminds and cancels from the list', function () use ($invite): void {
    $organisation = Organisation::factory()->create();
    $admin = asOrgAdmin($organisation);
    $first = $invite($admin, $organisation, 'first@example.com');
    $second = $invite($admin, $organisation, 'second@example.com');

    Livewire::test('pages::invitations.pending')
        ->call('remind', $first->id)
        ->assertHasNoErrors()
        ->assertDispatched('toast-show')
        ->call('confirmCancel', $second->id)

        ->and(Invitation::withTrashed()->find($second->id))->toBeNull()
        ->and(User::withTrashed()->find($second->user_id)?->trashed())->toBeTrue();
});

it('shows the invite link only to users who could grant its roles and refuses a forged showLink (INV-16, RK-B3)', function () use ($adminOf, $invite): void {
    $organisation = Organisation::factory()->create(['slug' => 'acme']);

    $snapshot = pageSnapshot(route('invitations.pending'), 'pages::invitations.pending');

    asOrgAdmin($organisation);

    $this->get(route('invitations.pending'))
        ->assertOk()
        ->assertSee('data-test="show-link-'.$invitation->id.'"', false)
        ->assertDontSee('/invitations/accept/', false);
```

- [ ] **Step 3: Cross-organisation display names**

`app/Tenancy/UserNames.php`:

```php
<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace App\Tenancy;

use App\Models\User;
use App\Tenancy\Facades\Tenant;

/**
 * Display names of users across organisations, super admins and deleted users included, for inviters,
 * causers and impersonators (§4.5, §4.8, RL-9). Callers pass only ids taken from rows they already read
 * through their own scope, never an id the client sent (RK-M4). Unknown ids are left out; callers show
 * "Deleted user" for them (W4).
 */
final class UserNames
{
    /**
     * @param  list<int>  $ids
     * @return array<int, string>
     */
    public static function of(array $ids): array
    {
        $ids = array_values(array_unique($ids));

        if ($ids === []) {
            return [];
        }

        return Tenant::bypass(fn (): array => User::withTrashed()
            ->whereKey($ids)
            ->pluck('name', 'id')
            ->mapWithKeys(fn (mixed $name, mixed $id): array => [(int) $id => (string) $name])
            ->all());
    }
}
```

```php
<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

use App\Actions\Invitations\InviteUser;
use App\Authorization\Permission;
use App\Authorization\Role;
use App\Authorization\SyncPermissions;
use App\Concerns\ResolvesCurrentUser;
use App\Enums\Locale;
use App\Models\Invitation;
use App\Models\Organisation;
use App\Tenancy\Facades\Tenant;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Builder;
use Illuminate\Support\Str;
use Illuminate\Validation\Rule;
use Illuminate\Validation\ValidationException;
use Livewire\Attributes\Computed;
use Livewire\Attributes\Title;
use Livewire\Component;
use Spatie\Permission\Models\Role as RoleModel;

/**
 * Invite a user by email with a language and at least one role (§4.5). A tenant host invites into its own
 * organisation; on a central host a super admin picks the organisation first (INV-17). InviteUser
 * authorises, locks the organisation and validates the address and the roles; this page only collects
 * the input.
 */
new #[Title('Invite user')] class extends Component
{
    use ResolvesCurrentUser;

    public string $email = '';

    public string $locale = '';

    /** @var list<int|string> Checkbox values arrive as strings. */
    public array $roles = [];

    /** The organisation picked on a central host; a tenant host always uses its own organisation (RK-I4). */
    public ?int $organisationId = null;

    /** Tenant host: users.create and roles.assign in this organisation (OR-M7); central hosts: super admins only. */
    public function mount(): void
    {
        $organisation = Tenant::current();

        if ($organisation instanceof Organisation) {
            $this->authorize('create', [Invitation::class, $organisation]);
        } else {
            abort_unless($this->currentUser()->isSuperAdmin(), 403);
        }

        $this->locale = Locale::default()->value;
    }

    /** Roles belong to one organisation, so a new pick clears them. */
    public function updatedOrganisationId(): void
    {
        $this->roles = [];
    }

    public function invite(InviteUser $inviteUser): void
    {
        $this->validate([
            'email' => ['required', 'string', 'email', 'max:255'],
            'locale' => ['required', 'string', Rule::enum(Locale::class)],
            'roles' => ['array'],
            'roles.*' => ['integer'],
        ]);

        $email = trim($this->email);
        $organisation = $this->organisationToInvite();

        // Components authorise before calling an action; super admins pass through Gate::before ('create' is not always checked).
        $this->authorize('create', [Invitation::class, $organisation]);

        $inviteUser->handle(
            $this->currentUser(),
            $organisation,
            $email,
            array_map(fn (int|string $roleId): int => (int) $roleId, $this->roles),
            Locale::from($this->locale),
        );

        session()->flash('status', __('Invitation sent to :email.', ['email' => Str::lower($email)]));
        $this->redirectRoute($this->returnRoute(), navigate: true);
    }

    /** The pending list needs users.view; an inviter without it goes back to the dashboard instead of a 403. */
    #[Computed]
    public function returnRoute(): string
    {
        return $this->currentUser()->can(Permission::UsersView) ? 'invitations.pending' : 'dashboard';
    }

    /** @return array<int, string> Active organisations, for the central picker only. */
    #[Computed]
    public function organisationOptions(): array
    {
        if (Tenant::check()) {
            return [];
        }

        return Organisation::query()
            ->orderBy('name')
            ->pluck('name', 'id')
            ->mapWithKeys(fn (mixed $name, mixed $id): array => [(int) $id => (string) $name])
            ->all();
    }

    /** @return array<int, string> The organisation_admin template and the team roles of the host's or the picked organisation (RK-I4). */
    #[Computed]
    public function roleOptions(): array
    {
        $current = Tenant::current();
        $teamId = $current instanceof Organisation ? $current->id : $this->pickedOrganisationId();

        if ($teamId === null) {
            return [];
        }

        return RoleModel::query()
            ->where('guard_name', SyncPermissions::GUARD)
            ->where(function (Builder $query) use ($teamId): void {
                $query->where('team_id', $teamId)
                    ->orWhere(fn (Builder $template): Builder => $template->whereNull('team_id')->where('name', Role::OrganisationAdmin->value));
            })
            ->orderBy('name')
            ->get(['id', 'name', 'team_id'])
            ->mapWithKeys(fn (RoleModel $role): array => [
                (int) $role->id => $role->team_id === null ? Role::OrganisationAdmin->label() : (string) $role->name,
            ])
            ->all();
    }

    /**
     * The host's organisation, or the central pick. Archived picks are passed on on purpose: InviteUser
     * refuses them under its own lock (RK-I11).
     *
     * @throws ValidationException
     */
    private function organisationToInvite(): Organisation
    {
        $current = Tenant::current();

        if ($current instanceof Organisation) {
            return $current;
        }

        $organisationId = $this->pickedOrganisationId();
        $organisation = $organisationId === null ? null : Organisation::withTrashed()->find($organisationId);

        return $organisation ?? throw ValidationException::withMessages([
            'organisationId' => __('Choose an organisation first.'),
        ]);
    }

    /** Livewire unsets a typed int property that receives an empty string, so read it null-safely. */
    private function pickedOrganisationId(): ?int
    {
        return $this->organisationId ?? null;
    }
};
```

Run: `php artisan make:livewire pages::invitations.pending --no-interaction`, then replace both files.

`resources/views/pages/invitations/pending/pending.php`:

```php
<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

use App\Actions\Invitations\CancelInvitation;
use App\Actions\Invitations\RemindInvitation;
use App\Concerns\ResolvesCurrentUser;
use App\Models\Invitation;
use App\Models\Organisation;
use App\Tenancy\Facades\Tenant;
use App\Tenancy\HostScope;
use App\Tenancy\UserNames;
use Flux\Flux;
use Illuminate\Contracts\Pagination\LengthAwarePaginator;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Builder;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Gate;
use Livewire\Attributes\Computed;
use Livewire\Attributes\Locked;
use Livewire\Attributes\Title;
use Livewire\Attributes\Url;
use Livewire\Component;
use Livewire\WithPagination;

/**
 * Open invitations (§4.5): inviter, relative expiry, send again (users.invite.resend), copy the invite link
 * (viewLink, RK-B3) and cancel (users.delete). Invitations are read through the host's scope, so another
 * organisation's id is not found on a tenant host (TEN-3); central hosts list every organisation's
 * invitations with an organisation filter that tenant hosts ignore (RK-I4).
 */
new #[Title('Pending invitations')] class extends Component
{
    use ResolvesCurrentUser, WithPagination;

    /** Central hosts only; ignored on a tenant host (RK-I4). */
    #[Url]
    public string $organisation = '';

    #[Locked]
    public ?int $cancellingInvitationId = null;

    #[Locked]
    public string $cancellingEmail = '';

    #[Locked]
    public ?int $linkInvitationId = null;

    public bool $showCancelModal = false;

    public bool $showLinkModal = false;

    /**
     * The current page, read once per request; private properties are never dehydrated.
     *
     * @var LengthAwarePaginator<int, Invitation>|null
     */
    private ?LengthAwarePaginator $invitationsPage = null;

    public function updatedOrganisation(): void
    {
        $this->resetPage();
    }

    /** Sends the invitation again with a renewed expiry (W5: refused once accepted, by the action). */
    public function remind(int $invitationId, RemindInvitation $remindInvitation): void
    {
        $invitation = $this->findInvitation($invitationId);
        $this->authorize('remind', $invitation);

        $remindInvitation->handle($this->currentUser(), $invitation);

        Flux::toast(variant: 'success', text: __('The invitation was sent again.'));
    }

    public function confirmCancel(int $invitationId): void
    {
        $invitation = $this->findInvitation($invitationId);
        $this->authorize('cancel', $invitation);

        $this->cancellingInvitationId = $invitation->id;
        $this->cancellingEmail = $invitation->user->email;
        $this->showCancelModal = true;
    }

    /** Re-resolves and re-authorises: the locked id may come from a replayed snapshot of another session. */
    public function cancel(CancelInvitation $cancelInvitation): void
    {
        $invitation = $this->findInvitation($this->cancellingInvitationId ?? abort(404));
        $this->authorize('cancel', $invitation);

        $cancelInvitation->handle($this->currentUser(), $invitation);

        $this->closeCancelModal();
        Flux::toast(variant: 'success', text: __('The invitation was cancelled.'));
    }

    public function closeCancelModal(): void
    {
        $this->reset('cancellingInvitationId', 'cancellingEmail', 'showCancelModal');
    }

    /** RK-B3: the link is a bearer credential for the invitation's roles; only actors who could grant them see it. */
    public function showLink(int $invitationId): void
    {
        $invitation = $this->findInvitation($invitationId);
        $this->authorize('viewLink', $invitation);

        $this->linkInvitationId = $invitation->id;
        $this->showLinkModal = true;
    }

    public function closeLinkModal(): void
    {
        $this->reset('linkInvitationId', 'showLinkModal');
    }

    /**
     * Memoised in $invitationsPage so the paginate query runs once per request. PHP code calls this method,
     * never the magic computed property (Larastan level 8 has no Livewire computed support).
     *
     * @return LengthAwarePaginator<int, Invitation>
     */
    #[Computed]
    public function invitations(): LengthAwarePaginator
    {
        if ($this->invitationsPage instanceof LengthAwarePaginator) {
            return $this->invitationsPage;
        }

        $central = ! Tenant::check();
        $organisationId = $central ? filter_var($this->organisation, FILTER_VALIDATE_INT) : false;

        /** @var LengthAwarePaginator<int, Invitation> $invitations */
        $invitations = HostScope::read(fn (): LengthAwarePaginator => Invitation::query()
            ->whereNull('accepted_at')
            ->when($organisationId !== false, fn (Builder $query): Builder => $query->where('organisation_id', $organisationId))
            ->with($central ? ['user', 'organisation'] : ['user'])
            ->orderBy('expires_at')
            ->orderBy('id')
            ->paginate(25));

        return $this->invitationsPage = $invitations;
    }

    /** @return array<int, string> Inviters of this page's rows only (RL-9). */
    #[Computed]
    public function inviterNames(): array
    {
        $ids = [];

        foreach ($this->invitations()->items() as $invitation) {
            if ($invitation->invited_by !== null) {
                $ids[] = $invitation->invited_by;
            }
        }

        return UserNames::of(array_values(array_unique($ids)));
    }

    /** @return list<int> Rows whose invite link this actor may see (RK-B3). */
    #[Computed]
    public function linkableIds(): array
    {
        $ids = [];

        foreach ($this->invitations()->items() as $invitation) {
            if (Gate::allows('viewLink', $invitation)) {
                $ids[] = $invitation->id;
            }
        }

        return $ids;
    }

    /** The accept link for the modal, re-authorised on every render and never part of the table. */
    #[Computed]
    public function inviteLink(): ?string
    {
        $invitationId = $this->linkInvitationId;

        if ($invitationId === null) {
            return null;
        }

        $invitation = HostScope::read(fn (): ?Invitation => Invitation::query()
            ->with('user')
            ->whereNull('accepted_at')
            ->find($invitationId));

        return $invitation instanceof Invitation && Gate::allows('viewLink', $invitation) ? $invitation->acceptUrl() : null;
    }

    /** Tenant host: the invitation policy (users.create and roles.assign, OR-M7); central hosts: super admins. */
    #[Computed]
    public function canInvite(): bool
    {
        $organisation = Tenant::current();

        return $organisation === null
            ? $this->currentUser()->isSuperAdmin()
            : Gate::allows('create', [Invitation::class, $organisation]);
    }

    #[Computed]
    public function showsOrganisations(): bool
    {
        return ! Tenant::check();
    }

    /** @return array<int, string> */
    #[Computed]
    public function organisationOptions(): array
    {
        if (Tenant::check()) {
            return [];
        }

        return Organisation::query()
            ->orderBy('name')
            ->pluck('name', 'id')
            ->mapWithKeys(fn (mixed $name, mixed $id): array => [(int) $id => (string) $name])
            ->all();
    }

    /** Through the host's scope: on a tenant host another organisation's id is not found (TEN-3). */
    private function findInvitation(int $invitationId): Invitation
    {
        return HostScope::read(fn (): Invitation => Invitation::query()->with('user')->findOrFail($invitationId));
    }
};
```

```blade
                        <div class="flex justify-end gap-2">
                            @can('remind', $invitation)
                                <flux:button size="sm" variant="ghost" icon="paper-airplane" wire:click="remind({{ $invitation->id }})" data-test="remind-{{ $invitation->id }}">
                                    {{ __('Send again') }}
                                </flux:button>
                            @endcan

                            @if (in_array($invitation->id, $this->linkableIds, true))
                                <flux:button size="sm" variant="ghost" icon="link" wire:click="showLink({{ $invitation->id }})" data-test="show-link-{{ $invitation->id }}">
                                    {{ __('Copy invite link') }}
                                </flux:button>
                            @endif

                            @can('cancel', $invitation)
                                <flux:button size="sm" variant="ghost" icon="x-mark" wire:click="confirmCancel({{ $invitation->id }})" data-test="cancel-{{ $invitation->id }}">
                                    {{ __('Cancel invitation') }}
                                </flux:button>
                            @endcan
                        </div>
                    </flux:table.cell>
                </flux:table.row>
            @empty
                <flux:table.row>
                    <flux:table.cell colspan="5">{{ __('No open invitations.') }}</flux:table.cell>
                </flux:table.row>
            @endforelse
        </flux:table.rows>
    </flux:table>

    <flux:modal name="cancel-invitation" class="max-w-md md:min-w-md" wire:model="showCancelModal" @close="closeCancelModal">
        <div class="space-y-6">
            <div class="space-y-2">
                <flux:heading size="lg">{{ __('Cancel invitation?') }}</flux:heading>
                <flux:text>{{ __('The link stops working and :email can be invited again later.', ['email' => $cancellingEmail]) }}</flux:text>
            </div>

            <div class="flex justify-end gap-3">
                <flux:button variant="outline" wire:click="closeCancelModal">{{ __('Keep invitation') }}</flux:button>
                <flux:button variant="danger" wire:click="cancel" data-test="confirm-cancel-invitation">{{ __('Cancel invitation') }}</flux:button>
            </div>
        </div>
    </flux:modal>

    <flux:modal name="invite-link" class="max-w-lg md:min-w-lg" wire:model="showLinkModal" @close="closeLinkModal">
        <div class="space-y-6">
            <div class="space-y-2">
                <flux:heading size="lg">{{ __('Invite link') }}</flux:heading>
                <flux:text>{{ __('Anyone with this link can accept the invitation. Share it only with the invitee.') }}</flux:text>
            </div>

            @if ($this->inviteLink !== null)
                <flux:input :value="$this->inviteLink" readonly copyable data-test="invite-link" />
            @endif

            <div class="flex justify-end">
                <flux:button variant="outline" wire:click="closeLinkModal">{{ __('Close') }}</flux:button>
            </div>
        </div>
    </flux:modal>
</section>
```

### Task 14: Slug rule, create and update organisation actions

**Covers:** ORG-1 (archived-name messages), ORG-4 (action), ORG-5 (action), ORG-14 (action), ORG-15, ORG-16 (who may change the slug), ORG-17 (W7 re-pinned), ORG-20 (create/update logged), AUD-7 (organisation CRUD), DEC26-7 (slug rule), FU2-1, FU3-5, TEN-6 (wizard mail), W7, W8, X10, RL-12, RL-17, RL-23, C-14; OR-I2, OR-M10, OR-M11, RK-M2, RK-I11.

What this task builds, and the rules it must keep:
- **Slug rule** `App\Rules\OrganisationSlug` (RL-23, spec §4.3): one DNS label of 3–63 characters `[a-z0-9-]`, lower case only (an upper-case slug is refused, not silently lowered), no leading or trailing hyphen, not one of `config('tenancy.reserved_slugs')` and not `config('tenancy.admin_subdomain')` (read at validation time, so `TENANCY_ADMIN_SUBDOMAIN=beheer` reserves `beheer`, FU2-1). `Hosts::slugOf()` uses the same pattern and the same reserved set, so the rule and the tenant resolver can never disagree, and the configured admin subdomain is never a tenant slug (FU3-5).
- **Uniqueness** of names and slugs includes archived organisations (the unique indexes cover soft-deleted rows, so archived names and slugs stay reserved). Only super admins are told that an archived organisation holds the value; everyone else gets the generic "This name can't be used." / "This address can't be used." so organisation admins cannot probe archived organisations (C-14, RK-M2). The slug is called the "address" in the UI.
- **CreateOrganisation** (the wizard's write, used by Task 18's page): super admins only (`OrganisationPolicy::create`); in **one** transaction: create the organisation, record `organisation.created`, invite the first admin through `InviteUser` with only the organisation_admin template role (by id; never a per-organisation admin role, DEC-21, W7). The first admin is a pending user with an explicit `organisation_id` and `is_super_admin = false` (W8). If inviting fails (for example the address belongs to another organisation), nothing is left behind. The mail is queued inside `Tenant::run()`, so its payload carries the new organisation as tenant, and it is pushed only after the outermost commit; the worker binds that organisation and builds the signed accept link for its host (OR-I2, TEN-6). Exactly three audit entries: `organisation.created`, `user.roles_changed`, `invitation.sent` (OR-M10). Invitation errors keep InviteUser's keys (`email`, `roles`); Task 18's page maps `email` to its `adminEmail` field.
- **UpdateOrganisation**: `OrganisationPolicy::update` (permission + own organisation; super admins through `Gate::before`); the organisation is locked with `HostScope::lockForWrite()` (archived → `organisation` error, another tenant's organisation on a tenant host → 403, RK-I11). **Only super admins change the slug** (owner ruling OD-3 = B); organisation admins edit name and description, and a slug change they send anyway is refused on `slug`. The old slug is free at once (no reservation). Records `organisation.updated` with the old and new values of the changed fields only, and nothing when nothing changed.

**Files:**
- Create: `app/Rules/OrganisationSlug.php`, `app/Concerns/OrganisationValidationRules.php`, `app/Actions/Organisations/CreateOrganisation.php`, `app/Actions/Organisations/UpdateOrganisation.php`
- Modify: `app/Tenancy/Hosts.php` (`SLUG_PATTERN`, `isReservedSlug()`, `slugOf()` excludes the admin subdomain), `lang/nl.json`, `lang/en.json`
- Test: `tests/Feature/Organisations/OrganisationSlugTest.php`, `tests/Feature/Organisations/CreateOrganisationTest.php`, `tests/Feature/Organisations/UpdateOrganisationTest.php`; `tests/Feature/Tenancy/ResolveTenantTest.php` (added case)

**Interfaces:**
- Consumes:
  - `App\Actions\Invitations\InviteUser::handle(User $actor, Organisation $organisation, string $email, array $roleIds, Locale $locale): Invitation` (Task 11): authorises `InvitationPolicy::create` (super admins via `Gate::before`), calls `HostScope::lockForWrite($organisation)` before `Tenant::run($organisation)`, validates with `AvailableEmail` (errors on `email`) and at least one role (`roles`), assigns roles through `UpdateUserRoles` (logs `user.roles_changed`), logs `invitation.sent`, queues `InvitationMail` after commit.
  - `App\Tenancy\HostScope::lockForWrite(Organisation $organisation): Organisation` (Task 7; needs an open transaction; archived → `ValidationException` on `organisation` with `__('This organisation is archived.')`; another bound tenant → `AuthorizationException`).
  - `App\Actions\Audit\RecordActivity::handle(ActivityEvent $event, ?Model $subject = null, array $properties = [], array $changes = [], ?User $causer = null, ?Organisation $organisation = null, bool $defaultCauser = true): Activity` (Task 1); `ActivityEvent::OrganisationCreated` (`organisation.created`), `ActivityEvent::OrganisationUpdated` (`organisation.updated`); test helper `recordedActivity(ActivityEvent $event): Collection<int, Activity>` (Task 1).
  - `OrganisationPolicy::create(): bool` (false; super admins via `Gate::before`), `OrganisationPolicy::update(User $actor, Organisation $organisation): bool`.
  - `App\Enums\Locale` (Task 10), `App\Authorization\Role::OrganisationAdmin`, `App\Authorization\SyncPermissions::GUARD`.
- Produces:
  - `App\Tenancy\Hosts::SLUG_PATTERN` (`public const string`, `'/^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]{1,61}[a-z0-9]$/'`) and `Hosts::isReservedSlug(string $slug): bool` (reserved list + lower-cased `tenancy.admin_subdomain`); `Hosts::slugOf(string $host): ?string` (unchanged signature) now returns null for the configured admin subdomain.
  - `App\Rules\OrganisationSlug implements Illuminate\Contracts\Validation\ValidationRule` — `validate(string $attribute, mixed $value, Closure $fail): void` (messages `__('Use 3 to 63 lower-case letters, digits and hyphens, without a hyphen at the start or end.')`, `__('This address is reserved.')`).
  - `App\Concerns\OrganisationValidationRules` (trait, protected methods): `organisationNameRules(?int $ignoreId = null, bool $revealArchived = false): array`, `organisationSlugRules(?int $ignoreId = null, bool $revealArchived = false): array` (starts with `bail`), `organisationDescriptionRules(): array` (`nullable|string|max:1000`). Conflict messages: `$revealArchived` true → `This name is used by an archived organisation.` / `This address is used by an archived organisation.` for archived holders, `This name is already used by another organisation.` / `This address is already used by another organisation.` for active ones; false → `This name can't be used.` / `This address can't be used.`.
  - `App\Actions\Organisations\CreateOrganisation::handle(User $actor, string $name, string $slug, ?string $description, string $adminEmail, Locale $adminLocale): Organisation` — `@throws AuthorizationException|ValidationException`; name and description trimmed, an empty description stored as null; validation errors on `name`, `slug`, `description`, and InviteUser's `email` / `roles`.
  - `App\Actions\Organisations\UpdateOrganisation::handle(User $actor, Organisation $organisation, string $name, string $slug, ?string $description): Organisation` — returns the locked, saved row; a slug change by a non-super actor → `ValidationException` on `slug` with `__('Only a platform administrator can change the address.')`.

**Matrix rows:** none.

- [ ] **Step 3: One slug pattern and one reserved set in `Hosts`**

In `app/Tenancy/Hosts.php`, add the constant as the first class element and the new method after `homeOf()`, and replace `slugOf()`:

```php
    /** One DNS label of 3–63 characters [a-z0-9-] without a leading or trailing hyphen (§4.3, §6.2). */
    public const string SLUG_PATTERN = '/^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]{1,61}[a-z0-9]$/';
```

```php
    /** Reserved words and the configured admin subdomain are never organisation slugs (§4.3, FU2-1, FU3-5). */
    public static function isReservedSlug(string $slug): bool
    {
        /** @var list<string> $reserved */
        $reserved = config('tenancy.reserved_slugs', []);

        return in_array($slug, [...$reserved, Str::lower((string) config('tenancy.admin_subdomain'))], true);
    }

    /**
     * The organisation slug a host names, or null when it is not {slug}.{apex} with a valid,
     * unreserved slug (§6.2, SLUG_PATTERN; the admin subdomain counts as reserved, FU3-5).
     * Expects a lower-cased host. Whether the organisation exists is not checked.
     */
    public static function slugOf(string $host): ?string
    {
        $suffix = '.'.self::apex();

        if (! str_ends_with($host, $suffix)) {
            return null;
        }

        $slug = substr($host, 0, -strlen($suffix));

        if (preg_match(self::SLUG_PATTERN, $slug) !== 1 || self::isReservedSlug($slug)) {
            return null;
        }

        return $slug;
    }
```

- [ ] **Step 4: The slug rule**

`app/Rules/OrganisationSlug.php`:

```php
<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace App\Rules;

use App\Tenancy\Hosts;
use Closure;
use Illuminate\Contracts\Validation\ValidationRule;
use Illuminate\Translation\PotentiallyTranslatedString;

/**
 * An organisation slug is one lower-case host label that the tenant resolver accepts (§4.3, RL-23): the same
 * pattern and reserved set as Hosts::slugOf(), so a valid slug always resolves to its organisation. Upper case
 * is refused rather than lowered, so the address a super admin types is the address that is stored.
 */
final class OrganisationSlug implements ValidationRule
{
    /** @param  Closure(string, ?string=): PotentiallyTranslatedString  $fail */
    public function validate(string $attribute, mixed $value, Closure $fail): void
    {
        if (! is_string($value) || preg_match(Hosts::SLUG_PATTERN, $value) !== 1) {
            $fail(__('Use 3 to 63 lower-case letters, digits and hyphens, without a hyphen at the start or end.'));

            return;
        }

        if (Hosts::isReservedSlug($value)) {
            $fail(__('This address is reserved.'));
        }
    }
}
```

- [ ] **Step 5: Organisation validation rules**

`app/Concerns/OrganisationValidationRules.php`:

```php
<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace App\Concerns;

use App\Models\Organisation;
use App\Rules\OrganisationSlug;
use Closure;
use Illuminate\Contracts\Validation\ValidationRule;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Builder;
use Stringable;

/**
 * Names and slugs are unique across all organisations, archived ones included: the unique indexes cover
 * soft-deleted rows, so archived names and slugs stay reserved (§4.3, C-14). Only super admins are told that
 * an archived organisation holds a value; everyone else gets the generic message (RK-M2).
 */
trait OrganisationValidationRules
{
    /** @return array<int, ValidationRule|Stringable|Closure|array<mixed>|string> */
    protected function organisationNameRules(?int $ignoreId = null, bool $revealArchived = false): array
    {
        return ['required', 'string', 'max:255', $this->uniqueOrganisationValue('name', $ignoreId, $revealArchived)];
    }

    /** @return array<int, ValidationRule|Stringable|Closure|array<mixed>|string> */
    protected function organisationSlugRules(?int $ignoreId = null, bool $revealArchived = false): array
    {
        return ['bail', 'required', 'string', new OrganisationSlug, $this->uniqueOrganisationValue('slug', $ignoreId, $revealArchived)];
    }

    /** @return array<int, string> */
    protected function organisationDescriptionRules(): array
    {
        return ['nullable', 'string', 'max:1000'];
    }

    /** @param  'name'|'slug'  $column */
    private function uniqueOrganisationValue(string $column, ?int $ignoreId, bool $revealArchived): Closure
    {
        return function (string $attribute, mixed $value, Closure $fail) use ($column, $ignoreId, $revealArchived): void {
            $holder = Organisation::withTrashed()
                ->where($column, $value)
                ->when($ignoreId !== null, fn (Builder $query): Builder => $query->whereKeyNot($ignoreId))
                ->first(['id', 'deleted_at']);

            if ($holder === null) {
                return;
            }

            $fail(match (true) {
                ! $revealArchived => $column === 'name' ? __('This name can\'t be used.') : __('This address can\'t be used.'),
                $holder->trashed() => $column === 'name'
                    ? __('This name is used by an archived organisation.')
                    : __('This address is used by an archived organisation.'),
                default => $column === 'name'
                    ? __('This name is already used by another organisation.')
                    : __('This address is already used by another organisation.'),
            });
        };
    }
}
```

`app/Actions/Organisations/CreateOrganisation.php`:

```php
<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace App\Actions\Organisations;

use App\Actions\Audit\RecordActivity;
use App\Actions\Invitations\InviteUser;
use App\Authorization\Role;
use App\Authorization\SyncPermissions;
use App\Concerns\OrganisationValidationRules;
use App\Enums\ActivityEvent;
use App\Enums\Locale;
use App\Models\Organisation;
use App\Models\User;
use Illuminate\Auth\Access\AuthorizationException;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Gate;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Validator;
use Illuminate\Validation\ValidationException;
use LogicException;
use Spatie\Permission\Models\Role as RoleModel;

/**
 * The organisation wizard's write (§4.3, RL-12): the organisation, its first admin as a pending user with the
 * organisation_admin template role and the invitation are created in one transaction, so a failing invitation
 * leaves nothing behind (ORG-14). No per-organisation admin role is ever created (DEC-21, W7). The invitation
 * mail is queued after the outermost commit and builds its link in the worker (OR-I2). Writes exactly
 * organisation.created, user.roles_changed and invitation.sent (OR-M10).
 */
final class CreateOrganisation
{
    use OrganisationValidationRules;

    public function __construct(
        private readonly InviteUser $inviteUser,
        private readonly RecordActivity $recordActivity,
    ) {}

    /**
     * @throws AuthorizationException
     * @throws ValidationException
     */
    public function handle(User $actor, string $name, string $slug, ?string $description, string $adminEmail, Locale $adminLocale): Organisation
    {
        Gate::forUser($actor)->authorize('create', Organisation::class);

        $name = trim($name);
        $description = $description === null || trim($description) === '' ? null : trim($description);

        Validator::make(
            ['name' => $name, 'slug' => $slug, 'description' => $description],
            [
                'name' => $this->organisationNameRules(revealArchived: $actor->isSuperAdmin()),
                'slug' => $this->organisationSlugRules(revealArchived: $actor->isSuperAdmin()),
                'description' => $this->organisationDescriptionRules(),
            ],
        )->validate();

        return DB::transaction(function () use ($actor, $name, $slug, $description, $adminEmail, $adminLocale): Organisation {
            $organisation = Organisation::query()->create([
                'name' => $name,
                'slug' => $slug,
                'description' => $description,
            ]);

            $this->recordActivity->handle(
                ActivityEvent::OrganisationCreated,
                $organisation,
                ['name' => $organisation->name, 'slug' => $organisation->slug],
                causer: $actor,
            );

            // Errors keep InviteUser's keys (email, roles); a failure rolls the organisation back.
            $this->inviteUser->handle($actor, $organisation, $adminEmail, [$this->templateRoleId()], $adminLocale);

            return $organisation;
        });
    }

    private function templateRoleId(): int
    {
        $id = RoleModel::query()
            ->whereNull('team_id')
            ->where('name', Role::OrganisationAdmin->value)
            ->where('guard_name', SyncPermissions::GUARD)
            ->value('id');

        return $id === null
            ? throw new LogicException('The organisation_admin template role is missing; run php artisan permissions:sync.')
            : (int) $id;
    }
}
```

`app/Actions/Organisations/UpdateOrganisation.php`:

```php
<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace App\Actions\Organisations;

use App\Actions\Audit\RecordActivity;
use App\Concerns\OrganisationValidationRules;
use App\Enums\ActivityEvent;
use App\Models\Organisation;
use App\Models\User;
use App\Tenancy\HostScope;
use Illuminate\Auth\Access\AuthorizationException;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Gate;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Validator;
use Illuminate\Validation\ValidationException;

/**
 * Edits an organisation (§4.3): name and description for its organisation admins and super admins; the slug
 * for super admins only (OD-3 = B), because a new slug moves the organisation to a new host. The row is locked
 * and re-checked, so an archived or another tenant's organisation is refused (RK-I11). The old slug is free at
 * once. Records organisation.updated with the changed fields only.
 */
final class UpdateOrganisation
{
    use OrganisationValidationRules;

    public function __construct(private readonly RecordActivity $recordActivity) {}

    /**
     * @throws AuthorizationException
     * @throws ValidationException
     */
    public function handle(User $actor, Organisation $organisation, string $name, string $slug, ?string $description): Organisation
    {
        Gate::forUser($actor)->authorize('update', $organisation);

        $name = trim($name);
        $description = $description === null || trim($description) === '' ? null : trim($description);

        return DB::transaction(function () use ($actor, $organisation, $name, $slug, $description): Organisation {
            $locked = HostScope::lockForWrite($organisation);

            if ($slug !== $locked->slug && ! $actor->isSuperAdmin()) {
                throw ValidationException::withMessages(['slug' => __('Only a platform administrator can change the address.')]);
            }

            Validator::make(
                ['name' => $name, 'slug' => $slug, 'description' => $description],
                [
                    'name' => $this->organisationNameRules($locked->id, $actor->isSuperAdmin()),
                    'slug' => $this->organisationSlugRules($locked->id, $actor->isSuperAdmin()),
                    'description' => $this->organisationDescriptionRules(),
                ],
            )->validate();

            $locked->fill(['name' => $name, 'slug' => $slug, 'description' => $description]);
            $changed = array_keys($locked->getDirty());

            if ($changed === []) {
                return $locked;
            }

            $old = [];
            $new = [];

            foreach ($changed as $field) {
                $old[$field] = $locked->getOriginal($field);
                $new[$field] = $locked->getAttribute($field);
            }

            $locked->save();

            $this->recordActivity->handle(
                ActivityEvent::OrganisationUpdated,
                $locked,
                changes: ['old' => $old, 'attributes' => $new],
                causer: $actor,
            );

            return $locked;
        });
    }
}
```

(The observer's `saved` hook already forgets the old and the new slug from the resolver cache.)

### Task 15: Archive, restore and purge actions

**Covers:** ORG-6, ORG-8, ORG-9, ORG-10, ORG-11, ORG-12, ORG-20 (archive/restore/purge logged), ORG-21, AUD-7 (purge), DEC26-9, DEC26-14, FU2-6, R-9, RL-17, RL-28, C-15, C-16, C-17, C-27; RK-I7, RK-I10, CV-13.

What this task builds, and the rules it must keep (Task 17's organisations index calls these actions; it re-resolves the organisation per request and passes a fresh instance):
- **ArchiveOrganisation** — super admins only (`OrganisationPolicy::delete`, always checked: super admin and not archived). One transaction: lock the row with `HostScope::lockForWrite()` (already archived → `organisation` error; another tenant's organisation on a tenant host → 403), soft-delete it — the observer's cascade (`SoftDeleteCascade`) soft-deletes the organisation's tenant rows (users, invitations, activity) with the same timestamp and never archives a promoted super admin — then end the cascaded users' sessions with `Sessions::endFor()` (Task 6: deletes their `sessions` rows and clears their `remember_token`), so neither a restore nor a re-enable revives an old session or "remember me" cookie (RL-28, with the kit's database session driver), and record `organisation.archived`.
- **RestoreOrganisation** — super admins only (`OrganisationPolicy::restore` returns false; super admins pass `Gate::before`; equivalent to `organisations.delete` while that permission is super-only, C-27). Central hosts only (an archived organisation's host does not resolve, so a bound tenant is always another organisation). One transaction: lock and re-read the row, refuse when it is no longer archived (RK-I10); refuse while an address of a user the cascade would bring back is now held by another non-deleted user, listing the addresses (C-15; the partial unique index would fail otherwise); restore (the cascade restores only rows with the archive timestamp, so users deleted earlier stay deleted); record `organisation.restored`.
- **PurgeOrganisation** — super admins only and only for archived organisations (`OrganisationPolicy::forceDelete`, always checked); the typed confirmation must equal the slug (ORG-10); central hosts only. One transaction: lock and re-check `trashed()` (RK-I10); lock every user row of the organisation in id order; **detach** promoted super admins, deleted ones included (`organisation_id` → null; listed in the audit properties) instead of refusing (DEC26-9, D-11); delete in order: invitations (also those the cascade archived), the users' sessions through `Sessions::endFor()` (`sessions` has no FK, C-16) and the `password_reset_tokens` of their addresses — except an address a live user elsewhere now holds (CV-13) — then the users including deleted ones (passkeys and handoff tokens cascade by FK), then the `model_has_roles` / `model_has_permissions` rows of the team (and of the purged users) and the team roles (role permissions cascade by FK), then the organisation itself (`users.organisation_id` stays `restrictOnDelete` as the safety net, R-9). Activity rows are kept (no FK; they stay soft-deleted from the archive and central viewers still see them, ORG-12, C-17). Record `organisation.purged` with name, slug, user count and detached super admin ids, tagged with the purged id. The Spatie permission cache is forgotten **after commit**. Any failure — including the final audit write — rolls everything back.
- All three actions pass `causer: $actor` to `RecordActivity`, like CreateOrganisation and UpdateOrganisation: the recorded actor is the user the action was called for, also when nobody (or somebody else) is signed in on the web guard (console, tests, a later command).
- Every bulk delete is a `DB::table()` statement with an explicit `organisation_id` / id filter. **Never** use Eloquent's builder `forceDelete()` for bulk deletes here: `Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Builder::forceDelete()` runs `$this->query->delete()` without applying global scopes, so `Invitation::withTrashed()->forceDelete()` would delete every organisation's invitations.

**Files:**
- Create: `app/Actions/Organisations/ArchiveOrganisation.php`, `app/Actions/Organisations/RestoreOrganisation.php`, `app/Actions/Organisations/PurgeOrganisation.php`
- Modify: `lang/nl.json`, `lang/en.json`
- Test: `tests/Feature/Organisations/ArchiveRestorePurgeTest.php`

**Interfaces:**
- Consumes:
  - `OrganisationPolicy::delete(User, Organisation)` (always checked: super admin && !trashed), `OrganisationPolicy::restore(): bool` (false; super admins via `Gate::before`), `OrganisationPolicy::forceDelete(User, Organisation)` (always checked: super admin && trashed).

- [ ] **Step 3: Archive**

`app/Actions/Organisations/ArchiveOrganisation.php`:

```php
<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace App\Actions\Organisations;

use App\Actions\Audit\RecordActivity;
use App\Enums\ActivityEvent;
use App\Models\Organisation;
use App\Models\User;
use App\Tenancy\Auth\Sessions;
use App\Tenancy\HostScope;
use Illuminate\Auth\Access\AuthorizationException;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Gate;
use Illuminate\Validation\ValidationException;

/**
 * Archives (soft-deletes) an organisation in one transaction (§4.3, DEC-26 (10)): the observer cascades the
 * soft delete to the organisation's tenant rows and never archives a promoted super admin; the cascaded users
 * lose their sessions and remember tokens, so a later restore revives neither (RL-28); organisation.archived is
 * recorded. Super admins only (always checked).
 */
final class ArchiveOrganisation
{
    public function __construct(private readonly RecordActivity $recordActivity) {}

    /**
     * @throws AuthorizationException
     * @throws ValidationException
     */
    public function handle(User $actor, Organisation $organisation): void
    {
        Gate::forUser($actor)->authorize('delete', $organisation);

        DB::transaction(function () use ($actor, $organisation): void {
            $locked = HostScope::lockForWrite($organisation);

            // The users the cascade is about to archive, locked in id order (RL-27).
            $userIds = array_values(DB::table('users')
                ->where('organisation_id', $locked->id)
                ->where('is_super_admin', false)
                ->whereNull('deleted_at')
                ->orderBy('id')
                ->lockForUpdate()
                ->pluck('id')
                ->map(fn (mixed $id): int => (int) $id)
                ->all());

            $locked->delete();
            Sessions::endFor($userIds);

            $this->recordActivity->handle(ActivityEvent::OrganisationArchived, $locked, [
                'name' => $locked->name,
                'slug' => $locked->slug,
                'users' => count($userIds),
            ], causer: $actor);
        });
    }
}
```

- [ ] **Step 4: Restore**

`app/Actions/Organisations/RestoreOrganisation.php`:

```php
<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace App\Actions\Organisations;

use App\Actions\Audit\RecordActivity;
use App\Enums\ActivityEvent;
use App\Models\Organisation;
use App\Models\User;
use App\Tenancy\Facades\Tenant;
use Illuminate\Auth\Access\AuthorizationException;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Gate;
use Illuminate\Validation\ValidationException;

/**
 * Restores an archived organisation with the rows its archive cascaded (§4.3; restore = organisations.delete,
 * which only super admins hold, C-27). The row is locked and re-checked (RK-I10); a restore is refused while
 * an address of a user it would bring back is now held by another account (C-15). Central hosts only: an
 * archived organisation's host does not resolve, so a bound tenant is always another organisation.
 */
final class RestoreOrganisation
{
    public function __construct(private readonly RecordActivity $recordActivity) {}

    /**
     * @throws AuthorizationException
     * @throws ValidationException
     */
    public function handle(User $actor, Organisation $organisation): void
    {
        Gate::forUser($actor)->authorize('restore', $organisation);

        if (Tenant::check()) {
            throw new AuthorizationException('Archived organisations are restored on a central host.');
        }

        DB::transaction(function () use ($actor, $organisation): void {
            $locked = Organisation::withTrashed()->lockForUpdate()->findOrFail($organisation->id);

            if (! $locked->trashed()) {
                throw ValidationException::withMessages(['organisation' => __('This organisation is not archived.')]);
            }

            $this->ensureAddressesAreFree($locked);
            $locked->restore();

            $this->recordActivity->handle(ActivityEvent::OrganisationRestored, $locked, [
                'name' => $locked->name,
                'slug' => $locked->slug,
            ], causer: $actor);
        });
    }

    /**
     * The cascade restores the users archived with the organisation (same deleted_at); the partial unique
     * index on users.email would refuse any whose address a non-deleted user holds by now.
     *
     * @throws ValidationException
     */
    private function ensureAddressesAreFree(Organisation $organisation): void
    {
        $addresses = DB::table('users')
            ->where('organisation_id', $organisation->id)
            ->where('deleted_at', $organisation->deleted_at)
            ->pluck('email')
            ->map(fn (mixed $email): string => (string) $email)
            ->all();

        if ($addresses === []) {
            return;
        }

        $taken = DB::table('users')
            ->whereNull('deleted_at')
            ->whereIn('email', $addresses)
            ->orderBy('email')
            ->pluck('email')
            ->map(fn (mixed $email): string => (string) $email)
            ->all();

        if ($taken !== []) {
            throw ValidationException::withMessages([
                'email' => __('These addresses are now used by other accounts: :addresses.', ['addresses' => implode(', ', $taken)]),
            ]);
        }
    }
}
```

- [ ] **Step 5: Purge**

`app/Actions/Organisations/PurgeOrganisation.php`:

```php
<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace App\Actions\Organisations;

use App\Actions\Audit\RecordActivity;
use App\Enums\ActivityEvent;
use App\Models\Organisation;
use App\Models\User;
use App\Tenancy\Auth\Sessions;
use App\Tenancy\Facades\Tenant;
use Illuminate\Auth\Access\AuthorizationException;
use Illuminate\Database\Query\Builder;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Gate;
use Illuminate\Validation\ValidationException;
use Spatie\Permission\PermissionRegistrar;

/**
 * Purges an archived organisation for good (§4.3): super admins only, only after its slug is typed, in one
 * transaction. Promoted super admins are detached, not deleted (DEC-26 (9)); then invitations, the users'
 * sessions and reset tokens, the users including deleted ones (passkeys and handoff tokens cascade), the
 * team's role assignments and roles, and the organisation are deleted. Activity rows are kept (ORG-12).
 *
 * Every bulk delete is a query-builder statement with an explicit organisation or id filter: Eloquent's builder
 * forceDelete() runs without global scopes, so on a tenant model it would delete every organisation's rows.
 */
final class PurgeOrganisation
{
    public function __construct(
        private readonly RecordActivity $recordActivity,
        private readonly PermissionRegistrar $permissionRegistrar,
    ) {}

    /**
     * @throws AuthorizationException
     * @throws ValidationException
     */
    public function handle(User $actor, Organisation $organisation, string $confirmation): void
    {
        Gate::forUser($actor)->authorize('forceDelete', $organisation);

        if (Tenant::check()) {
            throw new AuthorizationException('Archived organisations are purged on a central host.');
        }

        DB::transaction(function () use ($actor, $organisation, $confirmation): void {
            $locked = Organisation::withTrashed()->lockForUpdate()->findOrFail($organisation->id);

            if (! $locked->trashed()) {
                throw ValidationException::withMessages(['organisation' => __('This organisation is not archived.')]);
            }

            if (trim($confirmation) !== $locked->slug) {
                throw ValidationException::withMessages(['confirmation' => __('Type :slug to confirm.', ['slug' => $locked->slug])]);
            }

            // Every user row of the organisation, deleted ones included, locked in id order (RL-27).
            $rows = DB::table('users')
                ->where('organisation_id', $locked->id)
                ->orderBy('id')
                ->lockForUpdate()
                ->get(['id', 'email', 'is_super_admin']);

            $detached = [];
            $users = [];

            foreach ($rows as $row) {
                if ((bool) $row->is_super_admin) {
                    $detached[] = (int) $row->id;
                } else {
                    $users[(int) $row->id] = (string) $row->email;
                }
            }

            if ($detached !== []) {
                DB::table('users')->whereIn('id', $detached)->update(['organisation_id' => null]);
            }

            DB::table('invitations')->where('organisation_id', $locked->id)->delete();
            $this->deleteSignInState($locked, $users);
            DB::table('users')->where('organisation_id', $locked->id)->delete();
            $this->deleteTeam($locked, array_keys($users));
            $locked->forceDelete();

            $this->recordActivity->handle(
                ActivityEvent::OrganisationPurged,
                $locked,
                [
                    'name' => $locked->name,
                    'slug' => $locked->slug,
                    'users' => count($users),
                    'detached_super_admins' => $detached,
                ],
                causer: $actor,
                organisation: $locked,
            );

            DB::afterCommit(fn (): bool => $this->permissionRegistrar->forgetCachedPermissions());
        });
    }

    /**
     * Sessions have no foreign key (C-16), so Sessions::endFor() deletes them. Reset tokens are keyed by address: a deleted user's address may belong
     * to a live account elsewhere by now, and that account keeps its token (CV-13).
     *
     * @param  array<int, string>  $users  id => email
     */
    private function deleteSignInState(Organisation $organisation, array $users): void
    {
        if ($users === []) {
            return;
        }

        Sessions::endFor(array_keys($users));

        $addresses = array_values(array_unique($users));
        $heldElsewhere = DB::table('users')
            ->whereNull('deleted_at')
            ->whereIn('email', $addresses)
            ->where(function (Builder $query) use ($organisation): void {
                $query->whereNull('organisation_id')->orWhere('organisation_id', '!=', $organisation->id);
            })
            ->pluck('email')
            ->map(fn (mixed $email): string => (string) $email)
            ->all();

        $purgeable = array_values(array_diff($addresses, $heldElsewhere));

        if ($purgeable !== []) {
            DB::table('password_reset_tokens')->whereIn('email', $purgeable)->delete();
        }
    }

    /**
     * Role assignments carry team_id but no foreign key to organisations (spec §4.3); role permissions and any
     * remaining assignments of the team roles cascade when the roles go.
     *
     * @param  list<int>  $userIds
     */
    private function deleteTeam(Organisation $organisation, array $userIds): void
    {
        $morphClass = (new User)->getMorphClass();

        foreach (['model_has_roles', 'model_has_permissions'] as $table) {
            DB::table($table)->where('team_id', $organisation->id)->delete();

            if ($userIds !== []) {
                DB::table($table)->where('model_type', $morphClass)->whereIn('model_id', $userIds)->delete();
            }
        }

        DB::table('roles')->where('team_id', $organisation->id)->delete();
    }
}
```

### Task 16: Handoff follow-ups (same-user shortcut, different-user confirmation, FU3-3/4)

**Covers:** HND-1 (shortcut, confirmation), AUD-13 (shortcut), DEC27-2 (part), FU3-1 (documented), FU3-2, FU3-3, FU3-4, RL-22; OR-I6, CV-9, CV-14, RK-I14, CV-b.

What this task changes, in plain words (spec §6.4, RL-22):

- Today `GET /auth/handoff/{token}` always logs out whoever is signed in on that host (cycling their remember token) and signs the token's user in. That is a session swap anyone can trigger with a link (FU3-2).
- After this task: a guest is signed in as before; **the same user** who is already signed in just continues — the token is consumed, `HandoffConsumed` is dispatched (so Task 2's subscriber audits it), and there is no new sign-in, no session invalidation and no remember-token cycling (CV-14); **another signed-in user** gets a confirmation page ("You are signed in as :name. Continue as :other?") and the token stays unused; only the CSRF-protected `POST` from that page consumes the token and replaces this browser's session with `logoutCurrentDevice()` + `invalidate()` (never `logout()`, which cycles the previous user's remember token and so signs them out on their other devices). A `GET` never replaces a different user's session (RK-I14).
- `IssueHandoff` turns `Hosts::homeOf()`'s `LogicException` (a member whose organisation is archived or missing) into the same `AuthorizationException` it throws for any host the user may not enter (FU3-4), and its docblock says that callers pass only the authenticated actor (FU3-1: a handoff is a sign-in that skips the second factor).
- Consuming a handoff on the apex and on the admin host gets a test (FU3-3).

**Files:**
- Create: `resources/views/pages/auth/handoff-confirm.blade.php` (plain Blade on the auth layout, like the Fortify views in `resources/views/pages/auth/`)
- Modify: `app/Actions/Auth/IssueHandoff.php`, `app/Http/Controllers/Auth/HandoffController.php` (`__invoke` → `show` + `store`), `routes/web.php` (GET → `show`; new `POST auth/handoff/{token}` → `store`, name `auth.handoff.store`, same `throttle:handoff`), `lang/nl.json`, `lang/en.json`
- Test: `tests/Feature/Auth/HandoffTest.php` (new cases; the M3 case "signs out a different user and starts a clean session" is replaced, see Step 1)

**Interfaces:**
- Consumes: `App\Models\HandoffToken`, `App\Tenancy\Auth\HostLoginRule::allows(User $user): bool`, `App\Events\HandoffConsumed(User $user, string $host)`, `App\Tenancy\Hosts::homeOf(User $user): string` (throws `LogicException`), `Hosts::url(string $host, string $path = '/'): string` (scheme and port from the current request; the redirect after a consumed handoff is built with it on the token's target host).
- Produces:
  - `App\Actions\Auth\IssueHandoff::handle(User $user, string $targetHost, string $path = '/dashboard'): string` — signature unchanged; a member without a reachable organisation now gets `AuthorizationException`; docblock: pass only the authenticated actor.
  - `App\Http\Controllers\Auth\HandoffController::show(Request $request, HostLoginRule $rule, string $token): RedirectResponse|Response` (`Illuminate\Http\Response`, so the confirmation page can carry `Referrer-Policy: no-referrer`) — invalid token or a user who fails the host rule → refuse (M3 message, token untouched); signed in as the token user → atomic claim, `HandoffConsumed`, redirect (no new sign-in); signed in as another user → render `pages::auth.handoff-confirm` (token not consumed); nobody signed in → claim, sign in, regenerate (M3 behaviour).
  - `HandoffController::store(Request $request, HostLoginRule $rule, string $token): RedirectResponse` — CSRF-protected POST; same validation; claim; replaces only this browser's session (`logoutCurrentDevice()`, `invalidate()`), signs in, `regenerateToken()`, `HandoffConsumed`, redirect with `Referrer-Policy: no-referrer`.
  - Routes `auth.handoff` (GET, unchanged name and URI) and `auth.handoff.store` (POST, same URI).
- Task 20 later adds the impersonation interplay to `IssueHandoff`, `show` and `store`; nothing here anticipates it.

```php
/**
```
