- [ ] **Step 4: Start and stop actions**

`app/Actions/Users/StartImpersonation.php`:

```php
<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace App\Actions\Users;

use App\Actions\Audit\RecordActivity;
use App\Enums\ActivityEvent;
use App\Models\User;
use App\Tenancy\Auth\Impersonation;
use Illuminate\Auth\Access\AuthorizationException;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Auth;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Gate;
use Illuminate\Validation\ValidationException;
use LogicException;
use Throwable;

/**
 * Starts impersonating $target in the signed-in actor's session (§4.7): a reason (IMP-1), the policy
 * (module on, depth 1, the matrix), the swap, then impersonation.start with the reason. Logged after the
 * swap, so the causer rewrite records the actor with impersonated_as.
 */
final readonly class StartImpersonation
{
    public const int MAX_REASON_LENGTH = 500;

    public function __construct(private RecordActivity $recordActivity) {}

    /**
     * @throws ValidationException
     * @throws AuthorizationException
     */
    public function handle(User $actor, User $target, string $reason): void
    {
        $reason = trim($reason);

        if ($reason === '' || mb_strlen($reason) > self::MAX_REASON_LENGTH) {
            throw ValidationException::withMessages(['reason' => __('Give a reason of at most 500 characters.')]);
        }

        Gate::forUser($actor)->authorize('impersonate', $target);

        if (Auth::guard('web')->id() !== $actor->id) {
            throw new LogicException('Only the signed-in user can start an impersonation.');
        }

        Impersonation::enter($actor, $target);

        try {
            $this->recordActivity->handle(ActivityEvent::ImpersonationStarted, $target, ['reason' => $reason]);
        } catch (Throwable $exception) {
            // No unlogged impersonation (§4.8).
            Impersonation::leave();

            throw $exception;
        }
    }
}
```

`app/Actions/Users/StopImpersonation.php`:

```php
<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace App\Actions\Users;

use App\Actions\Audit\RecordActivity;
use App\Enums\ActivityEvent;
use App\Models\User;
use App\Tenancy\Auth\HostLoginRule;
use App\Tenancy\Auth\Impersonation;

/**
 * Ends this session's impersonation (§4.7, RL-20). impersonation.stop is logged first, while the session
 * still says who impersonated whom, with an explicit causer: the impersonator, or nobody plus
 * properties.impersonator_id when they no longer exist (RK-M6). Then the impersonator is back in their own
 * account when they still qualify (exist, active, allowed on this host, unchanged password); otherwise
 * this browser is signed out. Returns the restored impersonator, or null.
 */
final readonly class StopImpersonation
{
    public function __construct(
        private RecordActivity $recordActivity,
        private HostLoginRule $rule,
    ) {}

    /** @param  string|null  $endedBecause  why the stop was not asked for (module_disabled, target_unavailable, target_credentials_changed, no_longer_allowed, impersonator_unavailable, impersonator_credentials_changed, handoff, logout) */
    public function handle(?string $endedBecause = null): ?User
    {
        if (! Impersonation::isActive()) {
            return null;
        }

        // EnforceImpersonation calls this before Authenticate ran: from here on nothing in this request may
        // resolve the guard's user from the impersonator's remember-me cookie when the target is gone (RK-I1).
        Impersonation::ignoreRememberCookie();

        $impersonator = Impersonation::impersonator();
        $properties = ['impersonated_as' => Impersonation::targetId()];

        if (! $impersonator instanceof User) {
            $properties['impersonator_id'] = Impersonation::impersonatorId();
        }

        if ($endedBecause !== null) {
            $properties['ended_because'] = $endedBecause;
        }

        $this->recordActivity->handle(
            ActivityEvent::ImpersonationStopped,
            Impersonation::target(),
            $properties,
            causer: $impersonator,
            defaultCauser: false,
        );

        if ($impersonator instanceof User
            && $this->rule->allows($impersonator)
            && Impersonation::impersonatorPasswordUnchanged($impersonator)) {
            return Impersonation::leave();
        }

        Impersonation::signOut();

        return null;
    }
}
```

- [ ] **Step 5: The causer rewrite in the log action**

`RecordActivity` (Task 1) builds the entry itself and, unless told otherwise, takes the signed-in `web` user as causer — the target, right after the swap. In `app/Actions/Audit/LogActivity.php` (Task 1), add `use App\Models\Activity;`, `use App\Models\User;` and `use App\Tenancy\Auth\Impersonation;` to the imports, call the rewrite as the **last** statement of `beforeActivityLogged()` (after the `ip_address` / `user_agent` block):

```php
        $this->rewriteImpersonatedCauser($activity);
```

and add the method to the class:

```php
    /**
     * While this session impersonates, an entry caused by the impersonated user is caused by the real user
     * and records the impersonated user's id as impersonated_as (§4.7, IMP-6). Another explicit causer is
     * kept. Independent of the module flag, like Impersonation::isActive() (RK-I3).
     */
    private function rewriteImpersonatedCauser(Model $activity): void
    {
        if (! $activity instanceof Activity || ! Impersonation::isActive()) {
            return;
        }

        $targetId = Impersonation::targetId();

        if ($targetId === null
            || $activity->causer_type !== (new User)->getMorphClass()
            || $activity->causer_id !== $targetId) {
            return;
        }

        $impersonator = Impersonation::impersonator();

        if (! $impersonator instanceof User) {
            return;
        }

        $activity->causer()->associate($impersonator);
        $activity->properties = collect([...($activity->properties?->all() ?? []), 'impersonated_as' => $targetId]);
    }
```

- [ ] **Step 6: Per-request enforcement and the membership middleware**

`app/Tenancy/Http/Middleware/EnforceImpersonation.php`:

```php
<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace App\Tenancy\Http\Middleware;

use App\Actions\Users\StopImpersonation;
use App\Authorization\Permission;
use App\Authorization\UserAbilities;
use App\Models\User;
use App\Tenancy\Auth\HostLoginRule;
use App\Tenancy\Auth\Impersonation;
use Closure;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use Symfony\Component\HttpFoundation\Response;

/**
 * Re-validates a running impersonation on every web request (§4.7, RL-20), before Authenticate resolves
 * the signed-in user: the module is on; the impersonator still exists, is active, may use this host and has
 * the same password; the target still exists, is active, may use this host and has the same password as at
 * the swap (else AuthenticateSession would sign the browser out unlogged); and the matrix still allows the
 * pair. Otherwise the impersonation ends, logged with the reason (module_disabled, impersonator_unavailable,
 * impersonator_credentials_changed, target_unavailable, target_credentials_changed, no_longer_allowed), and
 * the impersonator is back in their own account, or signed out when they no longer qualify themselves
 * (W3, RK-B4, RK-I1, RK-I2, RK-I3).
 * Both users are read from the session through the unscoped provider; the guard is never asked.
 */
final readonly class EnforceImpersonation
{
    public function __construct(
        private HostLoginRule $rule,
        private UserAbilities $abilities,
        private StopImpersonation $stopImpersonation,
    ) {}

    /** @param  Closure(Request): Response  $next */
    public function handle(Request $request, Closure $next): Response
    {
        if (! Impersonation::isActive()) {
            return $next($request);
        }

        $reason = $this->endReason();

        if ($reason === null) {
            return $next($request);
        }

        $impersonator = $this->stopImpersonation->handle($reason);

        if (! $impersonator instanceof User) {
            return to_route('login')->with('status', __('The impersonation has ended. Sign in again.'));
        }

        return to_route($impersonator->can(Permission::UsersView) ? 'users.index' : 'dashboard')
            ->with('status', __('The impersonation has ended. You are back in your own account.'));
    }

    private function endReason(): ?string
    {
        if (! Impersonation::enabled()) {
            return 'module_disabled';
        }

        $impersonator = Impersonation::impersonator();

        if (! $impersonator instanceof User || ! $this->rule->allows($impersonator)) {
            return 'impersonator_unavailable';
        }

        if (! Impersonation::impersonatorPasswordUnchanged($impersonator)) {
            return 'impersonator_credentials_changed';
        }

        $target = Impersonation::target();

        if (! $target instanceof User || ! $this->rule->allows($target)) {
            return 'target_unavailable';
        }

        if (! Impersonation::targetPasswordUnchanged($target)) {
            return 'target_credentials_changed';
        }

        return $this->abilities->mayImpersonate($impersonator, $target) ? null : 'no_longer_allowed';
    }
}
```

Replace `app/Tenancy/Http/Middleware/VerifyTenantMembership.php` with:

```php
<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace App\Tenancy\Http\Middleware;

use App\Models\User;
use App\Tenancy\Auth\HostLoginRule;
use Closure;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Auth;
use Symfony\Component\HttpFoundation\Response;

/**
 * Logs out a signed-in user the host login rule refuses — inactive, deleted, or on a host they do not
 * belong to — with a reason (§4.1, FU3-6). A running impersonation never reaches this point with a refused
 * user: EnforceImpersonation re-checked the pair before and ended the impersonation instead (RL-20).
 */
final readonly class VerifyTenantMembership
{
    public function __construct(private HostLoginRule $rule) {}

    /** @param  Closure(Request): Response  $next */
    public function handle(Request $request, Closure $next): Response
    {
        $user = $request->user();

        if (! $user instanceof User || $this->rule->allows($user)) {
            return $next($request);
        }

        $reason = $user->isActive() && ! $user->trashed()
            ? __('Your account does not have access to this address. Sign in at your own organisation.')
            : __('Your account is not active. Contact your administrator.');

        Auth::guard('web')->logout();
        $request->session()->invalidate();
        $request->session()->regenerateToken();

        return redirect()->route('login')->with('status', $reason);
    }
}
```

In `bootstrap/app.php`, add the imports `use App\Tenancy\Http\Middleware\EnforceImpersonation;` and `use Illuminate\Contracts\Auth\Middleware\AuthenticatesRequests;`, and change the web-group line inside `withMiddleware()` plus add the priority line below the existing three:

```php
        $middleware->web(
            append: [EnforceImpersonation::class, VerifyTenantMembership::class, AuthenticateSession::class],
            prepend: [InitializeTenancy::class],
        );
        // Before route-model binding (and so before can:): a tenant model bound on the wrong host
        // gives a 404, not a strict-mode error.
        $middleware->prependToPriorityList(SubstituteBindings::class, VerifyTenantMembership::class);
        $middleware->prependToPriorityList(SubstituteBindings::class, EnsureTenantHost::class);
        $middleware->prependToPriorityList(SubstituteBindings::class, EnsureCentralHost::class);
        // §4.7 / RL-20: a running impersonation is re-checked from the session before Authenticate (or anything
        // else) resolves the signed-in user, so a gone target never falls back to a remember-me sign-in.
        $middleware->prependToPriorityList(AuthenticatesRequests::class, EnforceImpersonation::class);
```

The resulting order on every web route is `InitializeTenancy` (first, outside the priority list) → … → `StartSession` → `EnforceImpersonation` → `Authenticate` → `AuthenticateSession` → `VerifyTenantMembership` → host middleware → `SubstituteBindings` → `Authorize`; the middleware-order test pins it.

```php
<?php
```

```php
    public function destroy(StopImpersonation $stopImpersonation): RedirectResponse

    }
}
```

### Task 21: Impersonation UI — start action, banner, logout path

**Covers:** IMP-7 (banner, toast), IMP-9 (start), IMP-11 (hidden UI), IMP-12 (dataset), TEN-3, DEC26-5, DEC26-7 (`#[RequiresTenant]`), USR-9, X3, R-8, RL-11 (banner), RL-20; RK-I6 (button), RK-I12 (actions), RK-M5.

What this task delivers, in plain words (spec §4.4, §4.7, §6.2, §6.8):

- **Start from the users index** (USR-9): each row the actor may impersonate (Task 19's batch `impersonate` column — never a per-row policy query) shows a "Log in as this user" button. It opens a modal that asks for the reason (required, at most 500 characters; the error comes from `StartImpersonation`). Confirming starts the impersonation and loads the dashboard as the target with a full page load. This Livewire action **is** spec §6.8's "start route": it is marked `#[RequiresTenant]` (a new Livewire method attribute that answers 404 on the apex and the admin host before the method runs, also for a forged `/livewire/update`, TEN-3), and both the confirm and the start action answer 404 when the module is off (RK-I12). Super admins reach other organisations' users by "Open"-ing that organisation first (Task 17): on central hosts the column is always false.
- **Sticky banner** (IMP-7, RL-11): while impersonating, every app page shows "Logged in as :name" with a "Back to your own account" button that submits `DELETE /impersonation`; after it the "You are back in your own account." toast appears through Task 12's flash bridge (X3). Hidden when the module is off or nobody is impersonating. It lives inside `<flux:main>` of the app layout (re-rendered on every page, outside `@persist`, so it survives `wire:navigate`; M5 moves it to `layouts/base`).
- **Logout path** (RK-M5): signing out while impersonating first ends the impersonation (logged, `ended_because` = `logout`) and then signs the real user out, so the impersonated user's remember token is never cycled. The Fortify `POST /logout` route is redefined with the same method, URI and name plus `StopImpersonationBeforeLogout`; the starter kit's `App\Livewire\Actions\Logout` does the same.
- The module dataset over the flag (IMP-12): with the module on the stop route, button, banner, actions and `can('impersonate')` work; with it off they answer 404 or are hidden.

```php
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Auth;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;

beforeEach(function (): void {
    useImpersonationModule(true);
});

/** A user of $organisation holding the organisation_admin template role (DEC-21), not signed in. */
$organisationAdmin = function (Organisation $organisation): User {
    $user = User::factory()->for($organisation)->create();
    withPermissionsTeam($organisation->id, fn (): User => $user->assignRole(Role::OrganisationAdmin->value));
    $user->unsetRelation('roles');

    return $user;
};

it('shows the action only on tenant hosts and only for targets the actor may impersonate', function () use ($organisationAdmin): void {
    $organisation = Organisation::factory()->create();
    $member = User::factory()->for($organisation)->create();
    $otherAdmin = $organisationAdmin($organisation);
    $admin = asOrgAdmin($organisation);

    $this->get(route('users.index'))->assertOk()
        ->assertSee('data-test="impersonate-'.$member->id.'"', false)
        ->assertDontSee('data-test="impersonate-'.$otherAdmin->id.'"', false)
        ->assertDontSee('data-test="impersonate-'.$admin->id.'"', false);

    asSuperAdmin();
    onAdminHost();

    $this->get(route('users.index'))->assertOk()
        ->assertSee($member->email)
        ->assertDontSee('data-test="impersonate-', false);
});

it('starts from the users index with a reason and lands on the dashboard as the target', function () use ($organisationAdmin): void {
    $organisation = Organisation::factory()->create();
    $admin = $organisationAdmin($organisation);
    $member = User::factory()->for($organisation)->create();
    onTenant($organisation);
    $this->post(route('login.store'), ['email' => $admin->email, 'password' => 'password'])->assertRedirect();
    Auth::guard('web')->forgetUser();

    $snapshot = pageSnapshot(route('users.index'), 'pages::users.index');
    $confirmed = callPageAction($snapshot, 'confirmImpersonation', [$member->id])->assertOk();

    /** @var array<string, mixed> $afterConfirm */
    $afterConfirm = json_decode((string) $confirmed->json('components.0.snapshot'), true, flags: JSON_THROW_ON_ERROR);

    Auth::guard('web')->forgetUser();
    callPageAction($afterConfirm, 'startImpersonation', [], ['impersonationReason' => '   '])->assertOk();
    expect(Impersonation::isActive())->toBeFalse();

    Auth::guard('web')->forgetUser();
    callPageAction($afterConfirm, 'startImpersonation', [], ['impersonationReason' => 'Ticket 42'])
        ->assertOk()
        ->assertJsonPath('components.0.effects.redirect', route('dashboard'));

    Auth::guard('web')->forgetUser();
    $this->get(route('dashboard'))->assertOk();
    $this->assertAuthenticatedAs($member);
    expect(recordedActivity(ActivityEvent::ImpersonationStarted)->sole()->getProperty('reason'))->toBe('Ticket 42');
});

it('refuses a forged start from the apex and the admin host with 404 (TEN-3)', function (string $host): void {
    $organisation = Organisation::factory()->create();
    $member = User::factory()->for($organisation)->create();
    asSuperAdmin();

    if ($host === 'apex') {
        onApex();
    } else {
        onAdminHost();
    }

    // The forged updates go to the current origin, the central host.
    $snapshot = pageSnapshot(route('users.index'), 'pages::users.index');

    callPageAction($snapshot, 'startImpersonation', [], ['impersonationReason' => 'Ticket 42'])->assertNotFound();
    callPageAction($snapshot, 'confirmImpersonation', [$member->id])->assertForbidden();
    expect(Impersonation::isActive())->toBeFalse();
})->with(['apex', 'admin']);

it('shows the sticky banner with a stop button while impersonating', function () use ($organisationAdmin): void {
    $organisation = Organisation::factory()->create();
    $admin = $organisationAdmin($organisation);
    $member = User::factory()->for($organisation)->create();
    onTenant($organisation);
    startImpersonatingOverHttp($admin, $member);

    $this->get(route('dashboard'))->assertOk()
        ->assertSee('data-test="impersonation-banner"', false)
        ->assertSee(__('Logged in as :name', ['name' => $member->name]))
        ->assertSee('action="'.route('impersonation.stop').'"', false)
        ->assertSee('name="_method" value="DELETE"', false)
        ->assertSee('data-test="stop-impersonating"', false);

    Auth::guard('web')->forgetUser();
    $this->delete(route('impersonation.stop'));
    Auth::guard('web')->forgetUser();

    $this->get(route('dashboard'))->assertOk()->assertDontSee('data-test="impersonation-banner"', false);
});

it('stops through DELETE /impersonation and shows the "stopped" toast (IMP-7, X3)', function () use ($organisationAdmin): void {
    $organisation = Organisation::factory()->create();
    $admin = $organisationAdmin($organisation);
    $member = User::factory()->for($organisation)->create();
    onTenant($organisation);
    startImpersonatingOverHttp($admin, $member);

    $this->delete(route('impersonation.stop'))
        ->assertRedirect(route('users.index'))
        ->assertSessionHas('status', __('You are back in your own account.'));

    Auth::guard('web')->forgetUser();
    // Task 12's bridge turns the flash into a Flux toast on the next app page.
    $this->get(route('users.index'))->assertOk()
        ->assertSee('data-flash-toast', false)
        ->assertSee(__('You are back in your own account.'));
    $this->assertAuthenticatedAs($admin);
});

it('stops the impersonation before signing out and leaves the target\'s remember token alone', function () use ($organisationAdmin): void {
    $organisation = Organisation::factory()->create();
    $admin = $organisationAdmin($organisation);
    $member = User::factory()->for($organisation)->create();
    $rememberToken = DB::table('users')->where('id', $member->id)->value('remember_token');
    onTenant($organisation);
    startImpersonatingOverHttp($admin, $member);

    $this->post(route('logout'))->assertRedirect();

    $this->assertGuest();
    expect(Impersonation::isActive())->toBeFalse()
        ->and(DB::table('users')->where('id', $member->id)->value('remember_token'))->toBe($rememberToken)
        ->and(recordedActivity(ActivityEvent::ImpersonationStopped)->sole()->getProperty('ended_because'))->toBe('logout');
});

it('stops the impersonation in the Logout action too (RK-M5)', function () use ($organisationAdmin): void {
    $organisation = Organisation::factory()->create();
    $admin = $organisationAdmin($organisation);
    $member = User::factory()->for($organisation)->create();
    $rememberToken = DB::table('users')->where('id', $member->id)->value('remember_token');
    onTenant($organisation);
    startImpersonatingOverHttp($admin, $member);

    app(Logout::class)();

    expect(Auth::guard('web')->check())->toBeFalse()
        ->and(Impersonation::isActive())->toBeFalse()
        ->and(DB::table('users')->where('id', $member->id)->value('remember_token'))->toBe($rememberToken)
        ->and(recordedActivity(ActivityEvent::ImpersonationStopped)->sole()->getProperty('ended_because'))->toBe('logout');
});
```

```php
<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

/** covers §6.8, §7.2 */

use App\Authorization\Role;
use App\Models\Organisation;
use App\Models\User;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Auth;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Gate;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Route;

/** A user of $organisation holding the organisation_admin template role (DEC-21), not signed in. */
$organisationAdmin = function (Organisation $organisation): User {
    $user = User::factory()->for($organisation)->create();
    withPermissionsTeam($organisation->id, fn (): User => $user->assignRole(Role::OrganisationAdmin->value));
    $user->unsetRelation('roles');

    return $user;
};

it('switches the whole impersonation module with its flag (IMP-11, IMP-12)', function (bool $enabled) use ($organisationAdmin): void {
    useImpersonationModule($enabled);
    $organisation = Organisation::factory()->create();
    $admin = $organisationAdmin($organisation);
    $member = User::factory()->for($organisation)->create();
    onTenant($organisation);

    expect(Route::has('impersonation.stop'))->toBe($enabled)
        ->and(Gate::forUser($admin)->allows('impersonate', $member))->toBe($enabled);

    $this->post(route('login.store'), ['email' => $admin->email, 'password' => 'password'])->assertRedirect();
    Auth::guard('web')->forgetUser();

    $index = $this->get(route('users.index'))->assertOk();

    if ($enabled) {
        $index->assertSee('data-test="impersonate-'.$member->id.'"', false);
    } else {
        $index->assertDontSee('data-test="impersonate-', false)->assertDontSee('data-test="impersonation-reason-modal"', false);
    }

    Auth::guard('web')->forgetUser();
    $snapshot = pageSnapshot(route('users.index'), 'pages::users.index');
    $confirmed = callPageAction($snapshot, 'confirmImpersonation', [$member->id])->assertStatus($enabled ? 200 : 404);

    Auth::guard('web')->forgetUser();

    if ($enabled) {
        /** @var array<string, mixed> $afterConfirm */
        $afterConfirm = json_decode((string) $confirmed->json('components.0.snapshot'), true, flags: JSON_THROW_ON_ERROR);
        callPageAction($afterConfirm, 'startImpersonation', [], ['impersonationReason' => 'Ticket 42'])
            ->assertOk()
            ->assertJsonPath('components.0.effects.redirect', route('dashboard'));
    } else {
        callPageAction($snapshot, 'startImpersonation', [], ['impersonationReason' => 'Ticket 42'])->assertNotFound();
    }

    Auth::guard('web')->forgetUser();
    $dashboard = $this->get(route('dashboard'))->assertOk();

    if ($enabled) {
        $dashboard->assertSee('data-test="impersonation-banner"', false);
    } else {
        $dashboard->assertDontSee('data-test="impersonation-banner"', false);
    }

    Auth::guard('web')->forgetUser();
    $this->delete('/impersonation')->assertStatus($enabled ? 302 : 404);
})->with(['on' => [true], 'off' => [false]]);
```

```php
<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace App\Tenancy\Attributes;

use App\Tenancy\Facades\Tenant;
use Livewire\Features\SupportAttributes\Attribute;

/**
 * Marks a Livewire action that works on a tenant host only (§6.2, DEC-26 (7)). On the apex or the admin host
 * it answers 404 before the method runs, also for a forged /livewire/update; Livewire calls this hook for
 * method attributes (SupportAttributes::call(), like its own #[Authorize]).
 */
#[\Attribute(\Attribute::TARGET_METHOD)]
final class RequiresTenant extends Attribute
{
    /** @param  array<int|string, mixed>  $parameters */
    public function call(array $parameters): void
    {
        abort_unless(Tenant::check(), 404);
    }
}
```

```php
    public function confirmImpersonation(int $userId): void
    {
        abort_unless(Impersonation::enabled(), 404);

        $target = $this->findUser($userId);

        $this->impersonatingUserId = $target->id;

     * route (§6.8): tenant hosts only, 404 while the module is off (RK-I12).
     */
    #[RequiresTenant]
    public function startImpersonation(StartImpersonation $startImpersonation): void
    {
        abort_unless(Impersonation::enabled(), 404);

        $target = $this->findUser($this->impersonatingUserId ?? abort(404));
        $this->authorize('impersonate', $target);

        $startImpersonation->handle($this->currentUser(), $target, $this->impersonationReason);

        // A full page load: this page's snapshot belongs to the impersonator.
        $this->redirect(route('dashboard'));

        $this->impersonatingUserName = '';
```

- [ ] **Step 6: The logout path**

`app/Tenancy/Http/Middleware/StopImpersonationBeforeLogout.php`:

```php
<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace App\Tenancy\Http\Middleware;

use App\Actions\Users\StopImpersonation;
use Closure;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use Symfony\Component\HttpFoundation\Response;

/**
 * Signing out while impersonating first ends the impersonation (logged, ended_because logout), so the
 * logout that follows signs the real user out and never cycles the impersonated user's remember token
 * (§4.7, RL-20).
 */
final readonly class StopImpersonationBeforeLogout
{
    public function __construct(private StopImpersonation $stopImpersonation) {}

    /** @param  Closure(Request): Response  $next */
    public function handle(Request $request, Closure $next): Response
    {
        $this->stopImpersonation->handle('logout');

        return $next($request);
    }
}
```

In `routes/web.php`, add `use App\Tenancy\Http\Middleware\StopImpersonationBeforeLogout;` and `use Laravel\Fortify\Http\Controllers\AuthenticatedSessionController;` to the imports and, after the redefined `password.update` route:

```php
// §4.7: signing out while impersonating ends the impersonation first. Same method, URI and name as Fortify's
// route, so this one replaces it.
Route::post('logout', [AuthenticatedSessionController::class, 'destroy'])
    ->middleware(['auth:web', StopImpersonationBeforeLogout::class])
    ->name('logout');
```

Replace `app/Livewire/Actions/Logout.php` with:

```php
<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace App\Livewire\Actions;

use App\Actions\Users\StopImpersonation;
use Illuminate\Http\RedirectResponse;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Auth;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Session;
use Livewire\Features\SupportRedirects\Redirector;

class Logout
{
    public function __construct(private readonly StopImpersonation $stopImpersonation) {}

    /**
     * Log the current user out of the application. A running impersonation ends first (logged), so the
     * impersonated user's remember token is left alone (RK-M5).
     */
    public function __invoke(): Redirector|RedirectResponse
    {
        $this->stopImpersonation->handle('logout');

        Auth::guard('web')->logout();

        Session::invalidate();
        Session::regenerateToken();

        return redirect('/');
    }
}
```

  - `App\Actions\Audit\RecordActivity::handle(ActivityEvent $event, ?Model $subject = null, array $properties = [], array $changes = [], ?User $causer = null, ?Organisation $organisation = null, bool $defaultCauser = true): Activity` and the cases `ActivityEvent::{RoleCreated,RoleUpdated,RoleDeleted}` (group `roles`, subject-mode tagging; Task 1).

  - `App\Authorization\SyncPermissions::GUARD` (`'web'`), `Spatie\Permission\PermissionRegistrar::forgetCachedPermissions()`, `App\Authorization\SuperAdminGate::ALWAYS_CHECKED` (already contains `delete`).
- Produces:
  - `App\Policies\RolePolicy` (final): `viewAny(User $actor): bool` (`roles.view`), `create(User $actor): bool` (`roles.manage`), `update(User $actor, RoleModel $role): bool` (`roles.manage` and, for non-super actors, `$role->team_id === $actor->organisation_id`), `delete(User $actor, RoleModel $role): bool` (always checked: never a system role — `team_id` NULL — for anyone; super admins explicitly; others `roles.manage` with the same team check). Registered in `AppServiceProvider::configureAuthorization()` with `Gate::policy(RoleModel::class, RolePolicy::class)`.
  - `App\Authorization\Permission::assignableToCustomRoles(): array` — `@return list<self>`: `Permission::organisationAdmin()` (the catalogue minus super-only) minus `UsersImpersonate` while `Impersonation::enabled()` is false.
  - `App\Concerns\ManagesCustomRoles` (trait, new): `validatedRoleName(string $name, int $teamId, ?int $ignoreRoleId = null): string`, `assignablePermissionValues(array $permissions): array` (`@param list<Permission>`, `@return list<string>`), `lockedRole(Organisation $organisation, int $roleId): RoleModel`.
  - `App\Actions\Roles\CreateRole::handle(User $actor, Organisation $organisation, string $name, array $permissions): RoleModel` — `@param list<Permission> $permissions`.
  - `App\Actions\Roles\UpdateRole::handle(User $actor, Organisation $organisation, int $roleId, string $name, array $permissions): RoleModel` — `@param list<Permission> $permissions`.
  - `App\Actions\Roles\DeleteRole::handle(User $actor, Organisation $organisation, int $roleId): int` — returns the number of holders the role was taken from.
  - Audit rows: `role.created` (`properties`: `name`, `permissions`), `role.updated` (`attribute_changes`: `old`/`attributes` with only the changed keys of `name` and `permissions`; nothing is written when nothing changed), `role.deleted` (`properties`: `name`, `holders`); every row tagged with the role's organisation, passed explicitly.

**Rules this task implements** (spec §4.6, §4.8, §6.8; RL-19, RL-5, RK-I11, RK-M7, RK-M9, CV-4, X14, W1, W6, FU2-3):
- Custom roles are always team-scoped: the team is the organisation's id; a role without a team is never created (ROLE-8). The two system roles (`super_admin`, `organisation_admin`, both with `team_id` NULL) can never be renamed, re-permissioned or deleted — also not by super admins, who pass `update` through `Gate::before`, so that protection lives in `UpdateRole` and in the always-checked `RolePolicy::delete` (W6, ROLE-6, ROLE-20).
- A role name is trimmed, required, at most 255 characters, not a system role's name in any case or spacing (`Organisation_Admin`, ` super admin `, `SUPER-ADMIN`), and unique per team compared case-insensitively **in PHP** (a SQL `LIKE` would treat `_` as a wildcard). The same name in another team is fine. A unique-index race becomes the same validation error.
- Permissions must come from `Permission::assignableToCustomRoles()`: super-only permissions (`roles.manage`, `organisations.create`, `organisations.delete`, `system.health`) never (ROLE-9), and `users.impersonate` not while the impersonation module is off (ROLE-17). Anything else is a `permissions` validation error.
- `UpdateRole` keeps permissions the role already holds that the editor currently hides (held ∩ (`organisationAdmin()` − `assignableToCustomRoles()`), i.e. `users.impersonate` while the module is off), so saving with the module off never strips it (§6.8 "stable sync", CV-4).
- Role lookups by id never leave the organisation's team: another team's role is a `ModelNotFoundException` (404) (W1, ROLE-10). The lookup also finds the two null-team system roles, so they are refused by name instead of answering "not found".
- Every action locks the organisation with `HostScope::lockForWrite()` inside its transaction (archived or another tenant's organisation refused, RK-I11), authorises with `Gate::forUser($actor)`, logs through `RecordActivity` with `organisation: $organisation` (a Spatie role carries `team_id`, not `organisation_id`, RL-5) and forgets Spatie's permission cache after commit.
- Deleting an assigned custom role is allowed: holders lose it, the action returns how many, and the count is logged (X14).
- Only `roles.manage` holders manage roles; `roles.manage` is super-only, so in practice only super admins do. For non-super actors `RolePolicy` also requires the role's team to be their organisation (RK-M9). CreateRole applies the same own-organisation check for non-super actors.

- [ ] **Step 3: The assignable permission set**

In `app/Authorization/Permission.php`, add the import `use App\Tenancy\Auth\Impersonation;` below `namespace App\Authorization;` and add this method directly after `organisationAdmin()`:

```php
    /**
     * The permissions the role editor offers custom roles (§4.6, §6.8): the catalogue minus the
     * super-only ones, and without users.impersonate while the impersonation module is off.
     * users.impersonate stays in the catalogue either way (stable sync).
     *
     * @return list<self>
     */
    public static function assignableToCustomRoles(): array
    {
        return array_values(array_filter(
            self::organisationAdmin(),
            fn (self $permission): bool => $permission !== self::UsersImpersonate || Impersonation::enabled(),
        ));
    }
```

- [ ] **Step 4: `RolePolicy` and its registration**

`app/Policies/RolePolicy.php`:

```php
<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace App\Policies;

use App\Authorization\Permission;
use App\Models\User;
use Spatie\Permission\Models\Role as RoleModel;

/**
 * §4.6: roles are viewed with roles.view and managed with roles.manage (super-only). For
 * non-super actors a role must belong to their own organisation's team (RK-M9). System roles
 * (team_id NULL) are protected: delete is always checked and refuses them to everyone; update
 * passes super admins through Gate::before, so UpdateRole refuses system roles itself (W6).
 */
final class RolePolicy
{
    public function viewAny(User $actor): bool
    {
        return $actor->can(Permission::RolesView);
    }

    /** Super admins pass through Gate::before. */
    public function create(User $actor): bool
    {
        return $actor->can(Permission::RolesManage);
    }

    /** Super admins pass through Gate::before; UpdateRole refuses system roles (W6). */
    public function update(User $actor, RoleModel $role): bool
    {
        return $actor->can(Permission::RolesManage) && $this->inOwnTeam($actor, $role);
    }

    /** Always checked (SuperAdminGate::ALWAYS_CHECKED): system roles are never deleted, by anyone (W6, FU2-3). */
    public function delete(User $actor, RoleModel $role): bool
    {
        if ($this->isSystemRole($role)) {
            return false;
        }

        if ($actor->isSuperAdmin()) {
            return true;
        }

        return $actor->can(Permission::RolesManage) && $this->inOwnTeam($actor, $role);
    }

    /** The two system roles are the only roles without a team; a custom role always has one (ROLE-8). */
    private function isSystemRole(RoleModel $role): bool
    {
        return $role->getAttribute('team_id') === null;
    }

    private function inOwnTeam(User $actor, RoleModel $role): bool
    {
        $teamId = $role->getAttribute('team_id');

        return $teamId !== null && $actor->organisation_id !== null && (int) $teamId === $actor->organisation_id;
    }
}
```

In `app/Providers/AppServiceProvider.php`, add the imports `use App\Policies\RolePolicy;` and `use Spatie\Permission\Models\Role as RoleModel;` (sorted with the others) and replace `configureAuthorization()` with:

```php
    /**
     * Super admins pass every gate check except the always-checked abilities (§4.6). Spatie's
     * role model lives outside App\Models, so policy discovery does not find RolePolicy.
     */
    protected function configureAuthorization(): void
    {
        Gate::before(SuperAdminGate::before(...));

        Gate::policy(RoleModel::class, RolePolicy::class);
    }
```

- [ ] **Step 5: Shared rules of the role actions**

`app/Concerns/ManagesCustomRoles.php`:

```php
<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace App\Concerns;

use App\Authorization\Permission;
use App\Authorization\Role;
use App\Models\Organisation;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Builder;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\ModelNotFoundException;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Validator;
use Illuminate\Validation\ValidationException;
use Spatie\Permission\Models\Role as RoleModel;

/**
 * Input rules and lookups shared by the custom-role actions (§4.6, RL-19): trimmed names that
 * are not a system role's name and unique per team, permissions from the role editor's set,
 * and role lookups that never leave the organisation's team (W1).
 */
trait ManagesCustomRoles
{
    /**
     * The trimmed name, refused when empty, longer than 255, reserved for a system role in any
     * case or spacing (W6) or already used in the team (case-insensitive).
     *
     * @throws ValidationException
     */
    protected function validatedRoleName(string $name, int $teamId, ?int $ignoreRoleId = null): string
    {
        $name = trim($name);

        Validator::make(['name' => $name], ['name' => ['required', 'string', 'max:255']])->validate();

        if (Role::isReservedName($name)) {
            throw ValidationException::withMessages(['name' => __('This name is reserved for a system role.')]);
        }

        $query = RoleModel::query()->where('team_id', $teamId);

        if ($ignoreRoleId !== null) {
            $query->whereKeyNot($ignoreRoleId);
        }

        // Compared in PHP: a LIKE would treat the underscore in a name as a wildcard (RL-19).
        $taken = $query->pluck('name')
            ->contains(fn (mixed $existing): bool => mb_strtolower((string) $existing) === mb_strtolower($name));

        if ($taken) {
            throw ValidationException::withMessages(['name' => __('This organisation already has a role with this name.')]);
        }

        return $name;
    }

    /**
     * The permission names to store, sorted and without duplicates. Anything the role editor does
     * not offer (super-only, or users.impersonate while the module is off) is refused (ROLE-9, ROLE-17).
     *
     * @param  list<Permission>  $permissions
     * @return list<string>
     *
     * @throws ValidationException
     */
    protected function assignablePermissionValues(array $permissions): array
    {
        $assignable = Permission::assignableToCustomRoles();

        foreach ($permissions as $permission) {
            if (! in_array($permission, $assignable, true)) {
                throw ValidationException::withMessages([
                    'permissions' => __('One or more permissions cannot be given to a custom role.'),
                ]);
            }
        }

        $values = array_values(array_unique(array_map(fn (Permission $permission): string => $permission->value, $permissions)));
        sort($values);

        return $values;
    }

    /**
     * The role with this id in the organisation's team, locked; or one of the two system roles
     * (team_id NULL), so callers refuse those by name. Any other team's role is not found (W1).
     *
     * @throws ModelNotFoundException
     */
    protected function lockedRole(Organisation $organisation, int $roleId): RoleModel
    {
        return RoleModel::query()
            ->whereKey($roleId)
            ->where(function (Builder $query) use ($organisation): void {
                $query->where('team_id', $organisation->id)->orWhereNull('team_id');
            })
            ->lockForUpdate()
            ->firstOrFail();
    }
}
```

- [ ] **Step 6: The three role actions**

`app/Actions/Roles/CreateRole.php`:

```php
<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace App\Actions\Roles;

use App\Actions\Audit\RecordActivity;
use App\Authorization\Permission;
use App\Authorization\SyncPermissions;
use App\Concerns\ManagesCustomRoles;
use App\Enums\ActivityEvent;
use App\Models\Organisation;
use App\Models\User;
use App\Tenancy\HostScope;
use Illuminate\Auth\Access\AuthorizationException;
use Illuminate\Database\UniqueConstraintViolationException;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Gate;
use Illuminate\Validation\ValidationException;
use Spatie\Permission\Models\Role as RoleModel;
use Spatie\Permission\PermissionRegistrar;

/**
 * Creates a custom role in an organisation's team (§4.6): never without a team (ROLE-8), never
 * with a system role's name (W6), only with permissions the role editor offers (ROLE-9,
 * ROLE-17). The organisation is locked first, so an archived one or, on a tenant host, another
 * organisation is refused (RK-I11).
 */
final class CreateRole
{
    use ManagesCustomRoles;

    public function __construct(private readonly RecordActivity $recordActivity) {}

    /**
     * @param  list<Permission>  $permissions
     *
     * @throws AuthorizationException
     * @throws ValidationException
     */
    public function handle(User $actor, Organisation $organisation, string $name, array $permissions): RoleModel
    {
        Gate::forUser($actor)->authorize('create', RoleModel::class);

        if (! $actor->isSuperAdmin() && $actor->organisation_id !== $organisation->id) {
            throw new AuthorizationException; // RK-M9: non-super actors only create roles in their own organisation
        }

        $values = $this->assignablePermissionValues($permissions);

        return DB::transaction(function () use ($actor, $organisation, $name, $values): RoleModel {
            $organisation = HostScope::lockForWrite($organisation);
            $name = $this->validatedRoleName($name, $organisation->id);

            try {
                $role = RoleModel::query()->create([
                    'name' => $name,
                    'guard_name' => SyncPermissions::GUARD,
                    'team_id' => $organisation->id,
                ]);
            } catch (UniqueConstraintViolationException) {
                throw ValidationException::withMessages(['name' => __('This organisation already has a role with this name.')]);
            }

            $role->syncPermissions($values);

            $this->recordActivity->handle(
                ActivityEvent::RoleCreated,
                $role,
                properties: ['name' => $name, 'permissions' => $values],
                causer: $actor,
                organisation: $organisation,
            );

            DB::afterCommit(fn () => app(PermissionRegistrar::class)->forgetCachedPermissions());

            return $role;
        });
    }
}
```

`app/Actions/Roles/UpdateRole.php`:

```php
<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace App\Actions\Roles;

use App\Actions\Audit\RecordActivity;
use App\Authorization\Permission;
use App\Concerns\ManagesCustomRoles;
use App\Enums\ActivityEvent;
use App\Models\Organisation;
use App\Models\User;
use App\Tenancy\HostScope;
use Illuminate\Auth\Access\AuthorizationException;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\ModelNotFoundException;
use Illuminate\Database\UniqueConstraintViolationException;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Gate;
use Illuminate\Validation\ValidationException;
use Spatie\Permission\Models\Role as RoleModel;
use Spatie\Permission\PermissionRegistrar;

/**
 * Renames a custom role and sets its permissions (§4.6). The role is looked up in the
 * organisation's team only (W1); system roles are refused for everyone, super admins included
 * (W6). Permissions the role holds but the editor hides right now (users.impersonate while the
 * module is off) are kept, so a save never strips them (§6.8, CV-4).
 */
final class UpdateRole
{
    use ManagesCustomRoles;

    public function __construct(private readonly RecordActivity $recordActivity) {}

    /**
     * @param  list<Permission>  $permissions
     *
     * @throws AuthorizationException
     * @throws ModelNotFoundException
     * @throws ValidationException
     */
    public function handle(User $actor, Organisation $organisation, int $roleId, string $name, array $permissions): RoleModel
    {
        $values = $this->assignablePermissionValues($permissions);

        return DB::transaction(function () use ($actor, $organisation, $roleId, $name, $values): RoleModel {
            $organisation = HostScope::lockForWrite($organisation);
            $role = $this->lockedRole($organisation, $roleId);

            Gate::forUser($actor)->authorize('update', $role);

            // Gate::before lets super admins through update, so the system-role guard lives here (W6).
            if ($role->getAttribute('team_id') === null) {
                throw ValidationException::withMessages(['role' => __('System roles cannot be changed.')]);
            }

            $old = ['name' => $role->name, 'permissions' => $this->permissionValuesOf($role)];
            $new = [
                'name' => $this->validatedRoleName($name, $organisation->id, (int) $role->getKey()),
                'permissions' => $this->savedPermissionValues($old['permissions'], $values),
            ];

            try {
                $role->forceFill(['name' => $new['name']])->save();
            } catch (UniqueConstraintViolationException) {
                throw ValidationException::withMessages(['name' => __('This organisation already has a role with this name.')]);
            }

            $role->syncPermissions($new['permissions']);
            $role->unsetRelation('permissions');

            $changes = $this->changes($old, $new);

            if ($changes['old'] !== []) {
                $this->recordActivity->handle(
                    ActivityEvent::RoleUpdated,
                    $role,
                    changes: $changes,
                    causer: $actor,
                    organisation: $organisation,
                );
            }

            DB::afterCommit(fn () => app(PermissionRegistrar::class)->forgetCachedPermissions());

            return $role;
        });
    }

    /** @return list<string> */
    private function permissionValuesOf(RoleModel $role): array
    {
        $values = $role->permissions()->pluck('name')->map(fn (mixed $name): string => (string) $name)->all();
        sort($values);

        return $values;
    }

    /**
     * The posted permissions plus the held ones the editor hides right now (CV-4).
     *
     * @param  list<string>  $held
     * @param  list<string>  $posted
     * @return list<string>
     */
    private function savedPermissionValues(array $held, array $posted): array
    {
        $offered = array_map(fn (Permission $permission): string => $permission->value, Permission::assignableToCustomRoles());
        $teamPermissions = array_map(fn (Permission $permission): string => $permission->value, Permission::organisationAdmin());
        $hidden = array_diff($teamPermissions, $offered);

        $saved = array_values(array_unique([...$posted, ...array_intersect($held, $hidden)]));
        sort($saved);

        return $saved;
    }

    /**
     * The changed keys only, as the audit diff (ROLE-19).
     *
     * @param  array{name: string, permissions: list<string>}  $old
     * @param  array{name: string, permissions: list<string>}  $new
     * @return array{old: array<string, mixed>, attributes: array<string, mixed>}
     */
    private function changes(array $old, array $new): array
    {
        $changes = ['old' => [], 'attributes' => []];

        foreach ($new as $key => $value) {
            if ($old[$key] !== $value) {
                $changes['old'][$key] = $old[$key];
                $changes['attributes'][$key] = $value;
            }
        }

        return $changes;
    }
}
```

`app/Actions/Roles/DeleteRole.php`:

```php
<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace App\Actions\Roles;

use App\Actions\Audit\RecordActivity;
use App\Concerns\ManagesCustomRoles;
use App\Enums\ActivityEvent;
use App\Models\Organisation;
use App\Models\User;
use App\Tenancy\HostScope;
use Illuminate\Auth\Access\AuthorizationException;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\ModelNotFoundException;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Gate;
use Illuminate\Validation\ValidationException;
use Spatie\Permission\PermissionRegistrar;

/**
 * Deletes a custom role of the organisation's team (§4.6). Assigned roles may be deleted: the
 * holders lose the role, and the number of holders is returned and logged (X14). System roles
 * are refused by the always-checked RolePolicy::delete, for super admins too (W6).
 */
final class DeleteRole
{
    use ManagesCustomRoles;

    public function __construct(private readonly RecordActivity $recordActivity) {}

    /**
     * @return int the number of users the role was taken from
     *
     * @throws AuthorizationException
     * @throws ModelNotFoundException
     * @throws ValidationException
     */
    public function handle(User $actor, Organisation $organisation, int $roleId): int
    {
        return DB::transaction(function () use ($actor, $organisation, $roleId): int {
            $organisation = HostScope::lockForWrite($organisation);
            $role = $this->lockedRole($organisation, $roleId);

            Gate::forUser($actor)->authorize('delete', $role);

            $holders = DB::table('model_has_roles')->where('role_id', $role->getKey())->count();
            $name = $role->name;

            // Spatie detaches the role from its holders and its permissions while deleting it (X14).
            $role->delete();

            $this->recordActivity->handle(
                ActivityEvent::RoleDeleted,
                $role,
                properties: ['name' => $name, 'holders' => $holders],
                causer: $actor,
                organisation: $organisation,
            );

            DB::afterCommit(fn () => app(PermissionRegistrar::class)->forgetCachedPermissions());

            return $holders;
        });
    }
}
```

### Task 23: Roles index page

**Covers:** ROLE-5 (page), ROLE-6 (UI), ROLE-7, ROLE-8 (picker), ROLE-12, ROLE-17 (editor), ROLE-20, AUTHZ-3, TEN-3 (forged organisation), TEN-4, DEC26-1, IMP-11 (editor), W1 (page), W6 (page), RL-19; CV-5, OR-M8, RK-I4, RK-M7.

**Files:**
- Create: `resources/views/pages/roles/index/index.php`, `resources/views/pages/roles/index/index.blade.php`
- Modify: `routes/admin.php`, `resources/views/layouts/app/sidebar.blade.php` (Roles link in the Administration group), `tests/Feature/Tenancy/RouteHostMatrixTest.php` (`roles.index`), `tests/Feature/Navigation/AdministrationLinksTest.php` (Roles link per actor), `lang/nl.json`, `lang/en.json`
- Test: `tests/Feature/Roles/RolesIndexTest.php`

**Interfaces:**
- Consumes:
  - `CreateRole`, `UpdateRole`, `DeleteRole`, `RolePolicy`, `Permission::assignableToCustomRoles()` (Task 22); `Permission::{label,description,group}`, `PermissionGroup::label()`, `Role::label()`, `Role::values()`.
  - `App\Tenancy\HostScope::organisationId(): ?int` (Task 7: the tenant id on a tenant host; `null` for a super admin on a central host; `AuthorizationException` otherwise), `App\Concerns\ResolvesCurrentUser::currentUser(): User` (Task 7), `App\Tenancy\Facades\Tenant::{check,current}()`.
  - Test helpers `pageSnapshot(string $url, string $component): array` and `callPageAction(array $snapshot, string $method, array $params = [], array $updates = [], ?string $host = null): TestResponse` (Task 7), `useImpersonationModule(bool $enabled): void` (Tasks 19/20).
  - The Administration sidebar group (Task 8, extended in Tasks 13 and 17), the `forbidden` matrix outcome (Task 8) and `AdministrationLinksTest.php` (Task 8).
- Produces:
  - Page `pages::roles.index` (`#[Title('Roles')]`):
    - `#[Url] public string $organisation = ''` — central filter and creation target; ignored on a tenant host.
    - `#[Locked] public ?int $editingRoleId = null`, `#[Locked] public ?int $formOrganisationId = null` (central only; on a tenant host the form always works for the tenant), `#[Locked] public ?int $deletingRoleId = null`, `#[Locked] public string $deletingRoleName = ''`.
    - `public string $name = ''`; `/** @var array<int, mixed> */ public array $permissions = []` (checked values; converted with `Permission::tryFrom()` in `save()`, anything else a `permissions` validation error, never a `ValueError`); `public bool $showRoleModal = false`, `public bool $showDeleteModal = false`.
    - `mount(): void` (`authorize('viewAny', RoleModel::class)`), `updatedOrganisation(): void` (`resetPage()`), `create(): void` (central: requires a picked, non-archived organisation — `organisation` error otherwise), `edit(int $roleId): void`, `save(CreateRole $createRole, UpdateRole $updateRole): void`, `confirmDelete(int $roleId): void`, `delete(DeleteRole $deleteRole): void`, `closeRoleModal(): void`, `closeDeleteModal(): void`.
    - `#[Computed] roles(): LengthAwarePaginator<int, RoleModel>` (custom roles of `HostScope::organisationId()`'s team; centrally every active organisation's, or the picked one's; 25 per page; permissions eager-loaded), `#[Computed] systemRoles(): Collection<int, RoleModel>`, `#[Computed] permissionGroups(): array<string, list<Permission>>` (keyed by `PermissionGroup` value), `#[Computed] organisationOptions(): array<int, string>` (central only, active organisations; empty on a tenant host), `#[Computed] holderCount(): int` (holders of the role in the delete modal).
  - Route `Route::livewire('roles', 'pages::roles.index')->can(Permission::RolesView)->name('roles.index')` (any host, inside the `auth` group of `routes/admin.php`).

**Rules this task implements** (spec §4.6, §6.2, §6.8; RL-19, RK-I4, CV-5, OR-M8, W1, W6, ROLE-20, AUTHZ-3, IMP-11):
- The roles index shows the two system roles first, each marked "Protected", with their permissions as read-only badges (the template shows the organisation-admin set; the `super_admin` badge has none — the flag grants access), and never an edit or delete control for them (ROLE-7, ROLE-20, AUTHZ-3: the template is protected like `super_admin`).
- Below it, the custom roles of the host's organisation with permission badges; on a central host every active organisation's roles with an organisation column and an organisation filter (`#[Url] $organisation`). On a tenant host only the tenant's roles are read and `?organisation=` is ignored (RK-I4).
- Create, edit and delete controls appear only for actors who pass `RolePolicy` (`roles.manage`, super-only): organisation admins see the roles read-only (C-20).
- A new role is created in the tenant on a tenant host, and on a central host only after an organisation was picked explicitly; a forged organisation id on a tenant host is ignored (ROLE-8, CV-5). Edit and delete only find custom roles of the host's team, so a forged id of another organisation's role or of a system role answers 404 (W1, W6).
- The editor is a modal with one `flux:checkbox.group` (free Flux, DEC-20) grouped by permission group, offering only `Permission::assignableToCustomRoles()`: no super-only permission and no `users.impersonate` while the module is off (IMP-11, ROLE-17). The delete modal shows how many users hold the role (X14).
- Every action re-resolves the role through the host scope and re-authorises before calling the action, which authorises again.

```php
    $foreign = $teamRoleIn($other, 'Finance Team', Permission::UsersView);
    asSuperAdmin();
    onTenant($own);
    $snapshot = pageSnapshot(route('roles.index'), 'pages::roles.index');

    callPageAction($snapshot, 'edit', [(int) $foreign->getKey()])->assertNotFound();
    callPageAction($snapshot, 'confirmDelete', [(int) $foreign->getKey()])->assertNotFound();

    expect(RoleModel::query()->findOrFail($foreign->getKey())->name)->toBe('Finance Team');
});

it('refuses a forged edit of the template role (W6)', function (): void {
    $organisation = Organisation::factory()->create();
    $template = RoleModel::query()->whereNull('team_id')->where('name', Role::OrganisationAdmin->value)->firstOrFail();
    $before = $template->permissions->pluck('name')->sort()->values()->all();
    asSuperAdmin();
    onTenant($organisation);
    $snapshot = pageSnapshot(route('roles.index'), 'pages::roles.index');

    callPageAction($snapshot, 'edit', [(int) $template->getKey()])->assertNotFound();
    callPageAction($snapshot, 'confirmDelete', [(int) $template->getKey()])->assertNotFound();

    $after = RoleModel::query()->findOrFail($template->getKey());

    expect($after->name)->toBe(Role::OrganisationAdmin->value)
        ->and($after->permissions->pluck('name')->sort()->values()->all())->toBe($before);
});

it('answers a validation error for an unknown or super-only permission value (OR-M8)', function (string $value): void {
    $organisation = Organisation::factory()->create();
    asSuperAdmin();
    onTenant($organisation);

    Livewire::test('pages::roles.index')
        ->call('create')
        ->set('name', 'Support')
        ->set('permissions', [Permission::UsersView->value, $value])
        ->call('save')
        ->assertHasErrors(['permissions']);

    expect(RoleModel::query()->where('name', 'Support')->exists())->toBeFalse();
})->with([
    'unknown' => 'nope.permission',
    'super-only' => Permission::RolesManage->value,
]);

it('groups permission checkboxes with their labels and offers no super-only permission', function (): void {
    useImpersonationModule(true);
    $organisation = Organisation::factory()->create();
    asSuperAdmin();
    onTenant($organisation);

    $component = Livewire::test('pages::roles.index')
        ->call('create')
        ->assertSee(PermissionGroup::Users->label())
        ->assertSee(PermissionGroup::Organisations->label())
        ->assertSee(PermissionGroup::ActivityLog->label());

    foreach (Permission::cases() as $permission) {
        if ($permission->superOnly()) {
            $component->assertDontSeeHtml('value="'.$permission->value.'"');
        } else {

        }
    }
});

it('hides users.impersonate in the editor when the module is off', function (bool $enabled): void {

})->with(['on' => true, 'off' => false]);
```

- [ ] **Step 3: Create the page component**

Run: `php artisan make:livewire pages::roles.index --no-interaction`

Replace `resources/views/pages/roles/index/index.php` with:

```php
<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

use App\Actions\Roles\CreateRole;
use App\Actions\Roles\DeleteRole;
use App\Actions\Roles\UpdateRole;
use App\Authorization\Permission;
use App\Authorization\Role;
use App\Concerns\ResolvesCurrentUser;
use App\Models\Organisation;
use App\Tenancy\Facades\Tenant;
use App\Tenancy\HostScope;
use Flux\Flux;
use Illuminate\Contracts\Pagination\LengthAwarePaginator;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Collection;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;
use Illuminate\Validation\ValidationException;
use Livewire\Attributes\Computed;
use Livewire\Attributes\Locked;
use Livewire\Attributes\Title;
use Livewire\Attributes\Url;
use Livewire\Component;
use Livewire\WithPagination;
use Spatie\Permission\Models\Role as RoleModel;

new #[Title('Roles')] class extends Component
{
    use ResolvesCurrentUser;
    use WithPagination;

    /** Central hosts only: whose roles are listed and where a new role goes; ignored on a tenant host (RK-I4). */
    #[Url]
    public string $organisation = '';

    #[Locked]
    public ?int $editingRoleId = null;

    /** Central hosts only; on a tenant host the form always works for the tenant (CV-5). */
    #[Locked]
    public ?int $formOrganisationId = null;

    #[Locked]
    public ?int $deletingRoleId = null;

    #[Locked]
    public string $deletingRoleName = '';

    public string $name = '';

    /** @var array<int, mixed> Checked permission values; converted and validated in save() (OR-M8). */
    public array $permissions = [];

    public bool $showRoleModal = false;

    public bool $showDeleteModal = false;

    /**
     * Mount the component.
     */
    public function mount(): void
    {
        $this->authorize('viewAny', RoleModel::class);
    }

    /**
     * Back to the first page when the organisation filter changes.
     */
    public function updatedOrganisation(): void
    {
        $this->resetPage();
    }

    /**
     * Open the editor for a new role: for the tenant on a tenant host, and on a central host only
     * for an explicitly picked, active organisation (ROLE-8).
     *
     * @throws ValidationException
     */
    public function create(): void
    {
        $this->authorize('create', RoleModel::class);
        $this->closeRoleModal();

        $this->formOrganisationId = Tenant::current()?->id ?? $this->pickedOrganisation()->id;
        $this->showRoleModal = true;
    }

    /**
     * Open the editor for a custom role of the host's organisation; system roles and other
     * organisations' roles are not found (W1, W6).
     */
    public function edit(int $roleId): void
    {
        $role = $this->scopedRole($roleId);
        $this->authorize('update', $role);
        $this->closeRoleModal();

        $offered = array_map(fn (Permission $permission): string => $permission->value, Permission::assignableToCustomRoles());
        $held = $role->permissions->pluck('name')->map(fn (mixed $name): string => (string) $name)->all();

        $this->editingRoleId = (int) $role->getKey();
        $this->formOrganisationId = (int) $role->getAttribute('team_id');
        $this->name = $role->name;
        // Held permissions the editor hides (users.impersonate while the module is off) stay on the role through UpdateRole (CV-4).
        $this->permissions = array_values(array_intersect($held, $offered));
        $this->showRoleModal = true;
    }

    /**
     * Create or update the role through its action, which authorises again and checks the
     * organisation, the name and the permissions (RL-19).
     *
     * @throws ValidationException
     */
    public function save(CreateRole $createRole, UpdateRole $updateRole): void
    {
        $organisation = $this->formOrganisation();
        $permissions = $this->postedPermissions();

        if ($this->editingRoleId === null) {
            $this->authorize('create', RoleModel::class);
            $createRole->handle($this->currentUser(), $organisation, $this->name, $permissions);
            $message = __('Role created.');
        } else {
            $this->authorize('update', $this->scopedRole($this->editingRoleId));
            $updateRole->handle($this->currentUser(), $organisation, $this->editingRoleId, $this->name, $permissions);
            $message = __('Role saved.');
        }

        $this->closeRoleModal();
        Flux::toast(variant: 'success', text: $message);
    }

    /**
     * Ask before deleting a custom role; the modal shows how many users hold it (X14).
     */
    public function confirmDelete(int $roleId): void
    {
        $role = $this->scopedRole($roleId);
        $this->authorize('delete', $role);

        $this->deletingRoleId = (int) $role->getKey();
        $this->deletingRoleName = $role->name;
        $this->showDeleteModal = true;
    }

    /**
     * Delete the role confirmed in the modal; its holders lose it (X14).
     */
    public function delete(DeleteRole $deleteRole): void
    {
        if ($this->deletingRoleId === null) {
            return;
        }

        $role = $this->scopedRole($this->deletingRoleId);
        $this->authorize('delete', $role);
        $organisation = Tenant::current() ?? Organisation::withTrashed()->findOrFail((int) $role->getAttribute('team_id'));

        $holders = $deleteRole->handle($this->currentUser(), $organisation, (int) $role->getKey());

        $this->closeDeleteModal();
        Flux::toast(variant: 'success', text: __('Role deleted. :count users lost it.', ['count' => $holders]));
    }

    /**
     * Close the editor and forget its state.
     */
    public function closeRoleModal(): void
    {
        $this->resetErrorBag();
        $this->showRoleModal = false;
        $this->editingRoleId = null;
        $this->formOrganisationId = null;
        $this->name = '';
        $this->permissions = [];
    }

    /**
     * Close the delete modal and forget its state.
     */
    public function closeDeleteModal(): void
    {
        $this->showDeleteModal = false;
        $this->deletingRoleId = null;
        $this->deletingRoleName = '';
    }

    /**
     * Custom roles of the host's organisation; on a central host every active organisation's
     * roles, or the picked organisation's.
     *
     * @return LengthAwarePaginator<int, RoleModel>
     */
    #[Computed]
    public function roles(): LengthAwarePaginator
    {
        $organisationId = HostScope::organisationId() ?? (ctype_digit($this->organisation) ? (int) $this->organisation : null);

        $query = RoleModel::query()
            ->whereNotNull('team_id')
            ->whereIn('team_id', Organisation::query()->select('id'))
            ->with('permissions');

        if ($organisationId !== null) {
            $query->where('team_id', $organisationId);
        }

        return $query->orderBy('name')->orderBy('id')->paginate(25);
    }

    /**
     * The two system roles, shown read-only (ROLE-7, ROLE-20).
     *
     * @return Collection<int, RoleModel>
     */
    #[Computed]
    public function systemRoles(): Collection
    {
        return RoleModel::query()
            ->whereNull('team_id')
            ->whereIn('name', Role::values())
            ->with('permissions')
            ->orderBy('name')
            ->get();
    }

    /**
     * The permissions the editor offers, by permission group (ROLE-9, ROLE-17).
     *
     * @return array<string, list<Permission>>
     */
    #[Computed]
    public function permissionGroups(): array
    {
        $groups = [];

        foreach (Permission::assignableToCustomRoles() as $permission) {
            $groups[$permission->group()->value][] = $permission;
        }

        return $groups;
    }

    /**
     * Active organisations for the central filter and picker; empty on a tenant host (RK-I4).
     *
     * @return array<int, string>
     */
    #[Computed]
    public function organisationOptions(): array
    {
        if (Tenant::check()) {
            return [];
        }

        $options = [];

        foreach (Organisation::query()->orderBy('name')->get(['id', 'name']) as $organisation) {
            $options[$organisation->id] = $organisation->name;
        }

        return $options;
    }

    /**
     * How many users hold the role in the delete modal (a plain count, no lock).
     */
    #[Computed]
    public function holderCount(): int
    {
        if ($this->deletingRoleId === null) {
            return 0;
        }

        return DB::table('model_has_roles')->where('role_id', $this->deletingRoleId)->count();
    }

    /**
     * A custom role of the host's organisation (any organisation's for a super admin on a central
     * host); never a system role.
     */
    private function scopedRole(int $roleId): RoleModel
    {
        $query = RoleModel::query()->whereNotNull('team_id')->with('permissions');
        $organisationId = HostScope::organisationId();

        if ($organisationId !== null) {
            $query->where('team_id', $organisationId);
        }

        return $query->findOrFail($roleId);
    }

    /**
     * The organisation the editor works for: always the tenant on a tenant host (CV-5).
     *
     * @throws ValidationException
     */
    private function formOrganisation(): Organisation
    {
        $tenant = Tenant::current();

        if ($tenant !== null) {
            return $tenant;
        }

        if ($this->formOrganisationId === null) {
            throw ValidationException::withMessages(['organisation' => __('Choose an organisation first.')]);
        }

        // withTrashed(): an organisation archived meanwhile gets the action's "archived" error (RK-I11).
        return Organisation::withTrashed()->findOrFail($this->formOrganisationId);
    }

    /**
     * The organisation picked in the central filter, active only.
     *
     * @throws ValidationException
     */
    private function pickedOrganisation(): Organisation
    {
        $organisation = ctype_digit($this->organisation)
            ? Organisation::query()->find((int) $this->organisation)
            : null;

        return $organisation ?? throw ValidationException::withMessages(['organisation' => __('Choose an organisation first.')]);
    }

    /**
     * The checked permissions as enum cases; an unknown or non-string value is a validation error,
     * never a ValueError (OR-M8, RK-M7).
     *
     * @return list<Permission>
     *
     * @throws ValidationException
     */
    private function postedPermissions(): array
    {
        $permissions = [];

        foreach ($this->permissions as $value) {
            $permission = is_string($value) ? Permission::tryFrom($value) : null;

            if ($permission === null) {
                throw ValidationException::withMessages([
                    'permissions' => __('One or more permissions cannot be given to a custom role.'),
                ]);
            }

            $permissions[] = $permission;
        }

        return $permissions;
    }
};
```

### Task 24: Audit viewer

**Covers:** AUD-3, AUD-8 (filters, URL, resetPage(), flyout; not CSV), AUD-11 (central-only rows), TEN-4, DEC26-1, R-5, RL-7, RL-9; RK-I4, RK-M4, RK-D1.

**Files:**
- Create: `resources/views/pages/activity/index/index.php`, `resources/views/pages/activity/index/index.blade.php`
- Modify: `app/Models/Activity.php` (`changeSummary()`), `routes/admin.php`, `resources/views/layouts/app/sidebar.blade.php` (Activity log link in the Administration group), `tests/Feature/Tenancy/RouteHostMatrixTest.php` (`activity.index`), `tests/Feature/Navigation/AdministrationLinksTest.php` (Activity log link per actor), `lang/nl.json`, `lang/en.json`
- Test: `tests/Feature/Audit/ActivityViewerTest.php`

**Interfaces:**
- Consumes:
  - `App\Models\Activity` (Task 1: extends `Spatie\Activitylog\Models\Activity`; tenant model with `BelongsToOrganisation`, `SoftDeletes`; `organisation_id`, `ip_address`, `user_agent` columns; `kitEvent(): ?ActivityEvent`; vendor `getProperty(string $propertyName, mixed $defaultValue = null): mixed`, `properties` and `attribute_changes` cast to collections), `App\Enums\ActivityEvent` (`label()`, cases), `App\Actions\Audit\RecordActivity::handle(...)` (tests only).
  - `App\Tenancy\HostScope::read(Closure $callback): mixed` and `HostScope::organisationId(): ?int` (Task 7).
  - `App\Tenancy\UserNames::of(array $ids): array<int, string>` (Task 13: `@param list<int>`; bypass + `withTrashed()`; missing ids omitted).
  - Test helpers `pageSnapshot()`, `callPageAction()` (Task 7); the Administration sidebar group, the `forbidden` matrix outcome and `AdministrationLinksTest.php` (Task 8).
- Produces:
  - `Activity::changeSummary(): array` — `@return list<array{attribute: string, old: mixed, new: mixed}>` (one row per attribute present in `attribute_changes.old` or `attribute_changes.attributes`).
  - Page `pages::activity.index` (`#[Title('Activity log')]`):
    - `#[Url] public string $from = ''`, `#[Url] public string $until = ''` (`Y-m-d`; anything else is ignored), `#[Url] public string $event = ''`, `#[Url] public string $subject = ''`, `#[Url] public string $causer = ''`, `#[Url] public string $organisation = ''` (central only; ignored on a tenant host); `#[Locked] public ?int $detailId = null`; `public bool $detailOpen = false`.
    - `mount(): void` (`Gate::authorize(Permission::ActivityLogView)`), `updated(string $property): void` (`resetPage()` for the six filters), `showDetail(int $activityId): void` (resolves through the host scope, 404 otherwise), `closeDetail(): void`.
    - `#[Computed] activities(): LengthAwarePaginator<int, Activity>` (50 per page, newest first; central: `withTrashed()`, `organisation_id = null` rows included), `#[Computed] rows(): list<array<string, mixed>>` (display rows of the page), `#[Computed] detail(): ?array` (the flyout's row), `#[Computed] causerNames(): array<int, string>` (causers, `impersonated_as`, `impersonator_id` and user subjects of the page's rows), `#[Computed] eventOptions(): array<string, string>`, `#[Computed] subjectOptions(): array<string, string>`, `#[Computed] causerOptions(): array<int, string>` (from the scoped query; a `?causer=` outside it is ignored), `#[Computed] organisationOptions(): array<int, string>` (central only, archived organisations included), `#[Computed] isCentral(): bool`.
  - Route `Route::livewire('activity', 'pages::activity.index')->can(Permission::ActivityLogView)->name('activity.index')` (any host, inside the `auth` group of `routes/admin.php`).

**Rules this task implements** (spec §4.8, §6.2, §6.7; RL-7, RL-9, RK-I4, RK-M4, RK-D1, R-5, AUD-3, AUD-8, AUD-11):
- The viewer is gated by `activity_log.view` on the route and in `mount()`. On a tenant host it lists only that organisation's entries (the tenant scope); on a central host a super admin sees every entry, including central ones (`organisation_id = null`, shown as "Platform") and archived organisations' entries (soft-deleted by the cascade, read with `withTrashed()`), with an organisation column and filter (AUD-3, AUD-11, RL-7). Tenant models are read only through `HostScope::read()`; the page is not on the bypass allow-list.
- Filters: date range as two `flux:input type="date"` (free Flux, §6.7) compared as datetimes in the app timezone (`created_at >= from 00:00`, `< until + 1 day`), action (`ActivityEvent` value), subject type, causer and (centrally) organisation. All live in the URL (`#[Url]`), every change resets the page, and invalid values are ignored, so a hostile query string answers 200 (AUD-8).
- 50 entries per page, newest first, with columns for when, action (translated label; an unknown older key renders raw), done by, subject, organisation (central), changes (old → new per attribute) and reason or details.
- Causer names are resolved across scopes — super admins and soft-deleted users included — with `UserNames::of()`, fed only ids taken from rows this viewer already read through its scope; a missing (purged) user shows as "Deleted user". A forged `?causer=` id that does not occur in the host's entries is ignored and its name never rendered (RL-9, RK-M4, RK-D1, R-5).
- An entry made while impersonating shows the real user with "as :name" for the impersonated user (`properties.impersonated_as`); a stop logged without a causer shows the impersonator from `properties.impersonator_id`.
- A failed sign-in whose typed value was not an email address (`properties.invalid_address = true`) shows "Not an email address" and never a value (none is stored, RL-7).
- The detail flyout (free `flux:modal variant="flyout"`) shows every stored field: action and its key, causer, subject, organisation, reason or details, IP address, user agent, the changes and the raw properties. No CSV export (M7).
- Morph relations (`causer`, `subject`) are never eager-loaded through the tenant scope; subject labels are built from the type and id (plus the user's name, or `properties.name`).

- [ ] **Step 3: `Activity::changeSummary()`**

In `app/Models/Activity.php`, add this public method after `kitEvent()`:

```php
    /**
     * The recorded diff as one row per attribute, for the viewer (§4.8). Attributes present on
     * only one side get null on the other.
     *
     * @return list<array{attribute: string, old: mixed, new: mixed}>
     */
    public function changeSummary(): array
    {
        $changes = $this->attribute_changes?->toArray() ?? [];
        $old = is_array($changes['old'] ?? null) ? $changes['old'] : [];
        $new = is_array($changes['attributes'] ?? null) ? $changes['attributes'] : [];
        $summary = [];

        foreach (array_unique([...array_keys($old), ...array_keys($new)]) as $attribute) {
            $summary[] = [
                'attribute' => (string) $attribute,
                'old' => $old[$attribute] ?? null,
                'new' => $new[$attribute] ?? null,
            ];
        }

        return $summary;
    }
```
